lines.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Gauree Sukhmani, Fifth Mehla,
Shalok:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
I bow to the Primal Guru.
I bow to the Guru of the ages.
I bow to the True Guru.
I bow to the Great, Divine Guru. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
Meditate, meditate, meditate in remembrance of Him, and find peace.
Worry and anguish shall be dispelled from your body.
Remember in praise the One who pervades the whole Universe.
His Name is chanted by countless people, in so many ways.
The Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees, the purest of utterances,
were created from the One Word of the Name of the Lord.
That one, in whose soul the One Lord dwells

lines.g: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਗਨੀ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
lines.r: taa kee mahimaa ganee na aavai ||
lines.ht: ता की महिमा गनी न आवै ॥
lines.e: the praises of his glory cannot be recounted.
Those who yearn only for the blessing of Your Darshan
- Nanak: save me along with them! ||1||
Sukhmani: Peace of Mind, the Nectar of the Name of God.

lines.g: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.r: bhagat janaa kai man bisraam || rahaau ||
lines.ht: भगत जना कै मनि बिस्राम ॥ रहाउ ॥
lines.e: The minds of the devotees abide in a joyful peace. ||Pause||

lines.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਗਰਭਿ ਨ ਬਸੈ ॥
lines.r: prabh kai simaran garabh na basai ||
lines.ht: प्रभ कै सिमरनि गरभि न बसै ॥
lines.e: Remembering God, one does not have to enter into the womb again.

lines.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਜਮੁ ਨਸੈ ॥
lines.r: prabh kai simaran dhookh jam nasai ||
lines.ht: प्रभ कै सिमरनि दूखु जमु नसै ॥
lines.e: Remembering God, the pain of death is dispelled.
Remembering God, death is eliminated.
Remembering God, one's enemies are repelled.

lines.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਕਛੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
lines.r: prabh simarat kachh bighan na laagai ||
lines.ht: प्रभ सिमरत कछु बिघनु न लागै ॥
lines.e: Remembering God, no obstacles are met.
Remembering God, one remains awake and aware, night and day.

lines.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਭਉ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
lines.r: prabh kai simaran bhau na biaapai ||
lines.ht: प्रभ कै सिमरनि भउ न बिआपै ॥
lines.e: Remembering God, one is not touched by fear.

lines.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ ॥
lines.r: prabh kai simaran dhukh na sa(n)taapai ||
lines.ht: प्रभ कै सिमरनि दुखु न संतापै ॥
lines.e: Remembering God, one does not suffer sorrow.

lines.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
lines.r: prabh kaa simaran saadh kai sa(n)g ||
lines.ht: प्रभ का सिमरनु साध कै संगि ॥
lines.e: The meditative remembrance of God is in the Company of the Holy.
All treasures, O Nanak, are in the Love of the Lord. ||2||

lines.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ॥
lines.r: prabh kai simaran ridh sidh nau nidh ||
lines.ht: प्रभ कै सिमरनि रिधि सिधि नउ निधि ॥
lines.e: In the remembrance of God are wealth, miraculous spiritual powers and the nine treasures.

lines.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਤਤੁ ਬੁਧਿ ॥
lines.r: prabh kai simaran giaan dhiaan tat budh ||
lines.ht: प्रभ कै सिमरनि गिआनु धिआनु ततु बुधि ॥
lines.e: In the remembrance of God are knowledge, meditation and the essence of wisdom.

lines.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
lines.r: prabh kai simaran jap tap poojaa ||
lines.ht: प्रभ कै सिमरनि जप तप पूजा ॥
lines.e: In the remembrance of God are chanting, intense meditation and devotional worship.
In the remembrance of God, duality is removed.
In the remembrance of God are purifying baths at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
In the remembrance of God, one attains honor in the Court of the Lord.

lines.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਭਲਾ ॥
lines.r: prabh kai simaran hoi su bhalaa ||
lines.ht: प्रभ कै सिमरनि होइ सु भला ॥
lines.e: In the remembrance of God, one becomes good.
In the remembrance of God, one flowers in fruition.
They alone remember Him in meditation, whom He inspires to meditate.
Nanak grasps the feet of those humble beings. ||3||

lines.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ॥
lines.r: prabh kaa simaran sabh te uoochaa ||
lines.ht: प्रभ का सिमरनु सभ ते ऊचा ॥
lines.e: The remembrance of God is the highest and most exalted of all.
In the remembrance of God, many are saved.
In the remembrance of God, thirst is quenched.

lines.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੁਝੈ ॥
lines.r: prabh kai simaran sabh kichh sujhai ||
lines.ht: प्रभ कै सिमरनि सभु किछु सुझै ॥
lines.e: In the remembrance of God, all things are known.

lines.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਮ ਤ੍ਰਾਸਾ ॥
lines.r: prabh kai simaran naahee jam traasaa ||
lines.ht: प्रभ कै सिमरनि नाही जम त्रासा ॥
lines.e: In the remembrance of God, there is no fear of death.
In the remembrance of God, hopes are fulfilled.

lines.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.r: prabh kai simaran man kee mal jai ||
lines.ht: प्रभ कै सिमरनि मन की मलु जाइ ॥
lines.e: In the remembrance of God, the filth of the mind is removed.
The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, is absorbed into the heart.

lines.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਬਸਹਿ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
lines.r: prabh jee baseh saadh kee rasanaa ||
lines.ht: प्रभ जी बसहि साध की रसना ॥
lines.e: God abides upon the tongues of His Saints.
Nanak is the servant of the slave of His slaves. ||4||
Those who remember God are wealthy.
Those who remember God are honorable.

lines.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਵਾਨ ॥
lines.r: prabh kau simareh se jan paravaan ||
lines.ht: प्रभ कउ सिमरहि से जन परवान ॥
lines.e: Those who remember God are approved.

lines.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਪੁਰਖ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨ ॥
lines.r: prabh kau simareh se purakh pradhaan ||
lines.ht: प्रभ कउ सिमरहि से पुरख प्रधान ॥
lines.e: Those who remember God are the most distinguished persons.
Those who remember God are not lacking.

lines.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸਿ ਸਰਬ ਕੇ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
lines.r: prabh kau simareh s sarab ke raaje ||
lines.ht: प्रभ कउ सिमरहि सि सरब के राजे ॥
lines.e: Those who remember God are the rulers of all.
Those who remember God dwell in peace.
Those who remember God are immortal and eternal.

lines.g: ਸਿਮਰਨ ਤੇ ਲਾਗੇ ਜਿਨ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
lines.r: simaran te laage jin aap dhiaalaa ||
lines.ht: सिमरन ते लागे जिन आपि दइआला ॥
lines.e: They alone hold to the remembrance of Him, unto whom He Himself shows His Mercy.
Nanak begs for the dust of their feet. ||5||
Those who remember God generously help others.

lines.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
lines.r: prabh kau simareh tin sadh balihaaree ||
lines.ht: प्रभ कउ सिमरहि तिन सद बलिहारी ॥
lines.e: Those who remember God - to them, I am forever a sacrifice.

lines.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਮੁਖ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ ॥
lines.r: prabh kau simareh se mukh suhaave ||
lines.ht: प्रभ कउ सिमरहि से मुख सुहावे ॥
lines.e: Those who remember God - their faces are beautiful.

lines.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਸੂਖਿ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ॥
lines.r: prabh kau simareh tin sookh bihaavai ||
lines.ht: प्रभ कउ सिमरहि तिन सूखि बिहावै ॥
lines.e: Those who remember God abide in peace.

lines.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਆਤਮੁ ਜੀਤਾ ॥
lines.r: prabh kau simareh tin aatam jeetaa ||
lines.ht: प्रभ कउ सिमरहि तिन आतमु जीता ॥
lines.e: Those who remember God conquer their souls.

lines.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਾ ॥
lines.r: prabh kau simareh tin niramal reetaa ||
lines.ht: प्रभ कउ सिमरहि तिन निरमल रीता ॥
lines.e: Those who remember God have a pure and spotless lifestyle.

lines.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਅਨਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ॥
lines.r: prabh kau simareh tin anadh ghanere ||
lines.ht: प्रभ कउ सिमरहि तिन अनद घनेरे ॥
lines.e: Those who remember God experience all sorts of joys.

lines.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਬਸਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨੇਰੇ ॥
lines.r: prabh kau simareh baseh har nere ||
lines.ht: प्रभ कउ सिमरहि बसहि हरि नेरे ॥
lines.e: Those who remember God abide near the Lord.
By the Grace of the Saints, one remains awake and aware, night and day.
O Nanak, this meditative remembrance comes only by perfect destiny. ||6||
Remembering God, one's works are accomplished.

lines.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਝੂਰੇ ॥
lines.r: prabh kai simaran kabahu na jhoore ||
lines.ht: प्रभ कै सिमरनि कबहु न झूरे ॥
lines.e: Remembering God, one never grieves.

lines.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
lines.r: prabh kai simaran har gun baanee ||
lines.ht: प्रभ कै सिमरनि हरि गुन बानी ॥
lines.e: Remembering God, one speaks the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
Remembering God, one is absorbed into the state of intuitive ease.
Remembering God, one attains the unchanging position.
Remembering God, the heart-lotus blossoms forth.
Remembering God, the unstruck melody vibrates.

lines.g: ਸੁਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰ ॥
lines.r: sukh prabh simaran kaa a(n)t na paar ||
lines.ht: सुखु प्रभ सिमरन का अंतु न पार ॥
lines.e: The peace of the meditative remembrance of God has no end or limitation.

lines.g: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਇਆ ॥
lines.r: simareh se jan jin kau prabh miaa ||
lines.ht: सिमरहि से जन जिन कउ प्रभ मइआ ॥
lines.e: They alone remember Him, upon whom God bestows His Grace.
Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of those humble beings. ||7||
Remembering the Lord, His devotees are famous and radiant.
Remembering the Lord, the Vedas were composed.

lines.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਭਏ ਸਿਧ ਜਤੀ ਦਾਤੇ ॥
lines.r: har simaran bhe sidh jatee dhaate ||
lines.ht: हरि सिमरनि भए सिध जती दाते ॥
lines.e: Remembering the Lord, we become Siddhas, celibates and givers.

lines.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਨੀਚ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਟ ਜਾਤੇ ॥
lines.r: har simaran neech chahu ku(n)T jaate ||
lines.ht: हरि सिमरनि नीच चहु कुँट जाते ॥
lines.e: Remembering the Lord, the lowly become known in all four directions.
For the remembrance of the Lord, the whole world was established.
Remember, remember in meditation the Lord, the Creator, the Cause of causes.
For the remembrance of the Lord, He created the whole creation.
In the remembrance of the Lord, He Himself is Formless.
By His Grace, He Himself bestows understanding.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੮॥੧॥
lines.r: naanak gurmukh har simaran tin paiaa ||8||1||
lines.ht: नानक गुरमुखि हरि सिमरनु तिनि पाइआ ॥८॥१॥
lines.e: O Nanak, the Gurmukh attains the remembrance of the Lord. ||8||1||
Shalok:

lines.g: ਦੀਨ ਦਰਦ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨਾ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਨਾਥ ਅਨਾਥ ॥
lines.r: dheen dharadh dhukh bha(n)janaa ghaT ghaT naath anaath ||
lines.ht: दीन दरद दुख भंजना घटि घटि नाथ अनाथ ॥
lines.e: O Destroyer of the pains and the suffering of the poor, O Master of each and every heart, O Masterless One:

lines.g: ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ਆਇਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਥ ॥੧॥
lines.r: saran tum(h)aaree aaio naanak ke prabh saath ||1||
lines.ht: सरणि तुम्मारी आइओ नानक के प्रभ साथ ॥१॥
lines.e: I have come seeking Your Sanctuary. O God, please be with Nanak! ||1||
Ashtapadee:

lines.g: ਜਹ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਮੀਤ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.r: jeh maat pitaa sut meet na bhaiee ||
lines.ht: जह मात पिता सुत मीत न भाई ॥
lines.e: Where there is no mother, father, children, friends or siblings

lines.g: ਮਨ ਊਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
lines.r: man uoohaa naam terai sa(n)g sahaiee ||
lines.ht: मन ऊहा नामु तेरै संगि सहाई ॥
lines.e: O my mind, there, only the Naam, the Name of the Lord, shall be with you as your help and support.

lines.g: ਜਹ ਮਹਾ ਭਇਆਨ ਦੂਤ ਜਮ ਦਲੈ ॥
lines.r: jeh mahaa bhiaan dhoot jam dhalai ||
lines.ht: जह महा भइआन दूत जम दलै ॥
lines.e: Where the great and terrible Messenger of Death shall try to crush you,

lines.g: ਤਹ ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਚਲੈ ॥
lines.r: teh keval naam sa(n)g terai chalai ||
lines.ht: तह केवल नामु संगि तेरै चलै ॥
lines.e: there, only the Naam shall go along with you.
Where the obstacles are so very heavy,

lines.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਖਿਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਧਾਰੀ ॥
lines.r: har ko naam khin maeh udhaaree ||
lines.ht: हरि को नामु खिन माहि उधारी ॥
lines.e: the Name of the Lord shall rescue you in an instant.
By performing countless religious rituals, you shall not be saved.

lines.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਾਪ ਪਰਹਰੈ ॥
lines.r: har ko naam koT paap paraharai ||
lines.ht: हरि को नामु कोटि पाप परहरै ॥
lines.e: The Name of the Lord washes off millions of sins.
As Gurmukh, chant the Naam, O my mind.
O Nanak, you shall obtain countless joys. ||1||
The rulers of the all the world are unhappy;

lines.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਖੀਆ ॥
lines.r: har kaa naam japat hoi sukheeaa ||
lines.ht: हरि का नामु जपत होइ सुखीआ ॥
lines.e: one who chants the Name of the Lord becomes happy.
Acquiring hundreds of thousands and millions, your desires shall not be contained.
Chanting the Name of the Lord, you shall find release.

lines.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ਤਿਖ ਨ ਬੁਝਾਵੈ ॥
lines.r: anik maiaa ra(n)g tikh na bujhaavai ||
lines.ht: अनिक माइआ रंग तिख न बुझावै ॥
lines.e: By the countless pleasures of Maya, your thirst shall not be quenched.
Chanting the Name of the Lord, you shall be satisfied.
Upon that path where you must go all alone,

lines.g: ਤਹ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੋਤ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
lines.r: teh har naam sa(n)g hot suhelaa ||
lines.ht: तह हरि नामु संगि होत सुहेला ॥
lines.e: there, only the Lord's Name shall go with you to sustain you.
On such a Name, O my mind, meditate forever.
O Nanak, as Gurmukh, you shall obtain the state of supreme dignity. ||2||
You shall not be saved by hundreds of thousands and millions of helping hands.
Chanting the Naam, you shall be lifted up and carried across.
Where countless misfortunes threaten to destroy you,
the Name of the Lord shall rescue you in an instant.
Through countless incarnations, you were born, then died and then born again.
Chanting the Name of the Lord, you shall come to rest in peace.

lines.g: ਹਉ ਮੈਲਾ ਮਲੁ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
lines.r: hau mailaa mal kabahu na dhovai ||
lines.ht: हउ मैला मलु कबहु न धोवै ॥
lines.e: The ego is polluted by a filth which can never be washed off.

lines.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਾਪ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
lines.r: har kaa naam koT paap khovai ||
lines.ht: हरि का नामु कोटि पाप खोवै ॥
lines.e: The Name of the Lord erases millions of sins.
Chant such a Name with love, O my mind.
O Nanak, it is obtained in the Company of the Holy. ||3||

lines.g: ਜਿਹ ਮਾਰਗ ਕੇ ਗਨੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਨ ਕੋਸਾ ॥
lines.r: jeh maarag ke gane jaeh na kosaa ||
lines.ht: जिह मारग के गने जाहि न कोसा ॥
lines.e: On that path where the miles cannot be counted,

lines.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਊਹਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੋਸਾ ॥
lines.r: har kaa naam uoohaa sa(n)g tosaa ||
lines.ht: हरि का नामु ऊहा संगि तोसा ॥
lines.e: there, the Name of the Lord shall be your sustenance.
On that journey of total, pitch-black darkness,
the Name of the Lord shall be the Light with you.

lines.g: ਜਹਾ ਪੰਥਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੋ ਨ ਸਿਞਾਨੂ ॥
lines.r: jahaa pa(n)th teraa ko na sin(j)aanoo ||
lines.ht: जहा पंथि तेरा को न सिञानू ॥
lines.e: On that journey where no one knows you,

lines.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਹ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਛਾਨੂ ॥
lines.r: har kaa naam teh naal pachhaanoo ||
lines.ht: हरि का नामु तह नालि पछानू ॥
lines.e: with the Name of the Lord, you shall be recognized.

lines.g: ਜਹ ਮਹਾ ਭਇਆਨ ਤਪਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਘਾਮ ॥
lines.r: jeh mahaa bhiaan tapat bahu ghaam ||
lines.ht: जह महा भइआन तपति बहु घाम ॥
lines.e: Where there is awesome and terrible heat and blazing sunshine,

lines.g: ਤਹ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਤੁਮ ਊਪਰਿ ਛਾਮ ॥
lines.r: teh har ke naam kee tum uoopar chhaam ||
lines.ht: तह हरि के नाम की तुम ऊपरि छाम ॥
lines.e: there, the Name of the Lord will give you shade.
Where thirst, O my mind, torments you to cry out,

lines.g: ਤਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬਰਖੈ ॥੪॥
lines.r: teh naanak har har a(n)mrit barakhai ||4||
lines.ht: तह नानक हरि हरि अंमृतु बरखै ॥४॥
lines.e: there, O Nanak, the Ambrosial Name, Har, Har, shall rain down upon you. ||4||
Unto the devotee, the Naam is an article of daily use.
The minds of the humble Saints are at peace.

lines.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਓਟ ॥
lines.r: har kaa naam dhaas kee oT ||
lines.ht: हरि का नामु दास की ओट ॥
lines.e: The Name of the Lord is the Support of His servants.

lines.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਉਧਰੇ ਜਨ ਕੋਟਿ ॥
lines.r: har kai naam udhare jan koT ||
lines.ht: हरि कै नामि उधरे जन कोटि ॥
lines.e: By the Name of the Lord, millions have been saved.

lines.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਰਤ ਸੰਤ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
lines.r: har jas karat sa(n)t dhin raat ||
lines.ht: हरि जसु करत संत दिनु राति ॥
lines.e: The Saints chant the Praises of the Lord, day and night.
Har, Har - the Lord's Name - the Holy use it as their healing medicine.

lines.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
lines.r: har jan kai har naam nidhaan ||
lines.ht: हरि जन कै हरि नामु निधानु ॥
lines.e: The Lord's Name is the treasure of the Lord's servant.
The Supreme Lord God has blessed His humble servant with this gift.

lines.g: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗ ਏਕੈ ॥
lines.r: man tan ra(n)g rate ra(n)g ekai ||
lines.ht: मन तन रंगि रते रंग एकै ॥
lines.e: Mind and body are imbued with ecstasy in the Love of the One Lord.
O Nanak, careful and discerning understanding is the way of the Lord's humble servant. ||5||

lines.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ॥
lines.r: har kaa naam jan kau mukat jugat ||
lines.ht: हरि का नामु जन कउ मुकति जुगति ॥
lines.e: The Name of the Lord is the path of liberation for His humble servants.

lines.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਭੁਗਤਿ ॥
lines.r: har kai naam jan kau tirapat bhugat ||
lines.ht: हरि कै नामि जन कउ तृपति भुगति ॥
lines.e: With the food of the Name of the Lord, His servants are satisfied.

lines.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
lines.r: har kaa naam jan kaa roop ra(n)g ||
lines.ht: हरि का नामु जन का रूप रंगु ॥
lines.e: The Name of the Lord is the beauty and delight of His servants.

lines.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਕਬ ਪਰੈ ਨ ਭੰਗੁ ॥
lines.r: har naam japat kab parai na bha(n)g ||
lines.ht: हरि नामु जपत कब परै न भंगु ॥
lines.e: Chanting the Lord's Name, one is never blocked by obstacles.

lines.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
lines.r: har kaa naam jan kee vaddiaaiee ||
lines.ht: हरि का नामु जन की वडिआई ॥
lines.e: The Name of the Lord is the glorious greatness of His servants.

lines.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਜਨ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.r: har kai naam jan sobhaa paiee ||
lines.ht: हरि कै नामि जन सोभा पाई ॥
lines.e: Through the Name of the Lord, His servants obtain honor.

lines.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਭੋਗ ਜੋਗ ॥
lines.r: har kaa naam jan kau bhog jog ||
lines.ht: हरि का नामु जन कउ भोग जोग ॥
lines.e: The Name of the Lord is the enjoyment and Yoga of His servants.

lines.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਕਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਬਿਓਗੁ ॥
lines.r: har naam japat kachh naeh biog ||
lines.ht: हरि नामु जपत कछु नाहि बिओगु ॥
lines.e: Chanting the Lord's Name, there is no separation from Him.

lines.g: ਜਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
lines.r: jan raataa har naam kee sevaa ||
lines.ht: जनु राता हरि नाम की सेवा ॥
lines.e: His servants are imbued with the service of the Lord's Name.
O Nanak, worship the Lord, the Lord Divine, Har, Har. ||6||

lines.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਮਾਲੁ ਖਜੀਨਾ ॥
lines.r: har har jan kai maal khajeenaa ||
lines.ht: हरि हरि जन कै मालु खजीना ॥
lines.e: The Lord's Name, Har, Har, is the treasure of wealth of His servants.

lines.g: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
lines.r: har dhan jan kau aap prabh dheenaa ||
lines.ht: हरि धनु जन कउ आपि प्रभि दीना ॥
lines.e: The treasure of the Lord has been bestowed on His servants by God Himself.

lines.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਓਟ ਸਤਾਣੀ ॥
lines.r: har har jan kai oT sataanee ||
lines.ht: हरि हरि जन कै ओट सताणी ॥
lines.e: The Lord, Har, Har is the All-powerful Protection of His servants.

lines.g: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪਿ ਜਨ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
lines.r: har prataap jan avar na jaanee ||
lines.ht: हरि प्रतापि जन अवर न जाणी ॥
lines.e: His servants know no other than the Lord's Magnificence.

lines.g: ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
lines.r: ot pot jan har ras raate ||
lines.ht: ओति पोति जन हरि रसि राते ॥
lines.e: Through and through, His servants are imbued with the Lord's Love.
In deepest Samaadhi, they are intoxicated with the essence of the Naam.

lines.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੈ ॥
lines.r: aaTh pahar jan har har japai ||
lines.ht: आठ पहर जनु हरि हरि जपै ॥
lines.e: Twenty-four hours a day, His servants chant Har, Har.

lines.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਭਗਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਨਹੀ ਛਪੈ ॥
lines.r: har kaa bhagat pragaT nahee chhapai ||
lines.ht: हरि का भगतु प्रगट नही छपै ॥
lines.e: The devotees of the Lord are known and respected; they do not hide in secrecy.

lines.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਕਰੇ ॥
lines.r: har kee bhagat mukat bahu kare ||
lines.ht: हरि की भगति मुकति बहु करे ॥
lines.e: Through devotion to the Lord, many have been liberated.
O Nanak, along with His servants, many others are saved. ||7||
This Elysian Tree of miraculous powers is the Name of the Lord.
The Khaamadhayn, the cow of miraculous powers, is the singing of the Glory of the Lord's Name, Har, Har.

lines.g: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਤਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ॥
lines.r: sabh te uootam har kee kathaa ||
lines.ht: सभ ते ऊतम हरि की कथा ॥
lines.e: Highest of all is the Lord's Speech.
Hearing the Naam, pain and sorrow are removed.

lines.g: ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਸੰਤ ਰਿਦ ਵਸੈ ॥
lines.r: naam kee mahimaa sa(n)t ridh vasai ||
lines.ht: नाम की महिमा संत रिद वसै ॥
lines.e: The Glory of the Naam abides in the hearts of His Saints.
By the Saint's kind intervention, all guilt is dispelled.
The Society of the Saints is obtained by great good fortune.
Serving the Saint, one meditates on the Naam.

lines.g: ਨਾਮ ਤੁਲਿ ਕਛੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.r: naam tul kachh avar na hoi ||
lines.ht: नाम तुलि कछु अवरु न होइ ॥
lines.e: There is nothing equal to the Naam.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੮॥੨॥
lines.r: naanak gurmukh naam paavai jan koi ||8||2||
lines.ht: नानक गुरमुखि नामु पावै जनु कोइ ॥८॥२॥
lines.e: O Nanak, rare are those, who, as Gurmukh, obtain the Naam. ||8||2||
Shalok:

lines.g: ਬਹੁ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬਹੁ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤੀ ਪੇਖੇ ਸਰਬ ਢਢੋਲਿ ॥
lines.r: bahu saasatr bahu simritee pekhe sarab ddaddol ||
lines.ht: बहु सासत्र बहु सिमृती पेखे सरब ढढोलि ॥
lines.e: The many Shaastras and the many Simritees - I have seen and searched through them all.

lines.g: ਪੂਜਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਅਮੋਲ ॥੧॥
lines.r: poojas naahee har hare naanak naam amol ||1||
lines.ht: पूजसि नाही हरि हरे नानक नाम अमोल ॥१॥
lines.e: They are not equal to Har, Haray - O Nanak, the Lord's Invaluable Name. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
Chanting, intense meditation, spiritual wisdom and all meditations;
the six schools of philosophy and sermons on the scriptures;
the practice of Yoga and righteous conduct;
the renunciation of everything and wandering around in the wilderness;
the performance of all sorts of works;
donations to charities and offerings of jewels to fire;
cutting the body apart and making the pieces into ceremonial fire offerings;
keeping fasts and making vows of all sorts
- none of these are equal to the contemplation of the Name of the Lord,

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਇਕ ਬਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.r: naanak gurmukh naam japeeaai ik baar ||1||
lines.ht: नानक गुरमुखि नामु जपीऐ इक बार ॥१॥
lines.e: O Nanak, if, as Gurmukh, one chants the Naam, even once. ||1||

lines.g: ਨਉ ਖੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੀ ਫਿਰੈ ਚਿਰੁ ਜੀਵੈ ॥
lines.r: nau kha(n)dd pirathamee firai chir jeevai ||
lines.ht: नउ खंड पृथमी फिरै चिरु जीवै ॥
lines.e: You may roam over the nine continents of the world and live a very long life;
you may become a great ascetic and a master of disciplined meditation
and burn yourself in fire;
you may give away gold, horses, elephants and land;
you may practice techniques of inner cleansing and all sorts of Yogic postures;
you may adopt the self-mortifying ways of the Jains and great spiritual disciplines;
piece by piece, you may cut your body apart;

lines.g: ਤਉ ਭੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
lines.r: tau bhee haumai mail na jaavai ||
lines.ht: तउ भी हउमै मैलु न जावै ॥
lines.e: but even so, the filth of your ego shall not depart.

lines.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਕਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
lines.r: har ke naam samasar kachh naeh ||
lines.ht: हरि के नाम समसरि कछु नाहि ॥
lines.e: There is nothing equal to the Name of the Lord.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
lines.r: naanak gurmukh naam japat gat paeh ||2||
lines.ht: नानक गुरमुखि नामु जपत गति पाहि ॥२॥
lines.e: O Nanak, as Gurmukh, chant the Naam, and obtain salvation. ||2||
With your mind filled with desire, you may give up your body at a sacred shrine of pilgrimage;

lines.g: ਗਰਬੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਹੁਟੈ ॥
lines.r: garab gumaan na man te huTai ||
lines.ht: गरबु गुमानु न मन ते हुटै ॥
lines.e: but even so, egotistical pride shall not be removed from your mind.
You may practice cleansing day and night,

lines.g: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਜਾਤਿ ॥
lines.r: man kee mail na tan te jaat ||
lines.ht: मन की मैलु न तन ते जाति ॥
lines.e: but the filth of your mind shall not leave your body.

lines.g: ਇਸੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਕਉ ਬਹੁ ਸਾਧਨਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
lines.r: eis dhehee kau bahu saadhanaa karai ||
lines.ht: इसु देही कउ बहु साधना करै ॥
lines.e: You may subject your body to all sorts of disciplines,

lines.g: ਮਨ ਤੇ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਟਰੈ ॥
lines.r: man te kabahoo na bikhiaa Tarai ||
lines.ht: मन ते कबहू न बिखिआ टरै ॥
lines.e: but your mind will never be rid of its corruption.
You may wash this transitory body with loads of water,
but how can a wall of mud be washed clean?

lines.g: ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਊਚ ॥
lines.r: man har ke naam kee mahimaa uooch ||
lines.ht: मन हरि के नाम की महिमा ऊच ॥
lines.e: O my mind, the Glorious Praise of the Name of the Lord is the highest;

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਉਧਰੇ ਪਤਿਤ ਬਹੁ ਮੂਚ ॥੩॥
lines.r: naanak naam udhare patit bahu mooch ||3||
lines.ht: नानक नामि उधरे पतित बहु मूच ॥३॥
lines.e: O Nanak, the Naam has saved so many of the worst sinners. ||3||

lines.g: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
lines.r: bahut siaanap jam kaa bhau biaapai ||
lines.ht: बहुतु सिआणप जम का भउ बिआपै ॥
lines.e: Even with great cleverness, the fear of death clings to you.

lines.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਨਾ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੈ ॥
lines.r: anik jatan kar tirasan naa dhraapai ||
lines.ht: अनिक जतन करि तृसन ना ध्रापै ॥
lines.e: You try all sorts of things, but your thirst is still not satisfied.
Wearing various religious robes, the fire is not extinguished.
Even making millions of efforts, you shall not be accepted in the Court of the Lord.
You cannot escape to the heavens, or to the nether regions,
if you are entangled in emotional attachment and the net of Maya.
All other efforts are punished by the Messenger of Death,

lines.g: ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
lines.r: govi(n)dh bhajan bin til nahee maanai ||
lines.ht: गोविंद भजन बिनु तिलु नही मानै ॥
lines.e: which accepts nothing at all, except meditation on the Lord of the Universe.

lines.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.r: har kaa naam japat dhukh jai ||
lines.ht: हरि का नामु जपत दुखु जाइ ॥
lines.e: Chanting the Name of the Lord, sorrow is dispelled.
O Nanak, chant it with intuitive ease. ||4||
One who prays for the four cardinal blessings
should commit himself to the service of the Saints.
If you wish to erase your sorrows,

lines.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਦ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
lines.r: har har naam ridhai sadh gaavai ||
lines.ht: हरि हरि नामु रिदै सद गावै ॥
lines.e: sing the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, within your heart.
If you long for honor for yourself,
then renounce your ego in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

lines.g: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਤੇ ਡਰੈ ॥
lines.r: je ko janam maran te ddarai ||
lines.ht: जे को जनम मरण ते डरै ॥
lines.e: If you fear the cycle of birth and death,
then seek the Sanctuary of the Holy.

lines.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥
lines.r: jis jan kau prabh dharas piaasaa ||
lines.ht: जिसु जन कउ प्रभ दरस पिआसा ॥
lines.e: Those who thirst for the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਸਾ ॥੫॥
lines.r: naanak taa kai bal bal jaasaa ||5||
lines.ht: नानक ता कै बलि बलि जासा ॥५॥
lines.e: - Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to them. ||5||
Among all persons, the supreme person is the one
who gives up his egotistical pride in the Company of the Holy.
One who sees himself as lowly,
shall be accounted as the highest of all.

lines.g: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਗਲ ਕੀ ਰੀਨਾ ॥
lines.r: jaa kaa man hoi sagal kee reenaa ||
lines.ht: जा का मनु होइ सगल की रीना ॥
lines.e: One whose mind is the dust of all,

lines.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਚੀਨਾ ॥
lines.r: har har naam tin ghaT ghaT cheenaa ||
lines.ht: हरि हरि नामु तिनि घटि घटि चीना ॥
lines.e: recognizes the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in each and every heart.
One who eradicates cruelty from within his own mind,
looks upon all the world as his friend.
One who looks upon pleasure and pain as one and the same,
O Nanak, is not affected by sin or virtue. ||6||
To the poor, Your Name is wealth.
To the homeless, Your Name is home.
To the dishonored, You, O God, are honor.
To all, You are the Giver of gifts.
O Creator Lord, Cause of causes, O Lord and Master,
Inner-knower, Searcher of all hearts:
You alone know Your own condition and state.
You Yourself, God, are imbued with Yourself.
You alone can celebrate Your Praises.
O Nanak, no one else knows. ||7||
Of all religions, the best religion

lines.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰਮੁ ॥
lines.r: har ko naam jap niramal karam ||
lines.ht: हरि को नामु जपि निरमल करमु ॥
lines.e: is to chant the Name of the Lord and maintain pure conduct.
Of all religious rituals, the most sublime ritual
is to erase the filth of the dirty mind in the Company of the Holy.
Of all efforts, the best effort

lines.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਜੀਅ ਸਦਾ ॥
lines.r: har kaa naam japahu jeea sadhaa ||
lines.ht: हरि का नामु जपहु जीअ सदा ॥
lines.e: is to chant the Name of the Lord in the heart, forever.
Of all speech, the most ambrosial speech

lines.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨਿ ਰਸਨ ਬਖਾਨੀ ॥
lines.r: har ko jas sun rasan bakhaanee ||
lines.ht: हरि को जसु सुनि रसन बखानी ॥
lines.e: is to hear the Lord's Praise and chant it with the tongue.

lines.g: ਸਗਲ ਥਾਨ ਤੇ ਓਹੁ ਊਤਮ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
lines.r: sagal thaan te oh uootam thaan ||
lines.ht: सगल थान ते ओहु ऊतम थानु ॥
lines.e: Of all places, the most sublime place,

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਹ ਘਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੮॥੩॥
lines.r: naanak jeh ghaT vasai har naam ||8||3||
lines.ht: नानक जिह घटि वसै हरि नामु ॥८॥३॥
lines.e: O Nanak, is that heart in which the Name of the Lord abides. ||8||3||
Shalok:

lines.g: ਨਿਰਗੁਨੀਆਰ ਇਆਨਿਆ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
lines.r: niraguneeaar iaaniaa so prabh sadhaa samaal ||
lines.ht: निरगुनीआर इआनिआ सो प्रभु सदा समालि ॥
lines.e: You worthless, ignorant fool - dwell upon God forever.

lines.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਰਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਬਹੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
lines.r: jin keeaa tis cheet rakh naanak nibahee naal ||1||
lines.ht: जिनि कीआ तिसु चीति रखु नानक निबही नालि ॥१॥
lines.e: Cherish in your consciousness the One who created you; O Nanak, He alone shall go along with you. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
Think of the Glory of the All-pervading Lord, O mortal;
what is your origin, and what is your appearance?
He who fashioned, adorned and decorated you
in the fire of the womb, He preserved you.
In your infancy, He gave you milk to drink.
In the flower of your youth, He gave you food, pleasure and understanding.

lines.g: ਬਿਰਧਿ ਭਇਆ ਊਪਰਿ ਸਾਕ ਸੈਨ ॥ ਮੁਖਿ ਅਪਿਆਉ ਬੈਠ ਕਉ ਦੈਨ ॥
lines.r: biradh bhiaa uoopar saak sain || mukh apiaau baiTh kau dhain ||
lines.ht: बिरधि भइआ ऊपरि साक सैन ॥ मुखि अपिआउ बैठ कउ दैन ॥
lines.e: As you grow old, family and friends are there to feed you as you rest.

lines.g: ਇਹੁ ਨਿਰਗੁਨੁ ਗੁਨੁ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
lines.r: eih niragun gun kachhoo na boojhai ||
lines.ht: इहु निरगुनु गुनु कछू न बूझै ॥
lines.e: This worthless person has not appreciated in the least, all the good deeds done for him.
If you bless him with forgiveness, O Nanak, only then will he be saved. ||1||

lines.g: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਧਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਬਸਹਿ ॥
lines.r: jeh prasaadh dhar uoopar sukh baseh ||
lines.ht: जिह प्रसादि धर ऊपरि सुखि बसहि ॥
lines.e: By His Grace, you abide in comfort upon the earth.

lines.g: ਸੁਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਮੀਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਸਹਿ ॥
lines.r: sut bhraat meet banitaa sa(n)g haseh ||
lines.ht: सुत भ्रात मीत बनिता संगि हसहि ॥
lines.e: With your children, siblings, friends and spouse, you laugh.
By His Grace, you drink in cool water.
You have peaceful breezes and priceless fire.
By His Grace, you enjoy all sorts of pleasures.
You are provided with all the necessities of life.

lines.g: ਦੀਨੇ ਹਸਤ ਪਾਵ ਕਰਨ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
lines.r: dheene hasat paav karan netr rasanaa ||
lines.ht: दीने हसत पाव करन नेत्र रसना ॥
lines.e: He gave you hands, feet, ears, eyes and tongue,
and yet, you forsake Him and attach yourself to others.
Such sinful mistakes cling to the blind fools;
Nanak: uplift and save them, God! ||2||
From beginning to end, He is our Protector,

lines.g: ਤਿਸ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਕਰੈ ਗਵਾਰੁ ॥
lines.r: tis siau preet na karai gavaar ||
lines.ht: तिस सिउ प्रीति न करै गवारु ॥
lines.e: and yet, the ignorant do not give their love to Him.

lines.g: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.r: jaa kee sevaa nav nidh paavai ||
lines.ht: जा की सेवा नव निधि पावै ॥
lines.e: Serving Him, the nine treasures are obtained,

lines.g: ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਮੂੜਾ ਮਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
lines.r: taa siau mooRaa man nahee laavai ||
lines.ht: ता सिउ मूड़ा मनु नही लावै ॥
lines.e: and yet, the foolish do not link their minds with Him.
Our Lord and Master is Ever-present, forever and ever,
and yet, the spiritually blind believe that He is far away.

lines.g: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਪਾਵੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.r: jaa kee Tahal paavai dharageh maan ||
lines.ht: जा की टहल पावै दरगह मानु ॥
lines.e: In His service, one obtains honor in the Court of the Lord,
and yet, the ignorant fool forgets Him.
Forever and ever, this person makes mistakes;
O Nanak, the Infinite Lord is our Saving Grace. ||3||
Forsaking the jewel, they are engrossed with a shell.
They renounce Truth and embrace falsehood.

lines.g: ਜੋ ਛਡਨਾ ਸੁ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
lines.r: jo chhaddanaa su asathir kar maanai ||
lines.ht: जो छडना सु असथिरु करि मानै ॥
lines.e: That which passes away, they believe to be permanent.
That which is immanent, they believe to be far off.

lines.g: ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਇ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
lines.r: chhodd jai tis kaa sram karai ||
lines.ht: छोडि जाइ तिस का स्रमु करै ॥
lines.e: They struggle for what they must eventually leave.
They turn away from the Lord, their Help and Support, who is always with them.
They wash off the sandalwood paste;
like donkeys, they are in love with the mud.
They have fallen into the deep, dark pit.
Nanak: lift them up and save them, O Merciful Lord God! ||4||
They belong to the human species, but they act like animals.
They curse others day and night.
Outwardly, they wear religious robes, but within is the filth of Maya.
They cannot conceal this, no matter how hard they try.
Outwardly, they display knowledge, meditation and purification,
but within clings the dog of greed.
The fire of desire rages within; outwardly they apply ashes to their bodies.
There is a stone around their neck - how can they cross the unfathomable ocean?

lines.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਸੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
lines.r: jaa kai a(n)tar basai prabh aap ||
lines.ht: जा कै अंतरि बसै प्रभु आपि ॥
lines.e: Those, within whom God Himself abides
- O Nanak, those humble beings are intuitively absorbed in the Lord. ||5||
By listening, how can the blind find the path?
Take hold of his hand, and then he can reach his destination.
How can a riddle be understood by the deaf?
Say 'night', and he thinks you said 'day'.
How can the mute sing the Songs of the Lord?

lines.g: ਜਤਨ ਕਰੈ ਤਉ ਭੀ ਸੁਰ ਭੰਗ ॥
lines.r: jatan karai tau bhee sur bha(n)g ||
lines.ht: जतन करै तउ भी सुर भंग ॥
lines.e: He may try, but his voice will fail him.
How can the cripple climb up the mountain?
He simply cannot go there.

lines.g: ਕਰਤਾਰ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਦੀਨੁ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕਰੈ ॥
lines.r: karataar karunaa mai dheen benatee karai ||
lines.ht: करतार करुणा मै दीनु बेनती करै ॥
lines.e: O Creator, Lord of Mercy - Your humble servant prays;
Nanak: by Your Grace, please save me. ||6||

lines.g: ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਸੁ ਆਵੈ ਨ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)g sahaiee su aavai na cheet ||
lines.ht: संगि सहाई सु आवै न चीति ॥
lines.e: The Lord, our Help and Support, is always with us, but the mortal does not remember Him.
He shows love to his enemies.
He lives in a castle of sand.
He enjoys the games of pleasure and the tastes of Maya.
He believes them to be permanent - this is the belief of his mind.
Death does not even come to mind for the fool.
Hate, conflict, sexual desire, anger, emotional attachment,
falsehood, corruption, immense greed and deceit:
So many lifetimes are wasted in these ways.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਆਪਨ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਮ ॥੭॥
lines.r: naanak raakh leh aapan kar karam ||7||
lines.ht: नानक राखि लेहु आपन करि करम ॥७॥
lines.e: Nanak: uplift them, and redeem them, O Lord - show Your Mercy! ||7||
You are our Lord and Master; to You, I offer this prayer.
This body and soul are all Your property.

lines.g: ਤੁਮ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
lines.r: tum maat pitaa ham baarik tere ||
lines.ht: तुम मात पिता हम बारिक तेरे ॥
lines.e: You are our mother and father; we are Your children.
In Your Grace, there are so many joys!
No one knows Your limits.
O Highest of the High, Most Generous God,
the whole creation is strung on Your thread.
That which has come from You is under Your Command.

lines.g: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
lines.r: tumaree gat mit tum hee jaanee ||
lines.ht: तुमरी गति मिति तुम ही जानी ॥
lines.e: You alone know Your state and extent.
Nanak, Your slave, is forever a sacrifice. ||8||4||
Shalok:

lines.g: ਦੇਨਹਾਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਛੋਡਿ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਹਿ ਆਨ ਸੁਆਇ ॥
lines.r: dhenahaar prabh chhodd kai laageh aan suaai ||
lines.ht: देनहारु प्रभ छोडि कै लागहि आन सुआइ ॥
lines.e: One who renounces God the Giver, and attaches himself to other affairs

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹੂ ਨ ਸੀਝਈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.r: naanak kahoo na seejhiee bin naavai pat jai ||1||
lines.ht: नानक कहू न सीझई बिनु नावै पति जाइ ॥१॥
lines.e: - O Nanak, he shall never succeed. Without the Name, he shall lose his honor. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
He obtains ten things, and puts them behind him;
for the sake of one thing withheld, he forfeits his faith.

lines.g: ਏਕ ਭੀ ਨ ਦੇਇ ਦਸ ਭੀ ਹਿਰਿ ਲੇਇ ॥
lines.r: ek bhee na dhei dhas bhee hir lei ||
lines.ht: एक भी न देइ दस भी हिरि लेइ ॥
lines.e: But what if that one thing were not given, and the ten were taken away?
Then, what could the fool say or do?
Our Lord and Master cannot be moved by force.
Unto Him, bow forever in adoration.

lines.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
lines.r: jaa kai man laagaa prabh meeThaa ||
lines.ht: जा कै मनि लागा प्रभु मीठा ॥
lines.e: That one, unto whose mind God seems sweet
all pleasures come to abide in his mind.
One who abides by the Lord's Will,
O Nanak, obtains all things. ||1||
God the Banker gives endless capital to the mortal,
who eats, drinks and expends it with pleasure and joy.

lines.g: ਅਪੁਨੀ ਅਮਾਨ ਕਛੁ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਸਾਹੁ ਲੇਇ ॥
lines.r: apunee amaan kachh bahur saahu lei ||
lines.ht: अपुनी अमान कछु बहुरि साहु लेइ ॥
lines.e: If some of this capital is later taken back by the Banker,
the ignorant person shows his anger.
He himself destroys his own credibility,

lines.g: ਬਹੁਰਿ ਉਸ ਕਾ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
lines.r: bahur us kaa bisavaiaas na hovai ||
lines.ht: बहुरि उस का बिस्वासु न होवै ॥
lines.e: and he shall not again be trusted.

lines.g: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਬਸਤੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
lines.r: jis kee basat tis aagai raakhai ||
lines.ht: जिस की बसतु तिसु आगै राखै ॥
lines.e: When one offers to the Lord, that which belongs to the Lord,
and willingly abides by the Will of God's Order,
the Lord will make him happy four times over.
O Nanak, our Lord and Master is merciful forever. ||2||

lines.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਤਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਹੇਤ ॥ ਸਰਪਰ ਹੋਵਤ ਜਾਨੁ ਅਨੇਤ ॥
lines.r: anik bhaat maiaa ke het || sarapar hovat jaan anet ||
lines.ht: अनिक भाति माइआ के हेत ॥ सरपर होवत जानु अनेत ॥
lines.e: The many forms of attachment to Maya shall surely pass away - know that they are transitory.

lines.g: ਬਿਰਖ ਕੀ ਛਾਇਆ ਸਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
lines.r: birakh kee chhaiaa siau ra(n)g laavai ||
lines.ht: बिरख की छाइआ सिउ रंगु लावै ॥
lines.e: People fall in love with the shade of the tree,
and when it passes away, they feel regret in their minds.
Whatever is seen, shall pass away;
and yet, the blindest of the blind cling to it.
One who gives her love to a passing traveler

lines.g: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਹਾਥਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕੇਹ ॥
lines.r: taa kau haath na aavai keh ||
lines.ht: ता कउ हाथि न आवै केह ॥
lines.e: nothing shall come into her hands in this way.

lines.g: ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
lines.r: man har ke naam kee preet sukhadhaiee ||
lines.ht: मन हरि के नाम की प्रीति सुखदाई ॥
lines.e: O mind, the love of the Name of the Lord bestows peace.

lines.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਲਏ ਲਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.r: kar kirapaa naanak aap le laiee ||3||
lines.ht: करि किरपा नानक आपि लए लाई ॥३॥
lines.e: O Nanak, the Lord, in His Mercy, unites us with Himself. ||3||
False are body, wealth, and all relations.
False are ego, possessiveness and Maya.
False are power, youth, wealth and property.
False are sexual desire and wild anger.
False are chariots, elephants, horses and expensive clothes.

lines.g: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਰੰਗ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਪੇਖਿ ਹਸਤਾ ॥
lines.r: mithiaa ra(n)g sa(n)g maiaa pekh hasataa ||
lines.ht: मिथिआ रंग संगि माइआ पेखि हसता ॥
lines.e: False is the love of gathering wealth, and reveling in the sight of it.
False are deception, emotional attachment and egotistical pride.
False are pride and self-conceit.
Only devotional worship is permanent, and the Sanctuary of the Holy.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ॥੪॥
lines.r: naanak jap jap jeevai har ke charan ||4||
lines.ht: नानक जपि जपि जीवै हरि के चरन ॥४॥
lines.e: Nanak lives by meditating, meditating on the Lotus Feet of the Lord. ||4||
False are the ears which listen to the slander of others.

lines.g: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਹਸਤ ਪਰ ਦਰਬ ਕਉ ਹਿਰਹਿ ॥
lines.r: mithiaa hasat par dharab kau hireh ||
lines.ht: मिथिआ हसत पर दरब कउ हिरहि ॥
lines.e: False are the hands which steal the wealth of others.

lines.g: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਪੇਖਤ ਪਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਅ ਰੂਪਾਦ ॥
lines.r: mithiaa netr pekhat par tria roopaadh ||
lines.ht: मिथिआ नेत्र पेखत पर तृअ रूपाद ॥
lines.e: False are the eyes which gaze upon the beauty of another's wife.
False is the tongue which enjoys delicacies and external tastes.

lines.g: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਚਰਨ ਪਰ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਕਉ ਧਾਵਹਿ ॥
lines.r: mithiaa charan par bikaar kau dhaaveh ||
lines.ht: मिथिआ चरन पर बिकार कउ धावहि ॥
lines.e: False are the feet which run to do evil to others.
False is the mind which covets the wealth of others.
False is the body which does not do good to others.
False is the nose which inhales corruption.
Without understanding, everything is false.

lines.g: ਸਫਲ ਦੇਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਲਏ ॥੫॥
lines.r: safal dheh naanak har har naam le ||5||
lines.ht: सफल देह नानक हरि हरि नाम लए ॥५॥
lines.e: Fruitful is the body, O Nanak, which takes to the Lord's Name. ||5||
The life of the faithless cynic is totally useless.
Without the Truth, how can anyone be pure?
Useless is the body of the spiritually blind, without the Name of the Lord.
From his mouth, a foul smell issues forth.

lines.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਬਿਹਾਇ ॥
lines.r: bin simaran dhin rain birathaa bihai ||
lines.ht: बिनु सिमरन दिनु रैनि बृथा बिहाइ ॥
lines.e: Without the remembrance of the Lord, day and night pass in vain,
like the crop which withers without rain.

lines.g: ਗੋਬਿਦ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਬ੍ਰਿਥੇ ਸਭ ਕਾਮ ॥
lines.r: gobidh bhajan bin birathe sabh kaam ||
lines.ht: गोबिद भजन बिनु बृथे सभ काम ॥
lines.e: Without meditation on the Lord of the Universe, all works are in vain,
like the wealth of a miser, which lies useless.

lines.g: ਧੰਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਜਿਹ ਘਟਿ ਬਸਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.r: dha(n)n dha(n)n te jan jeh ghaT basio har naau ||
lines.ht: धंनि धंनि ते जन जिह घटि बसिओ हरि नाउ ॥
lines.e: Blessed, blessed are those, whose hearts are filled with the Name of the Lord.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੬॥
lines.r: naanak taa kai bal bal jaau ||6||
lines.ht: नानक ता कै बलि बलि जाउ ॥६॥
lines.e: Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to them. ||6||
He says one thing, and does something else.

lines.g: ਮਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਗੰਢ ਲਾਵਤ ॥
lines.r: man nahee preet mukhahu ga(n)dd laavat ||
lines.ht: मनि नही प्रीति मुखहु गंढ लावत ॥
lines.e: There is no love in his heart, and yet with his mouth he talks tall.
The Omniscient Lord God is the Knower of all.
He is not impressed by outward display.
One who does not practice what he preaches to others,
shall come and go in reincarnation, through birth and death.
One whose inner being is filled with the Formless Lord
by his teachings, the world is saved.

lines.g: ਜੋ ਤੁਮ ਭਾਨੇ ਤਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
lines.r: jo tum bhaane tin prabh jaataa ||
lines.ht: जो तुम भाने तिन प्रभु जाता ॥
lines.e: Those who are pleasing to You, God, know You.
Nanak falls at their feet. ||7||
Offer your prayers to the Supreme Lord God, who knows everything.
He Himself values His own creatures.
He Himself, by Himself, makes the decisions.

lines.g: ਕਿਸੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਜਨਾਵਤ ਕਿਸੈ ਬੁਝਾਵਤ ਨੇਰਾ ॥
lines.r: kisai dhoor janaavat kisai bujhaavat neraa ||
lines.ht: किसै दूरि जनावत किसै बुझावत नेरा ॥
lines.e: To some, He appears far away, while others perceive Him near at hand.
He is beyond all efforts and clever tricks.

lines.g: ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਆਤਮ ਕੀ ਰਹਤ ॥
lines.r: sabh kachh jaanai aatam kee rahat ||
lines.ht: सभु कछु जानै आतम की रहत ॥
lines.e: He knows all the ways and means of the soul.

lines.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਏ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.r: jis bhaavai tis le laR lai ||
lines.ht: जिसु भावै तिसु लए लड़ि लाइ ॥
lines.e: Those with whom He is pleased are attached to the hem of His robe.
He is pervading all places and interspaces.
Those upon whom He bestows His favor, become His servants.
Each and every moment, O Nanak, meditate on the Lord. ||8||5||
Shalok:

lines.g: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਅਰੁ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਅਹੰਮੇਵ ॥
lines.r: kaam karodh ar lobh moh binas jai aha(n)mev ||
lines.ht: काम क्रोध अरु लोभ मोह बिनसि जाइ अहंमेव ॥
lines.e: Sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment - may these be gone, and egotism as well.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੁ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥੧॥
lines.r: naanak prabh saranaagatee kar prasaadh gurdhev ||1||
lines.ht: नानक प्रभ सरणागती करि प्रसादु गुरदेव ॥१॥
lines.e: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God; please bless me with Your Grace, O Divine Guru. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
By His Grace, you partake of the thirty-six delicacies;

lines.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਉ ਰਖੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.r: tis Thaakur kau rakh man maeh ||
lines.ht: तिसु ठाकुर कउ रखु मन माहि ॥
lines.e: enshrine that Lord and Master within your mind.
By His Grace, you apply scented oils to your body;

lines.g: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
lines.r: tis kau simarat param gat paaveh ||
lines.ht: तिस कउ सिमरत परम गति पावहि ॥
lines.e: remembering Him, the supreme status is obtained.
By His Grace, you dwell in the palace of peace;
meditate forever on Him within your mind.

lines.g: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਖ ਬਸਨਾ ॥
lines.r: jeh prasaadh gireh sa(n)g sukh basanaa ||
lines.ht: जिह प्रसादि गृह संगि सुख बसना ॥
lines.e: By His Grace, you abide with your family in peace;
keep His remembrance upon your tongue, twenty-four hours a day.
By His Grace, you enjoy tastes and pleasures;
O Nanak, meditate forever on the One, who is worthy of meditation. ||1||
By His Grace, you wear silks and satins;
why abandon Him, to attach yourself to another?
By His Grace, you sleep in a cozy bed;

lines.g: ਮਨ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੀਜੈ ॥
lines.r: man aaTh pahar taa kaa jas gaaveejai ||
lines.ht: मन आठ पहर ता का जसु गावीजै ॥
lines.e: O my mind, sing His Praises, twenty-four hours a day.

lines.g: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤੁਝੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਊ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
lines.r: jeh prasaadh tujh sabh kouoo maanai ||
lines.ht: जिह प्रसादि तुझु सभु कोऊ मानै ॥
lines.e: By His Grace, you are honored by everyone;

lines.g: ਮੁਖਿ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਜਸੁ ਰਸਨ ਬਖਾਨੈ ॥
lines.r: mukh taa ko jas rasan bakhaanai ||
lines.ht: मुखि ता को जसु रसन बखानै ॥
lines.e: with your mouth and with your tongue, chant His Praises.
By His Grace, you remain in the Dharma;
O mind, meditate continually on the Supreme Lord God.

lines.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਜਪਤ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
lines.r: prabh jee japat dharageh maan paaveh ||
lines.ht: प्रभ जी जपत दरगह मानु पावहि ॥
lines.e: Meditating on God, you shall be honored in His Court;
O Nanak, you shall return to your true home with honor. ||2||
By His Grace, you have a healthy, golden body;
attune yourself to that Loving Lord.
By His Grace, your honor is preserved;

lines.g: ਮਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਹਤ ॥
lines.r: man sukh paaveh har har jas kahat ||
lines.ht: मन सुखु पावहि हरि हरि जसु कहत ॥
lines.e: O mind, chant the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, and find peace.

lines.g: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਢਾਕੇ ॥
lines.r: jeh prasaadh tere sagal chhidhr ddaake ||
lines.ht: जिह प्रसादि तेरे सगल छिद्र ढाके ॥
lines.e: By His Grace, all your deficits are covered;

lines.g: ਮਨ ਸਰਨੀ ਪਰੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥
lines.r: man saranee par Thaakur prabh taa kai ||
lines.ht: मन सरनी परु ठाकुर प्रभ ता कै ॥
lines.e: O mind, seek the Sanctuary of God, our Lord and Master.

lines.g: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤੁਝੁ ਕੋ ਨ ਪਹੂਚੈ ॥
lines.r: jeh prasaadh tujh ko na pahoochai ||
lines.ht: जिह प्रसादि तुझु को न पहूचै ॥
lines.e: By His Grace, no one can rival you;

lines.g: ਮਨ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਊਚੇ ॥
lines.r: man saas saas simarahu prabh uooche ||
lines.ht: मन सासि सासि सिमरहु प्रभ ऊचे ॥
lines.e: O mind, with each and every breath, remember God on High.
By His Grace, you obtained this precious human body;
O Nanak, worship Him with devotion. ||3||
By His Grace, you wear decorations;

lines.g: ਮਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਕਿਉ ਆਲਸੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
lines.r: man tis simarat kiau aalas keejai ||
lines.ht: मन तिसु सिमरत किउ आलसु कीजै ॥
lines.e: O mind, why are you so lazy? Why don't you remember Him in meditation?
By His Grace, you have horses and elephants to ride;

lines.g: ਮਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਬਿਸਾਰੀ ॥
lines.r: man tis prabh kau kabahoo na bisaaree ||
lines.ht: मन तिसु प्रभ कउ कबहू न बिसारी ॥
lines.e: O mind, never forget that God.
By His Grace, you have land, gardens and wealth;
keep God enshrined in your heart.
O mind, the One who formed your form
standing up and sitting down, meditate always on Him.
Meditate on Him - the One Invisible Lord;
here and hereafter, O Nanak, He shall save you. ||4||

lines.g: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੁੰਨ ਬਹੁ ਦਾਨ ॥
lines.r: jeh prasaadh kareh pu(n)n bahu dhaan ||
lines.ht: जिह प्रसादि करहि पुँन बहु दान ॥
lines.e: By His Grace, you give donations in abundance to charities;

lines.g: ਮਨ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਕਰਿ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਧਿਆਨ ॥
lines.r: man aaTh pahar kar tis kaa dhiaan ||
lines.ht: मन आठ पहर करि तिस का धिआन ॥
lines.e: O mind, meditate on Him, twenty-four hours a day.
By His Grace, you perform religious rituals and worldly duties;

lines.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਚਿਤਾਰੀ ॥
lines.r: tis prabh kau saas saas chitaaree ||
lines.ht: तिसु प्रभ कउ सासि सासि चितारी ॥
lines.e: think of God with each and every breath.
By His Grace, your form is so beautiful;
constantly remember God, the Incomparably Beautiful One.
By His Grace, you have such high social status;

lines.g: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
lines.r: so prabh simar sadhaa dhin raat ||
lines.ht: सो प्रभु सिमरि सदा दिन राति ॥
lines.e: remember God always, day and night.
By His Grace, your honor is preserved;
by Guru's Grace, O Nanak, chant His Praises. ||5||
By His Grace, you listen to the sound current of the Naad.
By His Grace, you behold amazing wonders.
By His Grace, you speak ambrosial words with your tongue.
By His Grace, you abide in peace and ease.
By His Grace, your hands move and work.
By His Grace, you are completely fulfilled.
By His Grace, you obtain the supreme status.
By His Grace, you are absorbed into celestial peace.

lines.g: ਐਸਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਅਵਰ ਕਤ ਲਾਗਹੁ ॥
lines.r: aaisaa prabh tiaag avar kat laagahu ||
lines.ht: ऐसा प्रभु तिआगि अवर कत लागहु ॥
lines.e: Why forsake God, and attach yourself to another?
By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, awaken your mind! ||6||
By His Grace, you are famous all over the world;

lines.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਮਨਹੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ॥
lines.r: tis prabh kau mool na manahu bisaar ||
lines.ht: तिसु प्रभ कउ मूलि न मनहु बिसारि ॥
lines.e: never forget God from your mind.
By His Grace, you have prestige;

lines.g: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੂੜ ਤੂ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਜਾਪੁ ॥
lines.r: re man mooR too taa kau jaap ||
lines.ht: रे मन मूड़ तू ता कउ जापु ॥
lines.e: O foolish mind, meditate on Him!
By His Grace, your works are completed;
O mind, know Him to be close at hand.
By His Grace, you find the Truth;

lines.g: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੂੰ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਚੁ ॥
lines.r: re man mere too(n) taa siau raach ||
lines.ht: रे मन मेरे तूँ ता सिउ राचु ॥
lines.e: O my mind, merge yourself into Him.

lines.g: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸਭ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.r: jeh prasaadh sabh kee gat hoi ||
lines.ht: जिह प्रसादि सभ की गति होइ ॥
lines.e: By His Grace, everyone is saved;
O Nanak, meditate, and chant His Chant. ||7||
Those, whom He inspires to chant, chant His Name.

lines.g: ਆਪਿ ਗਾਵਾਏ ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥
lines.r: aap gaavaae su har gun gaau ||
lines.ht: आपि गावाए सु हरि गुन गाउ ॥
lines.e: Those, whom He inspires to sing, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
By God's Grace, enlightenment comes.
By God's Kind Mercy, the heart-lotus blossoms forth.
When God is totally pleased, He comes to dwell in the mind.

lines.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਇਆ ਤੇ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.r: prabh dhiaa te mat uootam hoi ||
lines.ht: प्रभ दइआ ते मति ऊतम होइ ॥
lines.e: By God's Kind Mercy, the intellect is exalted.
All treasures, O Lord, come by Your Kind Mercy.
No one obtains anything by himself.

lines.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਥ ॥
lines.r: jit jit laavahu tit lageh har naath ||
lines.ht: जितु जितु लावहु तितु लगहि हरि नाथ ॥
lines.e: As You have delegated, so do we apply ourselves, O Lord and Master.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਨ ਕੈ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹਾਥ ॥੮॥੬॥
lines.r: naanak in kai kachhoo na haath ||8||6||
lines.ht: नानक इन कै कछू न हाथ ॥८॥६॥
lines.e: O Nanak, nothing is in our hands. ||8||6||
Shalok:
Unapproachable and Unfathomable is the Supreme Lord God;

lines.g: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਹੈ ਸੁ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.r: jo jo kahai su mukataa hoi ||
lines.ht: जो जो कहै सु मुकता होइ ॥
lines.e: whoever speaks of Him shall be liberated.

lines.g: ਸੁਨਿ ਮੀਤਾ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬਿਨਵੰਤਾ ॥ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਅਚਰਜ ਕਥਾ ॥੧॥
lines.r: sun meetaa naanak binava(n)taa || saadh janaa kee acharaj kathaa ||1||
lines.ht: सुनि मीता नानकु बिनवंता ॥ साध जना की अचरज कथा ॥१॥
lines.e: Listen, O friends, Nanak prays, to the wonderful story of the Holy. ||1||
Ashtapadee:

lines.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਹੋਤ ॥
lines.r: saadh kai sa(n)g mukh uoojal hot ||
lines.ht: साध कै संगि मुख ऊजल होत ॥
lines.e: In the Company of the Holy, one's face becomes radiant.
In the Company of the Holy, all filth is removed.
In the Company of the Holy, egotism is eliminated.
In the Company of the Holy, spiritual wisdom is revealed.

lines.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਬੁਝੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨੇਰਾ ॥
lines.r: saadh kai sa(n)g bujhai prabh neraa ||
lines.ht: साध कै संगि बुझै प्रभु नेरा ॥
lines.e: In the Company of the Holy, God is understood to be near at hand.
In the Company of the Holy, all conflicts are settled.

lines.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ॥
lines.r: saadh kai sa(n)g paae naam ratan ||
lines.ht: साध कै संगि पाए नाम रतनु ॥
lines.e: In the Company of the Holy, one obtains the jewel of the Naam.

lines.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਏਕ ਊਪਰਿ ਜਤਨੁ ॥
lines.r: saadh kai sa(n)g ek uoopar jatan ||
lines.ht: साध कै संगि एक ऊपरि जतनु ॥
lines.e: In the Company of the Holy, one's efforts are directed toward the One Lord.

lines.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਬਰਨੈ ਕਉਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ॥
lines.r: saadh kee mahimaa baranai kaun praanee ||
lines.ht: साध की महिमा बरनै कउनु प्रानी ॥
lines.e: What mortal can speak of the Glorious Praises of the Holy?

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
lines.r: naanak saadh kee sobhaa prabh maeh samaanee ||1||
lines.ht: नानक साध की सोभा प्रभ माहि समानी ॥१॥
lines.e: O Nanak, the glory of the Holy people merges into God. ||1||
In the Company of the Holy, one meets the Incomprehensible Lord.
In the Company of the Holy, one flourishes forever.

lines.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਬਸਿ ਪੰਚਾ ॥
lines.r: saadh kai sa(n)g aaveh bas pa(n)chaa ||
lines.ht: साध कै संगि आवहि बसि पंचा ॥
lines.e: In the Company of the Holy, the five passions are brought to rest.
In the Company of the Holy, one enjoys the essence of ambrosia.
In the Company of the Holy, one becomes the dust of all.
In the Company of the Holy, one's speech is enticing.

lines.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
lines.r: saadh kai sa(n)g na katahoo(n) dhaavai ||
lines.ht: साध कै संगि न कतहूँ धावै ॥
lines.e: In the Company of the Holy, the mind does not wander.
In the Company of the Holy, the mind becomes stable.

lines.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਭਿੰਨ ॥
lines.r: saadh kai sa(n)g maiaa te bhi(n)n ||
lines.ht: साध कै संगि माइआ ते भिंन ॥
lines.e: In the Company of the Holy, one is rid of Maya.
In the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, God is totally pleased. ||2||
In the Company of the Holy, all one's enemies become friends.
In the Company of the Holy, there is great purity.
In the Company of the Holy, no one is hated.

lines.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਬੀਗਾ ਪੈਰੁ ॥
lines.r: saadh kai sa(n)g na beegaa pair ||
lines.ht: साध कै संगि न बीगा पैरु ॥
lines.e: In the Company of the Holy, one's feet do not wander.

lines.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਮੰਦਾ ॥
lines.r: saadh kai sa(n)g naahee ko ma(n)dhaa ||
lines.ht: साध कै संगि नाही को मंदा ॥
lines.e: In the Company of the Holy, no one seems evil.
In the Company of the Holy, supreme bliss is known.

lines.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਉ ਤਾਪੁ ॥
lines.r: saadh kai sa(n)g naahee hau taap ||
lines.ht: साध कै संगि नाही हउ तापु ॥
lines.e: In the Company of the Holy, the fever of ego departs.

lines.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਜੈ ਸਭੁ ਆਪੁ ॥
lines.r: saadh kai sa(n)g tajai sabh aap ||
lines.ht: साध कै संगि तजै सभु आपु ॥
lines.e: In the Company of the Holy, one renounces all selfishness.
He Himself knows the greatness of the Holy.
O Nanak, the Holy are at one with God. ||3||

lines.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
lines.r: saadh kai sa(n)g na kabahoo dhaavai ||
lines.ht: साध कै संगि न कबहू धावै ॥
lines.e: In the Company of the Holy, the mind never wanders.

lines.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.r: saadh kai sa(n)g sadhaa sukh paavai ||
lines.ht: साध कै संगि सदा सुखु पावै ॥
lines.e: In the Company of the Holy, one obtains everlasting peace.
In the Company of the Holy, one grasps the Incomprehensible.
In the Company of the Holy, one can endure the unendurable.

lines.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸੈ ਥਾਨਿ ਊਚੈ ॥
lines.r: saadh kai sa(n)g basai thaan uoochai ||
lines.ht: साध कै संगि बसै थानि ऊचै ॥
lines.e: In the Company of the Holy, one abides in the loftiest place.
In the Company of the Holy, one attains the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

lines.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੈ ਸਭਿ ਧਰਮ ॥
lines.r: saadh kai sa(n)g dhiraRai sabh dharam ||
lines.ht: साध कै संगि दृड़ै सभि धरम ॥
lines.e: In the Company of the Holy, one's Dharmic faith is firmly established.
In the Company of the Holy, one dwells with the Supreme Lord God.

lines.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
lines.r: saadh kai sa(n)g paae naam nidhaan ||
lines.ht: साध कै संगि पाए नाम निधान ॥
lines.e: In the Company of the Holy, one obtains the treasure of the Naam.
O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Holy. ||4||

lines.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਭ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰੈ ॥
lines.r: saadh kai sa(n)g sabh kul udhaarai ||
lines.ht: साध कै संगि सभ कुल उधारै ॥
lines.e: In the Company of the Holy, all one's family is saved.
In the Company of the Holy, one's friends, acquaintances and relatives are redeemed.

lines.g: ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.r: saadhoo kai sa(n)g so dhan paavai ||
lines.ht: साधू कै संगि सो धनु पावै ॥
lines.e: In the Company of the Holy, that wealth is obtained.

lines.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਧਨ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਵਰਸਾਵੈ ॥
lines.r: jis dhan te sabh ko varasaavai ||
lines.ht: जिसु धन ते सभु को वरसावै ॥
lines.e: Everyone benefits from that wealth.
In the Company of the Holy, the Lord of Dharma serves.
In the Company of the Holy, the divine, angelic beings sing God's Praises.
In the Company of the Holy, one's sins fly away.
In the Company of the Holy, one sings the Ambrosial Glories.

lines.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਥਾਨ ਗੰਮਿ ॥
lines.r: saadh kai sa(n)g srab thaan ga(n)m ||
lines.ht: साध कै संगि स्रब थान गंमि ॥
lines.e: In the Company of the Holy, all places are within reach.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਫਲ ਜਨੰਮ ॥੫॥
lines.r: naanak saadh kai sa(n)g safal jana(n)m ||5||
lines.ht: नानक साध कै संगि सफल जनंम ॥५॥
lines.e: O Nanak, in the Company of the Holy, one's life becomes fruitful. ||5||

lines.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਘਾਲ ॥
lines.r: saadh kai sa(n)g nahee kachh ghaal ||
lines.ht: साध कै संगि नही कछु घाल ॥
lines.e: In the Company of the Holy, there is no suffering.
The Blessed Vision of their Darshan brings a sublime, happy peace.
In the Company of the Holy, blemishes are removed.
In the Company of the Holy, hell is far away.

lines.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
lines.r: saadh kai sa(n)g ieehaa uoohaa suhelaa ||
lines.ht: साध कै संगि ईहा ऊहा सुहेला ॥
lines.e: In the Company of the Holy, one is happy here and hereafter.
In the Company of the Holy, the separated ones are reunited with the Lord.
The fruits of one's desires are obtained.

lines.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
lines.r: saadh kai sa(n)g na birathaa jaavai ||
lines.ht: साध कै संगि न बिरथा जावै ॥
lines.e: In the Company of the Holy, no one goes empty-handed.
The Supreme Lord God dwells in the hearts of the Holy.
O Nanak, listening to the sweet words of the Holy, one is saved. ||6||

lines.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਨਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.r: saadh kai sa(n)g sunau har naau ||
lines.ht: साध कै संगि सुनउ हरि नाउ ॥
lines.e: In the Company of the Holy, listen to the Name of the Lord.
In the Company of the Holy, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

lines.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਬਿਸਰੈ ॥
lines.r: saadh kai sa(n)g na man te bisarai ||
lines.ht: साध कै संगि न मन ते बिसरै ॥
lines.e: In the Company of the Holy, do not forget Him from your mind.
In the Company of the Holy, you shall surely be saved.

lines.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਗੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
lines.r: saadh kai sa(n)g lagai prabh meeThaa ||
lines.ht: साध कै संगि लगै प्रभु मीठा ॥
lines.e: In the Company of the Holy, God seems very sweet.

lines.g: ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਡੀਠਾ ॥
lines.r: saadhoo kai sa(n)g ghaT ghaT ddeeThaa ||
lines.ht: साधू कै संगि घटि घटि डीठा ॥
lines.e: In the Company of the Holy, He is seen in each and every heart.
In the Company of the Holy, we become obedient to the Lord.
In the Company of the Holy, we obtain the state of salvation.

lines.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਟੇ ਸਭਿ ਰੋਗ ॥
lines.r: saadh kai sa(n)g miTe sabh rog ||
lines.ht: साध कै संगि मिटे सभि रोग ॥
lines.e: In the Company of the Holy, all diseases are cured.
O Nanak, one meets with the Holy, by highest destiny. ||7||

lines.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਬੇਦ ਨ ਜਾਨਹਿ ॥
lines.r: saadh kee mahimaa bedh na jaaneh ||
lines.ht: साध की महिमा बेद न जानहि ॥
lines.e: The glory of the Holy people is not known to the Vedas.
They can describe only what they have heard.

lines.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਤਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
lines.r: saadh kee upamaa tih gun te dhoor ||
lines.ht: साध की उपमा तिहु गुण ते दूरि ॥
lines.e: The greatness of the Holy people is beyond the three qualities.
The greatness of the Holy people is all-pervading.

lines.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਅੰਤ ॥
lines.r: saadh kee sobhaa kaa naahee a(n)t ||
lines.ht: साध की सोभा का नाही अंत ॥
lines.e: The glory of the Holy people has no limit.
The glory of the Holy people is infinite and eternal.

lines.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਊਚ ਤੇ ਊਚੀ ॥
lines.r: saadh kee sobhaa uooch te uoochee ||
lines.ht: साध की सोभा ऊच ते ऊची ॥
lines.e: The glory of the Holy people is the highest of the high.

lines.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਮੂਚ ਤੇ ਮੂਚੀ ॥
lines.r: saadh kee sobhaa mooch te moochee ||
lines.ht: साध की सोभा मूच ते मूची ॥
lines.e: The glory of the Holy people is the greatest of the great.

lines.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਸਾਧ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
lines.r: saadh kee sobhaa saadh ban aaiee ||
lines.ht: साध की सोभा साध बनि आई ॥
lines.e: The glory of the Holy people is theirs alone;

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥੮॥੭॥
lines.r: naanak saadh prabh bhedh na bhaiee ||8||7||
lines.ht: नानक साध प्रभ भेदु न भाई ॥८॥७॥
lines.e: O Nanak, there is no difference between the Holy people and God. ||8||7||
Shalok:
The True One is on his mind, and the True One is upon his lips.

lines.g: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਪੇਖੈ ਏਕਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.r: avar na pekhai ekas bin koi ||
lines.ht: अवरु न पेखै एकसु बिनु कोइ ॥
lines.e: He sees only the One.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹ ਲਛਣ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.r: naanak ieh lachhan braham giaanee hoi ||1||
lines.ht: नानक इह लछण ब्रहम गिआनी होइ ॥१॥
lines.e: O Nanak, these are the qualities of the God-conscious being. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
The God-conscious being is always unattached,
as the lotus in the water remains detached.
The God-conscious being is always unstained,
like the sun, which gives its comfort and warmth to all.
The God-conscious being looks upon all alike,

lines.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਰਾਜ ਰੰਕ ਕਉ ਲਾਗੈ ਤੁਲਿ ਪਵਾਨ ॥
lines.r: jaise raaj ra(n)k kau laagai tul pavaan ||
lines.ht: जैसे राज रंक कउ लागै तुलि पवान ॥
lines.e: like the wind, which blows equally upon the king and the poor beggar.
The God-conscious being has a steady patience,

lines.g: ਜਿਉ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਕੋਊ ਖੋਦੈ ਕੋਊ ਚੰਦਨ ਲੇਪ ॥
lines.r: jiau basudhaa kouoo khodhai kouoo cha(n)dhan lep ||
lines.ht: जिउ बसुधा कोऊ खोदै कोऊ चंदन लेप ॥
lines.e: like the earth, which is dug up by one, and anointed with sandal paste by another.
This is the quality of the God-conscious being:

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਉ ਪਾਵਕ ਕਾ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਉ ॥੧॥
lines.r: naanak jiau paavak kaa sahaj subhaau ||1||
lines.ht: नानक जिउ पावक का सहज सुभाउ ॥१॥
lines.e: O Nanak, his inherent nature is like a warming fire. ||1||
The God-conscious being is the purest of the pure;
filth does not stick to water.

lines.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
lines.r: braham giaanee kai man hoi pragaas ||
lines.ht: ब्रहम गिआनी कै मनि होइ प्रगासु ॥
lines.e: The God-conscious being's mind is enlightened,
like the sky above the earth.

lines.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਮਾਨਿ ॥
lines.r: braham giaanee kai mitr satr samaan ||
lines.ht: ब्रहम गिआनी कै मित्र सत्रु समानि ॥
lines.e: To the God-conscious being, friend and foe are the same.
The God-conscious being has no egotistical pride.
The God-conscious being is the highest of the high.

lines.g: ਮਨਿ ਅਪਨੈ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਨੀਚਾ ॥
lines.r: man apanai hai sabh te neechaa ||
lines.ht: मनि अपनै है सभ ते नीचा ॥
lines.e: Within his own mind, he is the most humble of all.
They alone become God-conscious beings,
O Nanak, whom God Himself makes so. ||2||
The God-conscious being is the dust of all.
The God-conscious being knows the nature of the soul.

lines.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਮਇਆ ॥
lines.r: braham giaanee kee sabh uoopar miaa ||
lines.ht: ब्रहम गिआनी की सभ ऊपरि मइआ ॥
lines.e: The God-conscious being shows kindness to all.

lines.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਤੇ ਕਛੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਭਇਆ ॥
lines.r: braham giaanee te kachh buraa na bhiaa ||
lines.ht: ब्रहम गिआनी ते कछु बुरा न भइआ ॥
lines.e: No evil comes from the God-conscious being.
The God-conscious being is always impartial.

lines.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬਰਸੀ ॥
lines.r: braham giaanee kee dhirasaT a(n)mrit barasee ||
lines.ht: ब्रहम गिआनी की दृसटि अंमृतु बरसी ॥
lines.e: Nectar rains down from the glance of the God-conscious being.
The God-conscious being is free from entanglements.
The lifestyle of the God-conscious being is spotlessly pure.
Spiritual wisdom is the food of the God-conscious being.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੩॥
lines.r: naanak braham giaanee kaa braham dhiaan ||3||
lines.ht: नानक ब्रहम गिआनी का ब्रहम धिआनु ॥३॥
lines.e: O Nanak, the God-conscious being is absorbed in God's meditation. ||3||
The God-conscious being centers his hopes on the One alone.
The God-conscious being shall never perish.
The God-conscious being is steeped in humility.
The God-conscious being delights in doing good to others.
The God-conscious being has no worldly entanglements.
The God-conscious being holds his wandering mind under control.

lines.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਭਲਾ ॥
lines.r: braham giaanee kai hoi su bhalaa ||
lines.ht: ब्रहम गिआनी कै होइ सु भला ॥
lines.e: The God-conscious being acts in the common good.
The God-conscious being blossoms in fruitfulness.
In the Company of the God-conscious being, all are saved.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਪੈ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
lines.r: naanak braham giaanee japai sagal sa(n)saar ||4||
lines.ht: नानक ब्रहम गिआनी जपै सगल संसारु ॥४॥
lines.e: O Nanak, through the God-conscious being, the whole world meditates on God. ||4||
The God-conscious being loves the One Lord alone.

lines.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਬਸੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੰਗ ॥
lines.r: braham giaanee kai basai prabh sa(n)g ||
lines.ht: ब्रहम गिआनी कै बसै प्रभु संग ॥
lines.e: The God-conscious being dwells with God.
The God-conscious being takes the Naam as his Support.
The God-conscious being has the Naam as his Family.
The God-conscious being is awake and aware, forever and ever.
The God-conscious being renounces his proud ego.
In the mind of the God-conscious being, there is supreme bliss.

lines.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
lines.r: braham giaanee kai ghar sadhaa ana(n)dh ||
lines.ht: ब्रहम गिआनी कै घरि सदा अनंद ॥
lines.e: In the home of the God-conscious being, there is everlasting bliss.
The God-conscious being dwells in peaceful ease.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਨਾਸ ॥੫॥
lines.r: naanak braham giaanee kaa nahee binaas ||5||
lines.ht: नानक ब्रहम गिआनी का नही बिनास ॥५॥
lines.e: O Nanak, the God-conscious being shall never perish. ||5||
The God-conscious being knows God.
The God-conscious being is in love with the One alone.
The God-conscious being is carefree.
Pure are the Teachings of the God-conscious being.

lines.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
lines.r: braham giaanee jis karai prabh aap ||
lines.ht: ब्रहम गिआनी जिसु करै प्रभु आपि ॥
lines.e: The God-conscious being is made so by God Himself.
The God-conscious being is gloriously great.

lines.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.r: braham giaanee kaa dharas baddabhaagee paieeaai ||
lines.ht: ब्रहम गिआनी का दरसु बडभागी पाईऐ ॥
lines.e: The Darshan, the Blessed Vision of the God-conscious being, is obtained by great good fortune.

lines.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
lines.r: braham giaanee kau bal bal jaieeaai ||
lines.ht: ब्रहम गिआनी कउ बलि बलि जाईऐ ॥
lines.e: To the God-conscious being, I make my life a sacrifice.
The God-conscious being is sought by the great god Shiva.
O Nanak, the God-conscious being is Himself the Supreme Lord God. ||6||
The God-conscious being cannot be appraised.

lines.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਸਗਲ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.r: braham giaanee kai sagal man maeh ||
lines.ht: ब्रहम गिआनी कै सगल मन माहि ॥
lines.e: The God-conscious being has all within his mind.

lines.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਕਉਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਭੇਦੁ ॥
lines.r: braham giaanee kaa kaun jaanai bhedh ||
lines.ht: ब्रहम गिआनी का कउन जानै भेदु ॥
lines.e: Who can know the mystery of the God-conscious being?
Forever bow to the God-conscious being.

lines.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਕਥਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਅਧਾਖੵਰੁ ॥
lines.r: braham giaanee kaa kathiaa na jai adhaakhayer ||
lines.ht: ब्रहम गिआनी का कथिआ न जाइ अधाख्यरु ॥
lines.e: The God-conscious being cannot be described in words.
The God-conscious being is the Lord and Master of all.

lines.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੀ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਉਨੁ ਬਖਾਨੈ ॥
lines.r: braham giaanee kee mit kaun bakhaanai ||
lines.ht: ब्रहम गिआनी की मिति कउनु बखानै ॥
lines.e: Who can describe the limits of the God-conscious being?

lines.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
lines.r: braham giaanee kee gat braham giaanee jaanai ||
lines.ht: ब्रहम गिआनी की गति ब्रहम गिआनी जानै ॥
lines.e: Only the God-conscious being can know the state of the God-conscious being.

lines.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.r: braham giaanee kaa a(n)t na paar ||
lines.ht: ब्रहम गिआनी का अंतु न पारु ॥
lines.e: The God-conscious being has no end or limitation.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
lines.r: naanak braham giaanee kau sadhaa namasakaar ||7||
lines.ht: नानक ब्रहम गिआनी कउ सदा नमसकारु ॥७॥
lines.e: O Nanak, to the God-conscious being, bow forever in reverence. ||7||

lines.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਾ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
lines.r: braham giaanee sabh sirasaT kaa karataa ||
lines.ht: ब्रहम गिआनी सभ सृसटि का करता ॥
lines.e: The God-conscious being is the Creator of all the world.

lines.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸਦ ਜੀਵੈ ਨਹੀ ਮਰਤਾ ॥
lines.r: braham giaanee sadh jeevai nahee marataa ||
lines.ht: ब्रहम गिआनी सद जीवै नही मरता ॥
lines.e: The God-conscious being lives forever, and does not die.

lines.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
lines.r: braham giaanee mukat jugat jeea kaa dhaataa ||
lines.ht: ब्रहम गिआनी मुकति जुगति जीअ का दाता ॥
lines.e: The God-conscious being is the Giver of the way of liberation of the soul.
The God-conscious being is the Perfect Supreme Being, who orchestrates all.
The God-conscious being is the helper of the helpless.

lines.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਹਾਥੁ ॥
lines.r: braham giaanee kaa sabh uoopar haath ||
lines.ht: ब्रहम गिआनी का सभ ऊपरि हाथु ॥
lines.e: The God-conscious being extends his hand to all.
The God-conscious being owns the entire creation.
The God-conscious being is himself the Formless Lord.

lines.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਬਨੀ ॥
lines.r: braham giaanee kee sobhaa braham giaanee banee ||
lines.ht: ब्रहम गिआनी की सोभा ब्रहम गिआनी बनी ॥
lines.e: The glory of the God-conscious being belongs to the God-conscious being alone.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸਰਬ ਕਾ ਧਨੀ ॥੮॥੮॥
lines.r: naanak braham giaanee sarab kaa dhanee ||8||8||
lines.ht: नानक ब्रहम गिआनी सरब का धनी ॥८॥८॥
lines.e: O Nanak, the God-conscious being is the Lord of all. ||8||8||
Shalok:
One who enshrines the Naam within the heart,
who sees the Lord God in all,
who, each and every moment, bows in reverence to the Lord Master
- O Nanak, such a one is the true 'touch-nothing Saint', who emancipates everyone. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
One whose tongue does not touch falsehood;
whose mind is filled with love for the Blessed Vision of the Pure Lord,

lines.g: ਪਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਅ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਪੇਖੈ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ॥
lines.r: par tria roop na pekhai netr ||
lines.ht: पर तृअ रूपु न पेखै नेत्र ॥
lines.e: whose eyes do not gaze upon the beauty of others' wives,
who serves the Holy and loves the Saints' Congregation,

lines.g: ਕਰਨ ਨ ਸੁਨੈ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ॥
lines.r: karan na sunai kaahoo kee ni(n)dhaa ||
lines.ht: करन न सुनै काहू की निंदा ॥
lines.e: whose ears do not listen to slander against anyone,

lines.g: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਜਾਨੈ ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਮੰਦਾ ॥
lines.r: sabh te jaanai aapas kau ma(n)dhaa ||
lines.ht: सभ ते जानै आपस कउ मंदा ॥
lines.e: who deems himself to be the worst of all,
who, by Guru's Grace, renounces corruption,

lines.g: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਟਰੈ ॥
lines.r: man kee baasanaa man te Tarai ||
lines.ht: मन की बासना मन ते टरै ॥
lines.e: who banishes the mind's evil desires from his mind,

lines.g: ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਜਿਤ ਪੰਚ ਦੋਖ ਤੇ ਰਹਤ ॥
lines.r: ei(n)dhree jit pa(n)ch dhokh te rahat ||
lines.ht: इंद्री जित पंच दोख ते रहत ॥
lines.e: who conquers his sexual instincts and is free of the five sinful passions

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਕੋ ਐਸਾ ਅਪਰਸ ॥੧॥
lines.r: naanak koT madhe ko aaisaa aparas ||1||
lines.ht: नानक कोटि मधे को ऐसा अपरस ॥१॥
lines.e: - O Nanak, among millions, there is scarcely one such 'touch-nothing Saint'. ||1||
The true Vaishnaav, the devotee of Vishnu, is the one with whom God is thoroughly pleased.

lines.g: ਬਿਸਨ ਕੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਭਿੰਨ ॥
lines.r: bisan kee maiaa te hoi bhi(n)n ||
lines.ht: बिसन की माइआ ते होइ भिंन ॥
lines.e: He dwells apart from Maya.
Performing good deeds, he does not seek rewards.
Spotlessly pure is the religion of such a Vaishnaav;

lines.g: ਕਾਹੂ ਫਲ ਕੀ ਇਛਾ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਛੈ ॥
lines.r: kaahoo fal kee ichhaa nahee baachhai ||
lines.ht: काहू फल की इछा नही बाछै ॥
lines.e: he has no desire for the fruits of his labors.
He is absorbed in devotional worship and the singing of Kirtan, the songs of the Lord's Glory.
Within his mind and body, he meditates in remembrance on the Lord of the Universe.
He is kind to all creatures.
He holds fast to the Naam, and inspires others to chant it.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਓਹੁ ਬੈਸਨੋ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
lines.r: naanak oh baisano param gat paavai ||2||
lines.ht: नानक ओहु बैसनो परम गति पावै ॥२॥
lines.e: O Nanak, such a Vaishnaav obtains the supreme status. ||2||
The true Bhagaautee, the devotee of Adi Shakti, loves the devotional worship of God.
He forsakes the company of all wicked people.
All doubts are removed from his mind.
He performs devotional service to the Supreme Lord God in all.
In the Company of the Holy, the filth of sin is washed away.

lines.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਭਗਉਤੀ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
lines.r: tis bhagautee kee mat uootam hovai ||
lines.ht: तिसु भगउती की मति ऊतम होवै ॥
lines.e: The wisdom of such a Bhagaautee becomes supreme.

lines.g: ਭਗਵੰਤ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਕਰੈ ਨਿਤ ਨੀਤਿ ॥
lines.r: bhagava(n)t kee Tahal karai nit neet ||
lines.ht: भगवंत की टहल करै नित नीति ॥
lines.e: He constantly performs the service of the Supreme Lord God.
He dedicates his mind and body to the Love of God.
The Lotus Feet of the Lord abide in his heart.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਐਸਾ ਭਗਉਤੀ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਕਉ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
lines.r: naanak aaisaa bhagautee bhagava(n)t kau paavai ||3||
lines.ht: नानक ऐसा भगउती भगवंत कउ पावै ॥३॥
lines.e: O Nanak, such a Bhagaautee attains the Lord God. ||3||
He is a true Pandit, a religious scholar, who instructs his own mind.
He searches for the Lord's Name within his own soul.
He drinks in the Exquisite Nectar of the Lord's Name.

lines.g: ਉਸੁ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਕੈ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਜਗੁ ਜੀਵੈ ॥
lines.r: aus pa(n)ddit kai upadhes jag jeevai ||
lines.ht: उसु पंडित कै उपदेसि जगु जीवै ॥
lines.e: By that Pandit's teachings, the world lives.
He implants the Sermon of the Lord in his heart.

lines.g: ਸੋ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
lines.r: so pa(n)ddit fir jon na aavai ||
lines.ht: सो पंडितु फिरि जोनि न आवै ॥
lines.e: Such a Pandit is not cast into the womb of reincarnation again.
He understands the fundamental essence of the Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees.
In the unmanifest, he sees the manifest world to exist.
He gives instruction to people of all castes and social classes.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਸੁ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਅਦੇਸੁ ॥੪॥
lines.r: naanak us pa(n)ddit kau sadhaa adhes ||4||
lines.ht: नानक उसु पंडित कउ सदा अदेसु ॥४॥
lines.e: O Nanak, to such a Pandit, I bow in salutation forever. ||4||
The Beej Mantra, the Seed Mantra, is spiritual wisdom for everyone.

lines.g: ਚਹੁ ਵਰਨਾ ਮਹਿ ਜਪੈ ਕੋਊ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
lines.r: chahu varanaa meh japai kouoo naam ||
lines.ht: चहु वरना महि जपै कोऊ नामु ॥
lines.e: Anyone, from any class, may chant the Naam.

lines.g: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਜਪੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.r: jo jo japai tis kee gat hoi ||
lines.ht: जो जो जपै तिस की गति होइ ॥
lines.e: Whoever chants it, is emancipated.
And yet, rare are those who attain it, in the Company of the Holy.
By His Grace, He enshrines it within.

lines.g: ਪਸੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਮੁਘਦ ਪਾਥਰ ਕਉ ਤਾਰੈ ॥
lines.r: pas pret mughadh paathar kau taarai ||
lines.ht: पसु प्रेत मुघद पाथर कउ तारै ॥
lines.e: Even beasts, ghosts and the stone-hearted are saved.
The Naam is the panacea, the remedy to cure all ills.
Singing the Glory of God is the embodiment of bliss and emancipation.

lines.g: ਕਾਹੂ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਧਰਮਿ ॥
lines.r: kaahoo jugat kitai na paieeaai dharam ||
lines.ht: काहू जुगति कितै न पाईऐ धरमि ॥
lines.e: It cannot be obtained by any religious rituals.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਮਿ ॥੫॥
lines.r: naanak tis milai jis likhiaa dhur karam ||5||
lines.ht: नानक तिसु मिलै जिसु लिखिआ धुरि करमि ॥५॥
lines.e: O Nanak, he alone obtains it, whose karma is so pre-ordained. ||5||

lines.g: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਾ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
lines.r: jis kai man paarabraham kaa nivaas ||
lines.ht: जिस कै मनि पारब्रहम का निवासु ॥
lines.e: One whose mind is a home for the Supreme Lord God
- his name is truly Ram Das, the Lord's servant.
He comes to have the Vision of the Lord, the Supreme Soul.
Deeming himself to be the slave of the Lord's slaves, he obtains it.
He knows the Lord to be Ever-present, close at hand.
Such a servant is honored in the Court of the Lord.

lines.g: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਆਪਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
lines.r: apune dhaas kau aap kirapaa karai ||
lines.ht: अपुने दास कउ आपि किरपा करै ॥
lines.e: To His servant, He Himself shows His Mercy.

lines.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਸਭ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਰੈ ॥
lines.r: tis dhaas kau sabh sojhee parai ||
lines.ht: तिसु दास कउ सभ सोझी परै ॥
lines.e: Such a servant understands everything.
Amidst all, his soul is unattached.
Such is the way, O Nanak, of the Lord's servant. ||6||
One who, in his soul, loves the Will of God,
is said to be Jivan Mukta - liberated while yet alive.
As is joy, so is sorrow to him.
He is in eternal bliss, and is not separated from God.
As is gold, so is dust to him.
As is ambrosial nectar, so is bitter poison to him.
As is honor, so is dishonor.
As is the beggar, so is the king.
Whatever God ordains, that is his way.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਓਹੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ॥੭॥
lines.r: naanak oh purakh kaheeaai jeevan mukat ||7||
lines.ht: नानक ओहु पुरखु कहीऐ जीवन मुकति ॥७॥
lines.e: O Nanak, that being is known as Jivan Mukta. ||7||
All places belong to the Supreme Lord God.

lines.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਤੈਸਾ ਤਿਨ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.r: jit jit ghar raakhai taisaa tin naau ||
lines.ht: जितु जितु घरि राखै तैसा तिन नाउ ॥
lines.e: According to the homes in which they are placed, so are His creatures named.
He Himself is the Doer, the Cause of causes.
Whatever pleases God, ultimately comes to pass.
He Himself is All-pervading, in endless waves.

lines.g: ਲਖੇ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੇ ਰੰਗ ॥
lines.r: lakhe na jaeh paarabraham ke ra(n)g ||
lines.ht: लखे न जाहि पारब्रहम के रंग ॥
lines.e: The playful sport of the Supreme Lord God cannot be known.
As the understanding is given, so is one enlightened.
The Supreme Lord God, the Creator, is eternal and everlasting.
Forever, forever and ever, He is merciful.
Remembering Him, remembering Him in meditation, O Nanak, one is blessed with ecstasy. ||8||9||
Shalok:

lines.g: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਨੇਕ ਜਨ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ ॥
lines.r: ausatat kareh anek jan a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
lines.ht: उसतति करहि अनेक जन अंतु न पारावार ॥
