lines.e: Many people praise the Lord. He has no end or limitation.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਚਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਚੀ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.r: naanak rachanaa prabh rachee bahu bidh anik prakaar ||1||
lines.ht: नानक रचना प्रभि रची बहु बिधि अनिक प्रकार ॥१॥
lines.e: O Nanak, God created the creation, with its many ways and various species. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
Many millions are His devotees.
Many millions perform religious rituals and worldly duties.
Many millions become dwellers at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
Many millions wander as renunciates in the wilderness.
Many millions listen to the Vedas.
Many millions become austere penitents.
Many millions enshrine meditation within their souls.
Many millions of poets contemplate Him through poetry.
Many millions meditate on His eternally new Naam.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥
lines.r: naanak karate kaa a(n)t na paaveh ||1||
lines.ht: नानक करते का अंतु न पावहि ॥१॥
lines.e: O Nanak, none can find the limits of the Creator. ||1||
Many millions become self-centered.
Many millions are blinded by ignorance.
Many millions are stone-hearted misers.
Many millions are heartless, with dry, withered souls.

lines.g: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰ ਦਰਬ ਕਉ ਹਿਰਹਿ ॥
lines.r: kiee koT par dharab kau hireh ||
lines.ht: कई कोटि पर दरब कउ हिरहि ॥
lines.e: Many millions steal the wealth of others.
Many millions slander others.
Many millions struggle in Maya.
Many millions wander in foreign lands.

lines.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਨਾ ॥
lines.r: jit jit laavahu tit tit laganaa ||
lines.ht: जितु जितु लावहु तितु तितु लगना ॥
lines.e: Whatever God attaches them to - with that they are engaged.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀ ਜਾਨੈ ਕਰਤਾ ਰਚਨਾ ॥੨॥
lines.r: naanak karate kee jaanai karataa rachanaa ||2||
lines.ht: नानक करते की जानै करता रचना ॥२॥
lines.e: O Nanak, the Creator alone knows the workings of His creation. ||2||
Many millions are Siddhas, celibates and Yogis.
Many millions are kings, enjoying worldly pleasures.
Many millions of birds and snakes have been created.
Many millions of stones and trees have been produced.
Many millions are the winds, waters and fires.
Many millions are the countries and realms of the world.
Many millions are the moons, suns and stars.

lines.g: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਦੇਵ ਦਾਨਵ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਤ੍ਰ ॥
lines.r: kiee koT dhev dhaanav i(n)dhr sir chhatr ||
lines.ht: कई कोटि देव दानव इंद्र सिरि छत्र ॥
lines.e: Many millions are the demi-gods, demons and Indras, under their regal canopies.
He has strung the entire creation upon His thread.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੈ ॥੩॥
lines.r: naanak jis jis bhaavai tis tis nisataarai ||3||
lines.ht: नानक जिसु जिसु भावै तिसु तिसु निसतारै ॥३॥
lines.e: O Nanak, He emancipates those with whom He is pleased. ||3||
Many millions abide in heated activity, slothful darkness and peaceful light.

lines.g: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਅਰੁ ਸਾਸਤ ॥
lines.r: kiee koT bedh puraan simirat ar saasat ||
lines.ht: कई कोटि बेद पुरान सिमृति अरु सासत ॥
lines.e: Many millions are the Vedas, Puraanas, Simritees and Shaastras.
Many millions are the pearls of the oceans.
Many millions are the beings of so many descriptions.
Many millions are made long-lived.

lines.g: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਗਿਰੀ ਮੇਰ ਸੁਵਰਨ ਥੀਵੇ ॥
lines.r: kiee koT giree mer suvaran theeve ||
lines.ht: कई कोटि गिरी मेर सुवरन थीवे ॥
lines.e: Many millions of hills and mountains have been made of gold.
Many millions are the Yakhshas - the servants of the god of wealth, the Kinnars - the gods of celestial music, and the evil spirits of the Pisaach.

lines.g: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਭੂਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਸੂਕਰ ਮ੍ਰਿਗਾਚ ॥
lines.r: kiee koT bhoot pret sookar miragaach ||
lines.ht: कई कोटि भूत प्रेत सूकर मृगाच ॥
lines.e: Many millions are the evil nature-spirits, ghosts, pigs and tigers.

lines.g: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਨੇਰੈ ਸਭਹੂ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
lines.r: sabh te nerai sabhahoo te dhoor ||
lines.ht: सभ ते नेरै सभहू ते दूरि ॥
lines.e: He is near to all, and yet far from all;
O Nanak, He Himself remains distinct, while yet pervading all. ||4||
Many millions inhabit the nether regions.
Many millions dwell in heaven and hell.
Many millions are born, live and die.
Many millions are reincarnated, over and over again.
Many millions eat while sitting at ease.
Many millions are exhausted by their labors.
Many millions are created wealthy.
Many millions are anxiously involved in Maya.

lines.g: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
lines.r: jeh jeh bhaanaa teh teh raakhe ||
lines.ht: जह जह भाणा तह तह राखे ॥
lines.e: Wherever He wills, there He keeps us.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਹਾਥੇ ॥੫॥
lines.r: naanak sabh kichh prabh kai haathe ||5||
lines.ht: नानक सभु किछु प्रभ कै हाथे ॥५॥
lines.e: O Nanak, everything is in the Hands of God. ||5||
Many millions become Bairaagees, who renounce the world.

lines.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
lines.r: raam naam sa(n)g tin liv laagee ||
lines.ht: राम नाम संगि तिनि लिव लागी ॥
lines.e: They have attached themselves to the Lord's Name.
Many millions are searching for God.
Within their souls, they find the Supreme Lord God.
Many millions thirst for the Blessing of God's Darshan.
They meet with God, the Eternal.
Many millions pray for the Society of the Saints.
They are imbued with the Love of the Supreme Lord God.
Those with whom He Himself is pleased,

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਸਦਾ ਧਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ॥੬॥
lines.r: naanak te jan sadhaa dhan dha(n)n ||6||
lines.ht: नानक ते जन सदा धनि धंनि ॥६॥
lines.e: O Nanak, are blessed, forever blessed. ||6||
Many millions are the fields of creation and the galaxies.
Many millions are the etheric skies and the solar systems.
Many millions are the divine incarnations.
In so many ways, He has unfolded Himself.
So many times, He has expanded His expansion.
Forever and ever, He is the One, the One Universal Creator.
Many millions are created in various forms.

lines.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ਹੋਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਤਿ ॥
lines.r: prabh te hoe prabh maeh samaat ||
lines.ht: प्रभ ते होए प्रभ माहि समाति ॥
lines.e: From God they emanate, and into God they merge once again.

lines.g: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.r: taa kaa a(n)t na jaanai koi ||
lines.ht: ता का अंतु न जानै कोइ ॥
lines.e: His limits are not known to anyone.
Of Himself, and by Himself, O Nanak, God exists. ||7||
Many millions are the servants of the Supreme Lord God.
Their souls are enlightened.
Many millions know the essence of reality.
Their eyes gaze forever on the One alone.
Many millions drink in the essence of the Naam.

lines.g: ਅਮਰ ਭਏ ਸਦ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਜੀਵਹਿ ॥
lines.r: amar bhe sadh sadh hee jeeveh ||
lines.ht: अमर भए सद सद ही जीवहि ॥
lines.e: They become immortal; they live forever and ever.
Many millions sing the Glorious Praises of the Naam.
They are absorbed in intuitive peace and pleasure.

lines.g: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਮਾਰੇ ॥
lines.r: apune jan kau saas saas samaare ||
lines.ht: अपुने जन कउ सासि सासि समारे ॥
lines.e: He remembers His servants with each and every breath.
O Nanak, they are the beloveds of the Transcendent Lord God. ||8||10||
Shalok:

lines.g: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਸਰ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.r: karan kaaran prabh ek hai dhoosar naahee koi ||
lines.ht: करण कारण प्रभु एकु है दूसर नाही कोइ ॥
lines.e: God alone is the Doer of deeds - there is no other at all.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.r: naanak tis balihaaranai jal thal maheeal soi ||1||
lines.ht: नानक तिसु बलिहारणै जलि थलि महीअलि सोइ ॥१॥
lines.e: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the One, who pervades the waters, the lands, the sky and all space. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
The Doer, the Cause of causes, is potent to do anything.
That which pleases Him, comes to pass.
In an instant, He creates and destroys.
He has no end or limitation.
By His Order, He established the earth, and He maintains it unsupported.
By His Order, the world was created; by His Order, it shall merge again into Him.
By His Order, one's occupation is high or low.
By His Order, there are so many colors and forms.
Having created the Creation, He beholds His own greatness.
O Nanak, He is pervading in all. ||1||
If it pleases God, one attains salvation.
If it pleases God, then even stones can swim.

lines.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਸ ਤੇ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
lines.r: prabh bhaavai bin saas te raakhai ||
lines.ht: प्रभ भावै बिनु सास ते राखै ॥
lines.e: If it pleases God, the body is preserved, even without the breath of life.

lines.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਭਾਖੈ ॥
lines.r: prabh bhaavai taa har gun bhaakhai ||
lines.ht: प्रभ भावै ता हरि गुण भाखै ॥
lines.e: If it pleases God, then one chants the Lord's Glorious Praises.
If it pleases God, then even sinners are saved.
He Himself acts, and He Himself contemplates.
He Himself is the Master of both worlds.
He plays and He enjoys; He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.
As He wills, He causes actions to be done.
Nanak sees no other than Him. ||2||

lines.g: ਕਹੁ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਤੇ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਇ ਆਵੈ ॥
lines.r: kahu maanukh te kiaa hoi aavai ||
lines.ht: कहु मानुख ते किआ होइ आवै ॥
lines.e: Tell me - what can a mere mortal do?
Whatever pleases God is what He causes us to do.

lines.g: ਇਸ ਕੈ ਹਾਥਿ ਹੋਇ ਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਲੇਇ ॥
lines.r: eis kai haath hoi taa sabh kichh lei ||
lines.ht: इस कै हाथि होइ ता सभु किछु लेइ ॥
lines.e: If it were in our hands, we would grab up everything.
Whatever pleases God - that is what He does.
Through ignorance, people are engrossed in corruption.
If they knew better, they would save themselves.
Deluded by doubt, they wander around in the ten directions.

lines.g: ਨਿਮਖ ਮਾਹਿ ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
lines.r: nimakh maeh chaar ku(n)T fir aavai ||
lines.ht: निमख माहि चारि कुँट फिरि आवै ॥
lines.e: In an instant, their minds go around the four corners of the world and come back again.

lines.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.r: kar kirapaa jis apanee bhagat dhei ||
lines.ht: करि किरपा जिसु अपनी भगति देइ ॥
lines.e: Those whom the Lord mercifully blesses with His devotional worship
- O Nanak, they are absorbed into the Naam. ||3||

lines.g: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਨੀਚ ਕੀਟ ਕਉ ਰਾਜ ॥
lines.r: khin meh neech keeT kau raaj ||
lines.ht: खिन महि नीच कीट कउ राज ॥
lines.e: In an instant, the lowly worm is transformed into a king.
The Supreme Lord God is the Protector of the humble.

lines.g: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
lines.r: jaa kaa dhirasaT kachhoo na aavai ||
lines.ht: जा का दृसटि कछू न आवै ॥
lines.e: Even one who has never been seen at all,
becomes instantly famous in the ten directions.
And that one upon whom He bestows His blessings

lines.g: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਲੇਖਾ ਨ ਗਨੈ ਜਗਦੀਸ ॥
lines.r: taa kaa lekhaa na ganai jagadhees ||
lines.ht: ता का लेखा न गनै जगदीस ॥
lines.e: the Lord of the world does not hold him to his account.

lines.g: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
lines.r: jeeau pi(n)dd sabh tis kee raas ||
lines.ht: जीउ पिंडु सभ तिस की रासि ॥
lines.e: Soul and body are all His property.
Each and every heart is illuminated by the Perfect Lord God.
He Himself fashioned His own handiwork.
Nanak lives by beholding His greatness. ||4||

lines.g: ਇਸ ਕਾ ਬਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਇਸੁ ਹਾਥ ॥
lines.r: eis kaa bal naahee is haath ||
lines.ht: इस का बलु नाही इसु हाथ ॥
lines.e: There is no power in the hands of mortal beings;
the Doer, the Cause of causes is the Lord of all.
The helpless beings are subject to His Command.

lines.g: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਫੁਨਿ ਥੀਉ ॥
lines.r: jo tis bhaavai soiee fun theeau ||
lines.ht: जो तिसु भावै सोई फुनि थीउ ॥
lines.e: That which pleases Him, ultimately comes to pass.
Sometimes, they abide in exaltation; sometimes, they are depressed.
Sometimes, they are sad, and sometimes they laugh with joy and delight.
Sometimes, they are occupied with slander and anxiety.
Sometimes, they are high in the Akaashic Ethers, sometimes in the nether regions of the underworld.
Sometimes, they know the contemplation of God.
O Nanak, God Himself unites them with Himself. ||5||
Sometimes, they dance in various ways.
Sometimes, they remain asleep day and night.
Sometimes, they are awesome, in terrible rage.
Sometimes, they are the dust of the feet of all.
Sometimes, they sit as great kings.
Sometimes, they wear the coat of a lowly beggar.
Sometimes, they come to have evil reputations.
Sometimes, they are known as very, very good.

lines.g: ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਵ ਹੀ ਰਹੈ ॥
lines.r: jiau prabh raakhai tiv hee rahai ||
lines.ht: जिउ प्रभु राखै तिव ही रहै ॥
lines.e: As God keeps them, so they remain.
By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, the Truth is told. ||6||
Sometimes, as scholars, they deliver lectures.
Sometimes, they hold to silence in deep meditation.
Sometimes, they take cleansing baths at places of pilgrimage.
Sometimes, as Siddhas or seekers, they impart spiritual wisdom.

lines.g: ਕਬਹੂ ਕੀਟ ਹਸਤਿ ਪਤੰਗ ਹੋਇ ਜੀਆ ॥
lines.r: kabahoo keeT hasat pata(n)g hoi jeeaa ||
lines.ht: कबहू कीट हसति पतंग होइ जीआ ॥
lines.e: Sometimes, they becomes worms, elephants, or moths.
They may wander and roam through countless incarnations.
In various costumes, like actors, they appear.
As it pleases God, they dance.
Whatever pleases Him, comes to pass.
O Nanak, there is no other at all. ||7||
Sometimes, this being attains the Company of the Holy.

lines.g: ਉਸੁ ਅਸਥਾਨ ਤੇ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
lines.r: aus asathaan te bahur na aavai ||
lines.ht: उसु असथान ते बहुरि न आवै ॥
lines.e: From that place, he does not have to come back again.
The light of spiritual wisdom dawns within.
That place does not perish.

lines.g: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਇਕ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
lines.r: man tan naam rate ik ra(n)g ||
lines.ht: मन तन नामि रते इक रंगि ॥
lines.e: The mind and body are imbued with the Love of the Naam, the Name of the One Lord.
He dwells forever with the Supreme Lord God.

lines.g: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਜਲੁ ਆਇ ਖਟਾਨਾ ॥
lines.r: jiau jal meh jal aai khaTaanaa ||
lines.ht: जिउ जल महि जलु आइ खटाना ॥
lines.e: As water comes to blend with water,
his light blends into the Light.
Reincarnation is ended, and eternal peace is found.
Nanak is forever a sacrifice to God. ||8||11||
Shalok:

lines.g: ਸੁਖੀ ਬਸੈ ਮਸਕੀਨੀਆ ਆਪੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਤਲੇ ॥
lines.r: sukhee basai masakeeneeaa aap nivaar tale ||
lines.ht: सुखी बसै मसकीनीआ आपु निवारि तले ॥
lines.e: The humble beings abide in peace; subduing egotism, they are meek.

lines.g: ਬਡੇ ਬਡੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਗਰਬਿ ਗਲੇ ॥੧॥
lines.r: badde badde aha(n)kaareeaa naanak garab gale ||1||
lines.ht: बडे बडे अहंकारीआ नानक गरबि गले ॥१॥
lines.e: The very proud and arrogant persons, O Nanak, are consumed by their own pride. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
One who has the pride of power within,
shall dwell in hell, and become a dog.
One who deems himself to have the beauty of youth,
shall become a maggot in manure.
One who claims to act virtuously,
shall live and die, wandering through countless reincarnations.

lines.g: ਧਨ ਭੂਮਿ ਕਾ ਜੋ ਕਰੈ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.r: dhan bhoom kaa jo karai gumaan ||
lines.ht: धन भूमि का जो करै गुमानु ॥
lines.e: One who takes pride in wealth and lands
is a fool, blind and ignorant.

lines.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਬਸਾਵੈ ॥
lines.r: kar kirapaa jis kai hiradhai gareebee basaavai ||
lines.ht: करि किरपा जिस कै हिरदै गरीबी बसावै ॥
lines.e: One whose heart is mercifully blessed with abiding humility,

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਈਹਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਆਗੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
lines.r: naanak ieehaa mukat aagai sukh paavai ||1||
lines.ht: नानक ईहा मुकतु आगै सुखु पावै ॥१॥
lines.e: O Nanak, is liberated here, and obtains peace hereafter. ||1||
One who becomes wealthy and takes pride in it

lines.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਕਛੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
lines.r: tiran samaan kachh sa(n)g na jaavai ||
lines.ht: तृण समानि कछु संगि न जावै ॥
lines.e: not even a piece of straw shall go along with him.

lines.g: ਬਹੁ ਲਸਕਰ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਆਸ ॥
lines.r: bahu lasakar maanukh uoopar kare aas ||
lines.ht: बहु लसकर मानुख ऊपरि करे आस ॥
lines.e: He may place his hopes on a large army of men,

lines.g: ਪਲ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਨਾਸ ॥
lines.r: pal bheetar taa kaa hoi binaas ||
lines.ht: पल भीतरि ता का होइ बिनास ॥
lines.e: but he shall vanish in an instant.
One who deems himself to be the strongest of all,
in an instant, shall be reduced to ashes.
One who thinks of no one else except his own prideful self
the Righteous Judge of Dharma shall expose his disgrace.

lines.g: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਿਟੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.r: gur prasaadh jaa kaa miTai abhimaan ||
lines.ht: गुर प्रसादि जा का मिटै अभिमानु ॥
lines.e: One who, by Guru's Grace, eliminates his ego,
O Nanak, becomes acceptable in the Court of the Lord. ||2||
If someone does millions of good deeds, while acting in ego,
he shall incur only trouble; all this is in vain.
If someone performs great penance, while acting in selfishness and conceit,
he shall be reincarnated into heaven and hell, over and over again.

lines.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਆਤਮ ਨਹੀ ਦ੍ਰਵੈ ॥
lines.r: anik jatan kar aatam nahee dhravai ||
lines.ht: अनिक जतन करि आतम नही द्रवै ॥
lines.e: He makes all sorts of efforts, but his soul is still not softened
how can he go to the Court of the Lord?
One who calls himself good
goodness shall not draw near him.

lines.g: ਸਰਬ ਕੀ ਰੇਨ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.r: sarab kee ren jaa kaa man hoi ||
lines.ht: सरब की रेन जा का मनु होइ ॥
lines.e: One whose mind is the dust of all

lines.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.r: kahu naanak taa kee niramal soi ||3||
lines.ht: कहु नानक ता की निरमल सोइ ॥३॥
lines.e: - says Nanak, his reputation is spotlessly pure. ||3||

lines.g: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਮੁਝ ਤੇ ਕਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.r: jab lag jaanai mujh te kachh hoi ||
lines.ht: जब लगु जानै मुझ ते कछु होइ ॥
lines.e: As long as someone thinks that he is the one who acts,

lines.g: ਤਬ ਇਸ ਕਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.r: tab is kau sukh naahee koi ||
lines.ht: तब इस कउ सुखु नाही कोइ ॥
lines.e: he shall have no peace.

lines.g: ਜਬ ਇਹ ਜਾਨੈ ਮੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
lines.r: jab ieh jaanai mai kichh karataa ||
lines.ht: जब इह जानै मै किछु करता ॥
lines.e: As long as this mortal thinks that he is the one who does things,

lines.g: ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਫਿਰਤਾ ॥
lines.r: tab lag garabh jon meh firataa ||
lines.ht: तब लगु गरभ जोनि महि फिरता ॥
lines.e: he shall wander in reincarnation through the womb.
As long as he considers one an enemy, and another a friend,
his mind shall not come to rest.

lines.g: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇ ॥
lines.r: jab lag moh magan sa(n)g mai ||
lines.ht: जब लगु मोह मगन संगि माइ ॥
lines.e: As long as he is intoxicated with attachment to Maya,

lines.g: ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
lines.r: tab lag dharam rai dhei sajai ||
lines.ht: तब लगु धरम राइ देइ सजाइ ॥
lines.e: the Righteous Judge shall punish him.
By God's Grace, his bonds are shattered;
by Guru's Grace, O Nanak, his ego is eliminated. ||4||

lines.g: ਸਹਸ ਖਟੇ ਲਖ ਕਉ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
lines.r: sahas khaTe lakh kau uTh dhaavai ||
lines.ht: सहस खटे लख कउ उठि धावै ॥
lines.e: Earning a thousand, he runs after a hundred thousand.

lines.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.r: tirapat na aavai maiaa paachhai paavai ||
lines.ht: तृपति न आवै माइआ पाछै पावै ॥
lines.e: Satisfaction is not obtained by chasing after Maya.
He may enjoy all sorts of corrupt pleasures,
but he is still not satisfied; he indulges again and again, wearing himself out, until he dies.
Without contentment, no one is satisfied.
Like the objects in a dream, all his efforts are in vain.
Through the love of the Naam, all peace is obtained.
Only a few obtain this, by great good fortune.
He Himself is Himself the Cause of causes.
Forever and ever, O Nanak, chant the Lord's Name. ||5||
The Doer, the Cause of causes, is the Creator Lord.
What deliberations are in the hands of mortal beings?
As God casts His Glance of Grace, they come to be.
God Himself, of Himself, is unto Himself.

lines.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਸੁ ਅਪਨੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
lines.r: jo kichh keeno su apanai ra(n)g ||
lines.ht: जो किछु कीनो सु अपनै रंगि ॥
lines.e: Whatever He created, was by His Own Pleasure.

lines.g: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ ਸਭਹੂ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
lines.r: sabh te dhoor sabhahoo kai sa(n)g ||
lines.ht: सभ ते दूरि सभहू कै संगि ॥
lines.e: He is far from all, and yet with all.
He understands, He sees, and He passes judgment.
He Himself is the One, and He Himself is the many.

lines.g: ਮਰੈ ਨ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.r: marai na binasai aavai na jai ||
lines.ht: मरै न बिनसै आवै न जाइ ॥
lines.e: He does not die or perish; He does not come or go.
O Nanak, He remains forever All-pervading. ||6||
He Himself instructs, and He Himself learns.
He Himself mingles with all.
He Himself created His own expanse.

lines.g: ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਉਸ ਕਾ ਓਹੁ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.r: sabh kachh us kaa oh karanaihaar ||
lines.ht: सभु कछु उस का ओहु करनैहारु ॥
lines.e: All things are His; He is the Creator.

lines.g: ਉਸ ਤੇ ਭਿੰਨ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.r: aus te bhi(n)n kahahu kichh hoi ||
lines.ht: उस ते भिंन कहहु किछु होइ ॥
lines.e: Without Him, what could be done?
In the spaces and interspaces, He is the One.
In His own play, He Himself is the Actor.
He produces His plays with infinite variety.

lines.g: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.r: man meh aap man apune maeh ||
lines.ht: मन महि आपि मन अपुने माहि ॥
lines.e: He Himself is in the mind, and the mind is in Him.
O Nanak, His worth cannot be estimated. ||7||
True, True, True is God, our Lord and Master.
By Guru's Grace, some speak of Him.
True, True, True is the Creator of all.
Out of millions, scarcely anyone knows Him.
Beautiful, Beautiful, Beautiful is Your Sublime Form.
You are Exquisitely Beautiful, Infinite and Incomparable.
Pure, Pure, Pure is the Word of Your Bani,
heard in each and every heart, spoken to the ears.
Holy, Holy, Holy and Sublimely Pure
- chant the Naam, O Nanak, with heart-felt love. ||8||12||
Shalok:

lines.g: ਸੰਤ ਸਰਨਿ ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਪਰੈ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਉਧਰਨਹਾਰ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)t saran jo jan parai so jan udharanahaar ||
lines.ht: संत सरनि जो जनु परै सो जनु उधरनहार ॥
lines.e: One who seeks the Sanctuary of the Saints shall be saved.

lines.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.r: sa(n)t kee ni(n)dhaa naanakaa bahur bahur avataar ||1||
lines.ht: संत की निंदा नानका बहुरि बहुरि अवतार ॥१॥
lines.e: One who slanders the Saints, O Nanak, shall be reincarnated over and over again. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
Slandering the Saints, one's life is cut short.

lines.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਨਹੀ ਛੁਟੈ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)t kai dhookhan jam te nahee chhuTai ||
lines.ht: संत कै दूखनि जम ते नही छुटै ॥
lines.e: Slandering the Saints, one shall not escape the Messenger of Death.

lines.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)t kai dhookhan sukh sabh jai ||
lines.ht: संत कै दूखनि सुखु सभु जाइ ॥
lines.e: Slandering the Saints, all happiness vanishes.

lines.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਨਰਕ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)t kai dhookhan narak meh pai ||
lines.ht: संत कै दूखनि नरक महि पाइ ॥
lines.e: Slandering the Saints, one falls into hell.

lines.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਮਲੀਨ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)t kai dhookhan mat hoi maleen ||
lines.ht: संत कै दूखनि मति होइ मलीन ॥
lines.e: Slandering the Saints, the intellect is polluted.

lines.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਤੇ ਹੀਨ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)t kai dhookhan sobhaa te heen ||
lines.ht: संत कै दूखनि सोभा ते हीन ॥
lines.e: Slandering the Saints, one's reputation is lost.

lines.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਹਤੇ ਕਉ ਰਖੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)t ke hate kau rakhai na koi ||
lines.ht: संत के हते कउ रखै न कोइ ॥
lines.e: One who is cursed by a Saint cannot be saved.

lines.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਥਾਨ ਭ੍ਰਸਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)t kai dhookhan thaan bhrasaT hoi ||
lines.ht: संत कै दूखनि थान भ्रसटु होइ ॥
lines.e: Slandering the Saints, one's place is defiled.
But if the Compassionate Saint shows His Kindness,
O Nanak, in the Company of the Saints, the slanderer may still be saved. ||1||

lines.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੂਖਨ ਤੇ ਮੁਖੁ ਭਵੈ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)t ke dhookhan te mukh bhavai ||
lines.ht: संत के दूखन ते मुखु भवै ॥
lines.e: Slandering the Saints, one becomes a wry-faced malcontent.

lines.g: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਕਾਗ ਜਿਉ ਲਵੈ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)tan kai dhookhan kaag jiau lavai ||
lines.ht: संतन कै दूखनि काग जिउ लवै ॥
lines.e: Slandering the Saints, one croaks like a raven.

lines.g: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਸਰਪ ਜੋਨਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)tan kai dhookhan sarap jon pai ||
lines.ht: संतन कै दूखनि सरप जोनि पाइ ॥
lines.e: Slandering the Saints, one is reincarnated as a snake.

lines.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਗਦ ਜੋਨਿ ਕਿਰਮਾਇ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)t kai dhookhan tiragadh jon kiramai ||
lines.ht: संत कै दूखनि तृगद जोनि किरमाइ ॥
lines.e: Slandering the Saints, one is reincarnated as a wiggling worm.

lines.g: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਹਿ ਜਲੈ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)tan kai dhookhan tirasanaa meh jalai ||
lines.ht: संतन कै दूखनि तृसना महि जलै ॥
lines.e: Slandering the Saints, one burns in the fire of desire.

lines.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਛਲੈ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)t kai dhookhan sabh ko chhalai ||
lines.ht: संत कै दूखनि सभु को छलै ॥
lines.e: Slandering the Saints, one tries to deceive everyone.

lines.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਤੇਜੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)t kai dhookhan tej sabh jai ||
lines.ht: संत कै दूखनि तेजु सभु जाइ ॥
lines.e: Slandering the Saints, all one's influence vanishes.
Slandering the Saints, one becomes the lowest of the low.

lines.g: ਸੰਤ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਾ ਥਾਉ ਕੋ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)t dhokhee kaa thaau ko naeh ||
lines.ht: संत दोखी का थाउ को नाहि ॥
lines.e: For the slanderer of the Saint, there is no place of rest.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਓਇ ਭੀ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
lines.r: naanak sa(n)t bhaavai taa oi bhee gat paeh ||2||
lines.ht: नानक संत भावै ता ओइ भी गति पाहि ॥२॥
lines.e: O Nanak, if it pleases the Saint, even then, he may be saved. ||2||
The slanderer of the Saint is the worst evil-doer.

lines.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਟਿਕਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)t kaa ni(n)dhak khin Tikan na paiee ||
lines.ht: संत का निंदकु खिनु टिकनु न पाई ॥
lines.e: The slanderer of the Saint has not even a moment's rest.
The slanderer of the Saint is a brutal butcher.
The slanderer of the Saint is cursed by the Transcendent Lord.

lines.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਰਾਜ ਤੇ ਹੀਨੁ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)t kaa ni(n)dhak raaj te heen ||
lines.ht: संत का निंदकु राज ते हीनु ॥
lines.e: The slanderer of the Saint has no kingdom.

lines.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਅਰੁ ਦੀਨੁ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)t kaa ni(n)dhak dhukheeaa ar dheen ||
lines.ht: संत का निंदकु दुखीआ अरु दीनु ॥
lines.e: The slanderer of the Saint becomes miserable and poor.

lines.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਉ ਸਰਬ ਰੋਗ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)t ke ni(n)dhak kau sarab rog ||
lines.ht: संत के निंदक कउ सरब रोग ॥
lines.e: The slanderer of the Saint contracts all diseases.

lines.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਬਿਜੋਗ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)t ke ni(n)dhak kau sadhaa bijog ||
lines.ht: संत के निंदक कउ सदा बिजोग ॥
lines.e: The slanderer of the Saint is forever separated.

lines.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਦੋਖ ਮਹਿ ਦੋਖੁ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)t kee ni(n)dhaa dhokh meh dhokh ||
lines.ht: संत की निंदा दोख महि दोखु ॥
lines.e: To slander a Saint is the worst sin of sins.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਉਸ ਕਾ ਭੀ ਹੋਇ ਮੋਖੁ ॥੩॥
lines.r: naanak sa(n)t bhaavai taa us kaa bhee hoi mokh ||3||
lines.ht: नानक संत भावै ता उस का भी होइ मोखु ॥३॥
lines.e: O Nanak, if it pleases the Saint, then even this one may be liberated. ||3||
The slanderer of the Saint is forever impure.

lines.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਨਹੀ ਮਿਤੁ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)t kaa dhokhee kisai kaa nahee mit ||
lines.ht: संत का दोखी किसै का नही मितु ॥
lines.e: The slanderer of the Saint is nobody's friend.

lines.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਉ ਡਾਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)t ke dhokhee kau ddaan laagai ||
lines.ht: संत के दोखी कउ डानु लागै ॥
lines.e: The slanderer of the Saint shall be punished.

lines.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਉ ਸਭ ਤਿਆਗੈ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)t ke dhokhee kau sabh tiaagai ||
lines.ht: संत के दोखी कउ सभ तिआगै ॥
lines.e: The slanderer of the Saint is abandoned by all.
The slanderer of the Saint is totally egocentric.
The slanderer of the Saint is forever corrupt.
The slanderer of the Saint must endure birth and death.

lines.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਦੂਖਨਾ ਸੁਖ ਤੇ ਟਰੈ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)t kee dhookhanaa sukh te Tarai ||
lines.ht: संत की दूखना सुख ते टरै ॥
lines.e: The slanderer of the Saint is devoid of peace.

lines.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਠਾਉ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)t ke dhokhee kau naahee Thaau ||
lines.ht: संत के दोखी कउ नाही ठाउ ॥
lines.e: The slanderer of the Saint has no place of rest.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੪॥
lines.r: naanak sa(n)t bhaavai taa le milai ||4||
lines.ht: नानक संत भावै ता लए मिलाइ ॥४॥
lines.e: O Nanak, if it pleases the Saint, then even such a one may merge in union. ||4||

lines.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਅਧ ਬੀਚ ਤੇ ਟੂਟੈ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)t kaa dhokhee adh beech te TooTai ||
lines.ht: संत का दोखी अध बीच ते टूटै ॥
lines.e: The slanderer of the Saint breaks down mid-way.

lines.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਿਤੈ ਕਾਜਿ ਨ ਪਹੂਚੈ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)t kaa dhokhee kitai kaaj na pahoochai ||
lines.ht: संत का दोखी कितै काजि न पहूचै ॥
lines.e: The slanderer of the Saint cannot accomplish his tasks.

lines.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਉ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਈਐ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)t ke dhokhee kau udhiaan bhramaieeaai ||
lines.ht: संत के दोखी कउ उदिआन भ्रमाईऐ ॥
lines.e: The slanderer of the Saint wanders in the wilderness.
The slanderer of the Saint is misled into desolation.

lines.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਅੰਤਰ ਤੇ ਥੋਥਾ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)t kaa dhokhee a(n)tar te thothaa ||
lines.ht: संत का दोखी अंतर ते थोथा ॥
lines.e: The slanderer of the Saint is empty inside,

lines.g: ਜਿਉ ਸਾਸ ਬਿਨਾ ਮਿਰਤਕ ਕੀ ਲੋਥਾ ॥
lines.r: jiau saas binaa mritak kee lothaa ||
lines.ht: जिउ सास बिना मिरतक की लोथा ॥
lines.e: like the corpse of a dead man, without the breath of life.

lines.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕੀ ਜੜ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)t ke dhokhee kee jaR kichh naeh ||
lines.ht: संत के दोखी की जड़ किछु नाहि ॥
lines.e: The slanderer of the Saint has no heritage at all.
He himself must eat what he has planted.

lines.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਉ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)t ke dhokhee kau avar na raakhanahaar ||
lines.ht: संत के दोखी कउ अवरु न राखनहारु ॥
lines.e: The slanderer of the Saint cannot be saved by anyone else.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਲਏ ਉਬਾਰਿ ॥੫॥
lines.r: naanak sa(n)t bhaavai taa le ubaar ||5||
lines.ht: नानक संत भावै ता लए उबारि ॥५॥
lines.e: O Nanak, if it pleases the Saint, then even he may be saved. ||5||
The slanderer of the Saint bewails like this
like a fish, out of water, writhing in agony.

lines.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਭੂਖਾ ਨਹੀ ਰਾਜੈ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)t kaa dhokhee bhookhaa nahee raajai ||
lines.ht: संत का दोखी भूखा नही राजै ॥
lines.e: The slanderer of the Saint is hungry and is never satisfied,
as fire is not satisfied by fuel.
The slanderer of the Saint is left all alone,

lines.g: ਜਿਉ ਬੂਆੜੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਖੇਤ ਮਾਹਿ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
lines.r: jiau booaaR til khet maeh dhuhelaa ||
lines.ht: जिउ बूआड़ु तिलु खेत माहि दुहेला ॥
lines.e: like the miserable barren sesame stalk abandoned in the field.

lines.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਧਰਮ ਤੇ ਰਹਤ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)t kaa dhokhee dharam te rahat ||
lines.ht: संत का दोखी धरम ते रहत ॥
lines.e: The slanderer of the Saint is devoid of faith.

lines.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਸਦ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਕਹਤ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)t kaa dhokhee sadh mithiaa kahat ||
lines.ht: संत का दोखी सद मिथिआ कहत ॥
lines.e: The slanderer of the Saint constantly lies.

lines.g: ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਾ ਧੁਰਿ ਹੀ ਪਇਆ ॥
lines.r: kirat ni(n)dhak kaa dhur hee piaa ||
lines.ht: किरतु निंदक का धुरि ही पइआ ॥
lines.e: The fate of the slanderer is pre-ordained from the very beginning of time.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਥਿਆ ॥੬॥
lines.r: naanak jo tis bhaavai soiee thiaa ||6||
lines.ht: नानक जो तिसु भावै सोई थिआ ॥६॥
lines.e: O Nanak, whatever pleases God's Will comes to pass. ||6||

lines.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਬਿਗੜ ਰੂਪੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)t kaa dhokhee bigaR roop hoi jai ||
lines.ht: संत का दोखी बिगड़ रूपु होइ जाइ ॥
lines.e: The slanderer of the Saint becomes deformed.

lines.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਉ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)t ke dhokhee kau dharageh milai sajai ||
lines.ht: संत के दोखी कउ दरगह मिलै सजाइ ॥
lines.e: The slanderer of the Saint receives his punishment in the Court of the Lord.
The slanderer of the Saint is eternally in limbo.

lines.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਨ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜੀਵਾਈਐ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)t kaa dhokhee na marai na jeevaieeaai ||
lines.ht: संत का दोखी न मरै न जीवाईऐ ॥
lines.e: He does not die, but he does not live either.

lines.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕੀ ਪੁਜੈ ਨ ਆਸਾ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)t ke dhokhee kee pujai na aasaa ||
lines.ht: संत के दोखी की पुजै न आसा ॥
lines.e: The hopes of the slanderer of the Saint are not fulfilled.

lines.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਉਠਿ ਚਲੈ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)t kaa dhokhee uTh chalai niraasaa ||
lines.ht: संत का दोखी उठि चलै निरासा ॥
lines.e: The slanderer of the Saint departs disappointed.

lines.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੋਖਿ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)t kai dhokh na tirasaTai koi ||
lines.ht: संत कै दोखि न तृसटै कोइ ॥
lines.e: Slandering the Saint, no one attains satisfaction.
As it pleases the Lord, so do people become;
no one can erase their past actions.
O Nanak, the True Lord alone knows all. ||7||

lines.g: ਸਭ ਘਟ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਓਹੁ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.r: sabh ghaT tis ke oh karanaihaar ||
lines.ht: सभ घट तिस के ओहु करनैहारु ॥
lines.e: All hearts are His; He is the Creator.
Forever and ever, I bow to Him in reverence.

lines.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
lines.r: prabh kee usatat karahu dhin raat ||
lines.ht: प्रभ की उसतति करहु दिनु राति ॥
lines.e: Praise God, day and night.
Meditate on Him with every breath and morsel of food.

lines.g: ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ॥
lines.r: sabh kachh varatai tis kaa keeaa ||
lines.ht: सभु कछु वरतै तिस का कीआ ॥
lines.e: Everything happens as He wills.
As He wills, so people become.
He Himself is the play, and He Himself is the actor.
Who else can speak or deliberate upon this?

lines.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਪਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.r: jis no kirapaa karai tis aapan naam dhei ||
lines.ht: जिस नो कृपा करै तिसु आपन नामु देइ ॥
lines.e: He Himself gives His Name to those, upon whom He bestows His Mercy.
Very fortunate, O Nanak, are those people. ||8||13||
Shalok:

lines.g: ਤਜਹੁ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਸੁਰਿ ਜਨਹੁ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
lines.r: tajahu siaanap sur janahu simarahu har har rai ||
lines.ht: तजहु सिआनप सुरि जनहु सिमरहु हरि हरि राइ ॥
lines.e: Give up your cleverness, good people - remember the Lord God, your King!

lines.g: ਏਕ ਆਸ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਰਖਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੂਖੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.r: ek aas har man rakhahu naanak dhookh bharam bhau jai ||1||
lines.ht: एक आस हरि मनि रखहु नानक दूखु भरमु भउ जाइ ॥१॥
lines.e: Enshrine in your heart, your hopes in the One Lord. O Nanak, your pain, doubt and fear shall depart. ||1||
Ashtapadee:

lines.g: ਮਾਨੁਖ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਬ੍ਰਿਥੀ ਸਭ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
lines.r: maanukh kee Tek birathee sabh jaan ||
lines.ht: मानुख की टेक बृथी सभ जानु ॥
lines.e: Reliance on mortals is in vain - know this well.
The Great Giver is the One Lord God.
By His gifts, we are satisfied,
and we suffer from thirst no longer.
The One Lord Himself destroys and also preserves.
Nothing at all is in the hands of mortal beings.

lines.g: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੂਝਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.r: tis kaa hukam boojh sukh hoi ||
lines.ht: तिस का हुकमु बूझि सुखु होइ ॥
lines.e: Understanding His Order, there is peace.

lines.g: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖੁ ਕੰਠਿ ਪਰੋਇ ॥
lines.r: tis kaa naam rakh ka(n)Th paroi ||
lines.ht: तिस का नामु रखु कंठि परोइ ॥
lines.e: So take His Name, and wear it as your necklace.
Remember, remember, remember God in meditation.
O Nanak, no obstacle shall stand in your way. ||1||
Praise the Formless Lord in your mind.
O my mind, make this your true occupation.
Let your tongue become pure, drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar.
Your soul shall be forever peaceful.
With your eyes, see the wondrous play of your Lord and Master.
In the Company of the Holy, all other associations vanish.
With your feet, walk in the Way of the Lord.
Sins are washed away, chanting the Lord's Name, even for a moment.

lines.g: ਕਰ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਮ ਸ੍ਰਵਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ॥
lines.r: kar har karam sravan har kathaa ||
lines.ht: कर हरि करम स्रवनि हरि कथा ॥
lines.e: So do the Lord's Work, and listen to the Lord's Sermon.
In the Lord's Court, O Nanak, your face shall be radiant. ||2||
Very fortunate are those humble beings in this world,

lines.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਹਿ ॥
lines.r: sadhaa sadhaa har ke gun gaeh ||
lines.ht: सदा सदा हरि के गुन गाहि ॥
lines.e: who sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, forever and ever.
Those who dwell upon the Lord's Name,
are the most wealthy and prosperous in the world.

lines.g: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਖੀ ॥
lines.r: man tan mukh boleh har mukhee ||
lines.ht: मनि तनि मुखि बोलहि हरि मुखी ॥
lines.e: Those who speak of the Supreme Lord in thought, word and deed
know that they are peaceful and happy, forever and ever.
One who recognizes the One and only Lord as One,

lines.g: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਕੀ ਓਹੁ ਸੋਝੀ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
lines.r: eit ut kee oh sojhee jaanai ||
lines.ht: इत उत की ओहु सोझी जानै ॥
lines.e: understands this world and the next.

lines.g: ਨਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
lines.r: naam sa(n)g jis kaa man maaniaa ||
lines.ht: नाम संगि जिस का मनु मानिआ ॥
lines.e: One whose mind accepts the Company of the Naam,
the Name of the Lord, O Nanak, knows the Immaculate Lord. ||3||
By Guru's Grace, one understands himself;
know that then, his thirst is quenched.
In the Company of the Holy, one chants the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.g: ਸਰਬ ਰੋਗ ਤੇ ਓਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਰਹਤ ॥
lines.r: sarab rog te oh har jan rahat ||
lines.ht: सरब रोग ते ओहु हरि जनु रहत ॥
lines.e: Such a devotee of the Lord is free of all disease.
Night and day, sing the Kirtan, the Praises of the One Lord.
In the midst of your household, remain balanced and unattached.

lines.g: ਏਕ ਊਪਰਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
lines.r: ek uoopar jis jan kee aasaa ||
lines.ht: एक ऊपरि जिसु जन की आसा ॥
lines.e: One who places his hopes in the One Lord

lines.g: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕਟੀਐ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਾ ॥
lines.r: tis kee kaTeeaai jam kee faasaa ||
lines.ht: तिस की कटीऐ जम की फासा ॥
lines.e: the noose of Death is cut away from his neck.
One whose mind hungers for the Supreme Lord God,
O Nanak, shall not suffer pain. ||4||

lines.g: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
lines.r: jis kau har prabh man chit aavai ||
lines.ht: जिस कउ हरि प्रभु मनि चिति आवै ॥
lines.e: One who focuses his conscious mind on the Lord God
- that Saint is at peace; he does not waver.
Those unto whom God has granted His Grace

lines.g: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਸ ਤੇ ਡਰੈ ॥
lines.r: so sevak kahu kis te ddarai ||
lines.ht: सो सेवकु कहु किस ते डरै ॥
lines.e: who do those servants need to fear?
As God is, so does He appear;
in His Own creation, He Himself is pervading.
Searching, searching, searching, and finally, success!
By Guru's Grace, the essence of all reality is understood.

lines.g: ਜਬ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਬ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੂਲੁ ॥
lines.r: jab dhekhau tab sabh kichh mool ||
lines.ht: जब देखउ तब सभु किछु मूलु ॥
lines.e: Wherever I look, there I see Him, at the root of all things.
O Nanak, He is the subtle, and He is also the manifest. ||5||

lines.g: ਨਹ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਨਮੈ ਨਹ ਕਿਛੁ ਮਰੈ ॥
lines.r: neh kichh janamai neh kichh marai ||
lines.ht: नह किछु जनमै नह किछु मरै ॥
lines.e: Nothing is born, and nothing dies.
He Himself stages His own drama.
Coming and going, seen and unseen,
all the world is obedient to His Will.
He Himself is All-in-Himself.
In His many ways, He establishes and disestablishes.
He is Imperishable; nothing can be broken.
He lends His Support to maintain the Universe.
Unfathomable and Inscrutable is the Glory of the Lord.
As He inspires us to meditate, O Nanak, so do we meditate. ||6||
Those who know God are glorious.
The whole world is redeemed by their teachings.
God's servants redeem all.
God's servants cause sorrows to be forgotten.
The Merciful Lord unites them with Himself.

lines.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਜਪਿ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
lines.r: gur kaa sabadh jap bhe nihaal ||
lines.ht: गुर का सबदु जपि भए निहाल ॥
lines.e: Chanting the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they become ecstatic.
He alone is committed to serve them,
upon whom God bestows His Mercy, by great good fortune.
Those who chant the Naam find their place of rest.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਉ ਊਤਮ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੭॥
lines.r: naanak tin purakh kau uootam kar maan ||7||
lines.ht: नानक तिन पुरख कउ ऊतम करि मानु ॥७॥
lines.e: O Nanak, respect those persons as the most noble. ||7||

lines.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
lines.r: jo kichh karai su prabh kai ra(n)g ||
lines.ht: जो किछु करै सु प्रभ कै रंगि ॥
lines.e: Whatever you do, do it for the Love of God.
Forever and ever, abide with the Lord.
By its own natural course, whatever will be will be.
Acknowledge that Creator Lord;

lines.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਜਨ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨਾ ॥
lines.r: prabh kaa keeaa jan meeTh lagaanaa ||
lines.ht: प्रभ का कीआ जन मीठ लगाना ॥
lines.e: God's doings are sweet to His humble servant.
As He is, so does He appear.

lines.g: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
lines.r: jis te upaje tis maeh samaae ||
lines.ht: जिस ते उपजे तिसु माहि समाए ॥
lines.e: From Him we came, and into Him we shall merge again.

lines.g: ਓਇ ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਉਨਹੂ ਬਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
lines.r: oi sukh nidhaan unahoo ban aae ||
lines.ht: ओइ सुख निधान उनहू बनि आए ॥
lines.e: He is the treasure of peace, and so does His servant become.
Unto His own, He has given His honor.
O Nanak, know that God and His humble servant are one and the same. ||8||14||
Shalok:

lines.g: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਭਰਪੂਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਨਨਹਾਰ ॥
lines.r: sarab kalaa bharapoor prabh birathaa jaananahaar ||
lines.ht: सरब कला भरपूर प्रभ बिरथा जाननहार ॥
lines.e: God is totally imbued with all powers; He is the Knower of our troubles.

lines.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਉਧਰੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.r: jaa kai simaran udhareeaai naanak tis balihaar ||1||
lines.ht: जा कै सिमरनि उधरीऐ नानक तिसु बलिहार ॥१॥
lines.e: Meditating in remembrance on Him, we are saved; Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
The Lord of the World is the Mender of the broken.
He Himself cherishes all beings.

lines.g: ਸਗਲ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.r: sagal kee chi(n)taa jis man maeh ||
lines.ht: सगल की चिंता जिसु मन माहि ॥
lines.e: The cares of all are on His Mind;
no one is turned away from Him.

lines.g: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
lines.r: re man mere sadhaa har jaap ||
lines.ht: रे मन मेरे सदा हरि जापि ॥
lines.e: O my mind, meditate forever on the Lord.
The Imperishable Lord God is Himself All-in-all.
By one's own actions, nothing is accomplished,
even though the mortal may wish it so, hundreds of times.

lines.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੇਰੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਾਮ ॥
lines.r: tis bin naahee terai kichh kaam ||
lines.ht: तिसु बिनु नाही तेरै किछु काम ॥
lines.e: Without Him, nothing is of any use to you.

lines.g: ਗਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪਿ ਏਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥੧॥
lines.r: gat naanak jap ek har naam ||1||
lines.ht: गति नानक जपि एक हरि नाम ॥१॥
lines.e: Salvation, O Nanak, is attained by chanting the Name of the One Lord. ||1||
One who is good-looking should not be vain;

lines.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਗਲ ਘਟ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
lines.r: prabh kee jot sagal ghaT sohai ||
lines.ht: प्रभ की जोति सगल घट सोहै ॥
lines.e: the Light of God is in all hearts.
Why should anyone be proud of being rich?

lines.g: ਜਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਦੀਆ ਦਰਬੈ ॥
lines.r: jaa sabh kichh tis kaa dheeaa dharabai ||
lines.ht: जा सभु किछु तिस का दीआ दरबै ॥
lines.e: All riches are His gifts.
One may call himself a great hero,

lines.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਕਲਾ ਬਿਨਾ ਕਹ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
lines.r: prabh kee kalaa binaa keh dhaavai ||
lines.ht: प्रभ की कला बिना कह धावै ॥
lines.e: but without God's Power, what can anyone do?
One who brags about giving to charities
the Great Giver shall judge him to be a fool.

lines.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤੂਟੈ ਹਉ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
lines.r: jis gur prasaadh tooTai hau rog ||
lines.ht: जिसु गुर प्रसादि तूटै हउ रोगु ॥
lines.e: One who, by Guru's Grace, is cured of the disease of ego
- O Nanak, that person is forever healthy. ||2||
As a palace is supported by its pillars,

lines.g: ਤਿਉ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਅਸਥੰਮਨੁ ॥
lines.r: tiau gur kaa sabadh maneh asatha(n)man ||
lines.ht: तिउ गुर का सबदु मनहि असथंमनु ॥
lines.e: so does the Guru's Word support the mind.
As a stone placed in a boat can cross over the river,
so is the mortal saved, grasping hold of the Guru's Feet.
As the darkness is illuminated by the lamp,

lines.g: ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਗਾਸੁ ॥
lines.r: gur dharasan dhekh man hoi bigaas ||
lines.ht: गुर दरसनु देखि मनि होइ बिगासु ॥
lines.e: so does the mind blossom forth, beholding the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan.

lines.g: ਜਿਉ ਮਹਾ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥ ਤਿਉ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਵੈ ॥
lines.r: jiau mahaa udhiaan meh maarag paavai || tiau saadhoo sa(n)g mil jot pragaTaavai ||
lines.ht: जिउ महा उदिआन महि मारगु पावै ॥ तिउ साधू संगि मिलि जोति प्रगटावै ॥
lines.e: The path is found through the great wilderness by joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and one's light shines forth.
I seek the dust of the feet of those Saints;
O Lord, fulfill Nanak's longing! ||3||
O foolish mind, why do you cry and bewail?
You shall obtain your pre-ordained destiny.
God is the Giver of pain and pleasure.
Abandon others, and think of Him alone.

lines.g: ਜੋ ਕਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.r: jo kachh karai soiee sukh maan ||
lines.ht: जो कछु करै सोई सुखु मानु ॥
lines.e: Whatever He does - take comfort in that.
Why do you wander around, you ignorant fool?
What things did you bring with you?
You cling to worldly pleasures like a greedy moth.
Dwell upon the Lord's Name in your heart.
O Nanak, thus you shall return to your home with honor. ||4||

lines.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਵਖਰ ਕਉ ਲੈਨਿ ਤੂ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.r: jis vakhar kau lain too aaiaa ||
lines.ht: जिसु वखर कउ लैनि तू आइआ ॥
lines.e: This merchandise, which you have come to obtai
n - the Lord's Name is obtained in the home of the Saints.

lines.g: ਤਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਲੇਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੋਲਿ ॥ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਮਹਿ ਤੋਲਿ ॥
lines.r: taj abhimaan leh man mol || raam naam hiradhe meh tol ||
lines.ht: तजि अभिमानु लेहु मन मोलि ॥ राम नामु हिरदे महि तोलि ॥
lines.e: Renounce your egotistical pride, and with your mind, purchase the Lord's Name - measure it out within your heart.
Load up this merchandise, and set out with the Saints.
Give up other corrupt entanglements.
"Blessed, blessed", everyone will call you,
and your face shall be radiant in the Court of the Lord.
In this trade, only a few are trading.
Nanak is forever a sacrifice to them. ||5||

lines.g: ਚਰਨ ਸਾਧ ਕੇ ਧੋਇ ਧੋਇ ਪੀਉ ॥
lines.r: charan saadh ke dhoi dhoi peeau ||
lines.ht: चरन साध के धोइ धोइ पीउ ॥
lines.e: Wash the feet of the Holy, and drink in this water.
Dedicate your soul to the Holy.
Take your cleansing bath in the dust of the feet of the Holy.
To the Holy, make your life a sacrifice.
Service to the Holy is obtained by great good fortune.
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise is sung.
From all sorts of dangers, the Saint saves us.

lines.g: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੈ ॥
lines.r: har gun gai a(n)mirat ras chaakhai ||
lines.ht: हरि गुन गाइ अंमृत रसु चाखै ॥
lines.e: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, we taste the ambrosial essence.
Seeking the Protection of the Saints, we have come to their door.
All comforts, O Nanak, are so obtained. ||6||
He infuses life back into the dead.
He gives food to the hungry.

lines.g: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.r: sarab nidhaan jaa kee dhirasaTee maeh ||
lines.ht: सरब निधान जा की दृसटी माहि ॥
lines.e: All treasures are within His Glance of Grace.
People obtain that which they are pre-ordained to receive.

lines.g: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਓਹੁ ਕਰਨੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
lines.r: sabh kichh tis kaa oh karanai jog ||
lines.ht: सभु किछु तिस का ओहु करनै जोगु ॥
lines.e: All things are His; He is the Doer of all.

lines.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਸਰ ਹੋਆ ਨ ਹੋਗੁ ॥
lines.r: tis bin dhoosar hoaa na hog ||
lines.ht: तिसु बिनु दूसर होआ न होगु ॥
lines.e: Other than Him, there has never been any other, and there shall never be.

lines.g: ਜਪਿ ਜਨ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣੀ ॥
lines.r: jap jan sadhaa sadhaa dhin rainee ||
lines.ht: जपि जन सदा सदा दिनु रैणी ॥
lines.e: Meditate on Him forever and ever, day and night.

lines.g: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਇਹ ਕਰਣੀ ॥
lines.r: sabh te uooch niramal ieh karanee ||
lines.ht: सभ ते ऊच निरमल इह करणी ॥
lines.e: This way of life is exalted and immaculate.

lines.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ ॥
lines.r: kar kirapaa jis kau naam dheeaa ||
lines.ht: करि किरपा जिस कउ नामु दीआ ॥
lines.e: One whom the Lord, in His Grace, blesses with His Name
- O Nanak, that person becomes immaculate and pure. ||7||

lines.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ॥
lines.r: jaa kai man gur kee parateet ||
lines.ht: जा कै मनि गुर की परतीति ॥
lines.e: One who has faith in the Guru in his mind

lines.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
lines.r: tis jan aavai har prabh cheet ||
lines.ht: तिसु जन आवै हरि प्रभु चीति ॥
lines.e: comes to dwell upon the Lord God.
He is acclaimed as a devotee, a humble devotee throughout the three worlds.
The One Lord is in his heart.

lines.g: ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਰਹਤ ॥
lines.r: sach karanee sach taa kee rahat ||
lines.ht: सचु करणी सचु ता की रहत ॥
lines.e: True are his actions; true are his ways.
True is his heart; Truth is what he speaks with his mouth.
True is his vision; true is his form.
He distributes Truth and he spreads Truth.
One who recognizes the Supreme Lord God as True
- O Nanak, that humble being is absorbed into the True One. ||8||15||
Shalok:

lines.g: ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਿੰਨ ॥
lines.r: roop na rekh na ra(n)g kichh tirahu gun te prabh bhi(n)n ||
lines.ht: रूपु न रेख न रंगु किछु तृहु गुण ते प्रभ भिंन ॥
lines.e: He has no form, no shape, no color; God is beyond the three qualities.

lines.g: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ॥੧॥
lines.r: tiseh bujhaae naanakaa jis hovai suprasa(n)n ||1||
lines.ht: तिसहि बुझाए नानका जिसु होवै सुप्रसंन ॥१॥
lines.e: They alone understand Him, O Nanak, with whom He is pleased. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
Keep the Immortal Lord God enshrined within your mind.
Renounce your love and attachment to people.

lines.g: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਪਰੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.r: tis te parai naahee kichh koi ||
lines.ht: तिस ते परै नाही किछु कोइ ॥
lines.e: Beyond Him, there is nothing at all.
The One Lord is pervading among all.
He Himself is All-seeing; He Himself is All-knowing,
Unfathomable, Profound, Deep and All-knowing.
He is the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, the Lord of the Universe,
the Treasure of mercy, compassion and forgiveness.
To fall at the Feet of Your Holy Beings
- this is the longing of Nanak's mind. ||1||
The one who fulfills wishes and gives us Sanctuary.
That which He has written, comes to pass.

lines.g: ਹਰਨ ਭਰਨ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਫੋਰੁ ॥
lines.r: haran bharan jaa kaa netr for ||
lines.ht: हरन भरन जा का नेत्र फोरु ॥
lines.e: He destroys and creates in the blink of an eye.

lines.g: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਹੋਰੁ ॥
lines.r: tis kaa ma(n)tr na jaanai hor ||
lines.ht: तिस का मंत्रु न जानै होरु ॥
lines.e: No one else knows the mystery of His ways.

lines.g: ਅਨਦ ਰੂਪ ਮੰਗਲ ਸਦ ਜਾ ਕੈ ॥
lines.r: anadh roop ma(n)gal sadh jaa kai ||
lines.ht: अनद रूप मंगल सद जा कै ॥
lines.e: He is the embodiment of ecstasy and everlasting joy.

lines.g: ਸਰਬ ਥੋਕ ਸੁਨੀਅਹਿ ਘਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥
lines.r: sarab thok sune'eeh ghar taa kai ||
lines.ht: सरब थोक सुनीअहि घरि ता कै ॥
lines.e: I have heard that all things are in His home.

lines.g: ਰਾਜ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਗੀ ॥
lines.r: raaj meh raaj jog meh jogee ||
lines.ht: राज महि राजु जोग महि जोगी ॥
lines.e: Among kings, He is the King; among yogis, He is the Yogi.

lines.g: ਤਪ ਮਹਿ ਤਪੀਸਰੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਸਤ ਮਹਿ ਭੋਗੀ ॥
lines.r: tap meh tapeesar girahasat meh bhogee ||
lines.ht: तप महि तपीसरु गृहसत महि भोगी ॥
lines.e: Among ascetics, He is the Ascetic; among householders, He is the Consummator.
By the constant practice of meditation, His devotee finds peace.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਾ ਕਿਨੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.r: naanak tis purakh kaa kinai a(n)t na paiaa ||2||
lines.ht: नानक तिसु पुरख का किनै अंतु न पाइआ ॥२॥
lines.e: O Nanak, no one has found the limits of that Supreme Being. ||2||

lines.g: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਲੀਲਾ ਕੀ ਮਿਤਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
lines.r: jaa kee leelaa kee mit naeh ||
lines.ht: जा की लीला की मिति नाहि ॥
lines.e: There is no limit to His play.
All the demigods have grown weary of searching for it.

lines.g: ਪਿਤਾ ਕਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਕਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਪੂਤੁ ॥
lines.r: pitaa kaa janam k jaanai poot ||
lines.ht: पिता का जनमु कि जानै पूतु ॥
lines.e: What does the son know of his father's birth?
All are strung upon His string.

lines.g: ਸੁਮਤਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਜਿਨ ਦੇਇ ॥ ਜਨ ਦਾਸ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਸੇਇ ॥
lines.r: sumat giaan dhiaan jin dhei || jan dhaas naam dhiaaveh sei ||
lines.ht: सुमति गिआनु धिआनु जिन देइ ॥ जन दास नामु धिआवहि सेइ ॥
lines.e: He bestows good sense, spiritual wisdom and meditation on His humble servants and slaves who meditate on the Naam.

lines.g: ਤਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਰਮਾਏ ॥
lines.r: tih gun meh jaa kau bharamaae ||
lines.ht: तिहु गुण महि जा कउ भरमाए ॥
lines.e: He leads some astray in the three qualities;
they are born and die, coming and going over and over again.
The high and the low are His places.
As He inspires us to know Him, O Nanak, so is He known. ||3||

lines.g: ਨਾਨਾ ਰੂਪ ਨਾਨਾ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਰੰਗ ॥
lines.r: naanaa roop naanaa jaa ke ra(n)g ||
lines.ht: नाना रूप नाना जा के रंग ॥
lines.e: Many are His forms; many are His colors.
Many are the appearances which He assumes, and yet He is still the One.
In so many ways, He has extended Himself.
The Eternal Lord God is the One, the Creator.
He performs His many plays in an instant.
The Perfect Lord is pervading all places.
In so many ways, He created the creation.
He alone can estimate His worth.

lines.g: ਸਭ ਘਟ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਸਭ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਠਾਉ ॥
lines.r: sabh ghaT tis ke sabh tis ke Thaau ||
lines.ht: सभ घट तिस के सभ तिस के ठाउ ॥
lines.e: All hearts are His, and all places are His.

lines.g: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥
lines.r: jap jap jeevai naanak har naau ||4||
lines.ht: जपि जपि जीवै नानक हरि नाउ ॥४॥
lines.e: Nanak lives by chanting, chanting the Name of the Lord. ||4||
The Naam is the Support of all creatures.
The Naam is the Support of the earth and solar systems.

lines.g: ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਧਾਰੇ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ॥
lines.r: naam ke dhaare simirat bedh puraan ||
lines.ht: नाम के धारे सिमृति बेद पुरान ॥
lines.e: The Naam is the Support of the Simritees, the Vedas and the Puraanas.

lines.g: ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਧਾਰੇ ਸੁਨਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ॥
lines.r: naam ke dhaare sunan giaan dhiaan ||
lines.ht: नाम के धारे सुनन गिआन धिआन ॥
lines.e: The Naam is the Support by which we hear of spiritual wisdom and meditation.
The Naam is the Support of the Akaashic ethers and the nether regions.
The Naam is the Support of all bodies.

lines.g: ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਧਾਰੇ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਸਭ ਭਵਨ ॥
lines.r: naam ke dhaare pureeaa sabh bhavan ||
lines.ht: नाम के धारे पुरीआ सभ भवन ॥
lines.e: The Naam is the Support of all worlds and realms.

lines.g: ਨਾਮ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਰੇ ਸੁਨਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ॥
lines.r: naam kai sa(n)g udhare sun sravan ||
lines.ht: नाम कै संगि उधरे सुनि स्रवन ॥
lines.e: Associating with the Naam, listening to it with the ears, one is saved.

lines.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਨੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.r: kar kirapaa jis aapanai naam laae ||
lines.ht: करि किरपा जिसु आपनै नामि लाए ॥
lines.e: Those whom the Lord mercifully attaches to His Naam

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਉਥੇ ਪਦ ਮਹਿ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੫॥
lines.r: naanak chauthe padh meh so jan gat paae ||5||
lines.ht: नानक चउथे पद महि सो जनु गति पाए ॥५॥
lines.e: - O Nanak, in the fourth state, those humble servants attain salvation. ||5||

lines.g: ਰੂਪੁ ਸਤਿ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਸਤਿ ਅਸਥਾਨੁ ॥
lines.r: roop sat jaa kaa sat asathaan ||
lines.ht: रूपु सति जा का सति असथानु ॥
lines.e: His form is true, and true is His place.
His personality is true - He alone is supreme.

lines.g: ਕਰਤੂਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
lines.r: karatoot sat sat jaa kee baanee ||
lines.ht: करतूति सति सति जा की बाणी ॥
lines.e: His acts are true, and true is His Word.
The True Lord is permeating all.

lines.g: ਸਤਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਸਤਿ ॥
lines.r: sat karam jaa kee rachanaa sat ||
lines.ht: सति करमु जा की रचना सति ॥
lines.e: True are His actions; His creation is true.
His root is true, and true is what originates from it.
True is His lifestyle, the purest of the pure.
All goes well for those who know Him.
The True Name of God is the Giver of peace.

lines.g: ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸੁ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ॥੬॥
lines.r: bisavaiaas sat naanak gur te paiee ||6||
lines.ht: बिस्वासु सति नानक गुर ते पाई ॥६॥
lines.e: Nanak has obtained true faith from the Guru. ||6||
True are the Teachings, and the Instructions of the Holy.

lines.g: ਸਤਿ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸ ॥
lines.r: sat te jan jaa kai ridhai praves ||
lines.ht: सति ते जन जा कै रिदै प्रवेस ॥
lines.e: True are those into whose hearts He enters.
One who knows and loves the Truth

lines.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.r: naam japat taa kee gat hoi ||
lines.ht: नामु जपत ता की गति होइ ॥
lines.e: chanting the Naam, he obtains salvation.
He Himself is True, and all that He has made is true.
He Himself knows His own state and condition.
He is the Creator Lord of His world.
No one else understands Him, although they may try.

lines.g: ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀ ਮਿਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੀਆ ॥
lines.r: karate kee mit na jaanai keeaa ||
lines.ht: करते की मिति न जानै कीआ ॥
lines.e: The created cannot know the extent of the Creator.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਵਰਤੀਆ ॥੭॥
lines.r: naanak jo tis bhaavai so varateeaa ||7||
lines.ht: नानक जो तिसु भावै सो वरतीआ ॥७॥
lines.e: O Nanak, whatever pleases Him comes to pass. ||7||
Gazing upon His wondrous wonder, I am wonder-struck and amazed!
One who realizes this, comes to taste this state of joy.

lines.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਚਿ ਜਨ ਰਹੇ ॥
lines.r: prabh kai ra(n)g raach jan rahe ||
lines.ht: प्रभ कै रंगि राचि जन रहे ॥
lines.e: God's humble servants remain absorbed in His Love.
Following the Guru's Teachings, they receive the four cardinal blessings.
They are the givers, the dispellers of pain.
In their company, the world is saved.
The slave of the Lord's servant is so very blessed.

lines.g: ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
lines.r: jan kai sa(n)g ek liv laagee ||
lines.ht: जन कै संगि एक लिव लागी ॥
lines.e: In the company of His servant, one becomes attached to the Love of the One.
His humble servant sings the Kirtan, the songs of the glory of God.
By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, he receives the fruits of his rewards. ||8||16||
Shalok:
True in the beginning, True throughout the ages,

lines.g: ਹੈ ਭਿ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹੋਸੀ ਭਿ ਸਚੁ ॥੧॥
lines.r: hai bh sach naanak hosee bh sach ||1||
lines.ht: है भि सचु नानक होसी भि सचु ॥१॥
lines.e: True here and now. O Nanak, He shall forever be True. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
His Lotus Feet are True, and True are those who touch Them.
His devotional worship is True, and True are those who worship Him.
The Blessing of His Vision is True, and True are those who behold it.
His Naam is True, and True are those who meditate on it.
He Himself is True, and True is all that He sustains.
He Himself is virtuous goodness, and He Himself is the Bestower of virtue.
The Word of His Shabad is True, and True are those who speak of God.
Those ears are True, and True are those who listen to His Praises.
All is True to one who understands.
O Nanak, True, True is He, the Lord God. ||1||
One who believes in the Embodiment of Truth with all his heart
recognizes the Cause of causes as the Root of all.

lines.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.r: jaa kai ridhai bisavaiaas prabh aaiaa ||
lines.ht: जा कै रिदै बिस्वासु प्रभ आइआ ॥
lines.e: One whose heart is filled with faith in God
the essence of spiritual wisdom is revealed to his mind.
Coming out of fear, he comes to live without fear.

lines.g: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
lines.r: jis te upajiaa tis maeh samaanaa ||
lines.ht: जिस ते उपजिआ तिसु माहि समाना ॥
lines.e: He is absorbed into the One, from whom he originated.
When something blends with its own,

lines.g: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਭਿੰਨ ਨ ਕਹਨਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.r: taa kau bhi(n)n na kahanaa jaiee ||
lines.ht: ता कउ भिंन न कहना जाई ॥
lines.e: it cannot be said to be separate from it.
This is understood only by one of discerning understanding.
Meeting with the Lord, O Nanak, he becomes one with Him. ||2||
The servant is obedient to his Lord and Master.
The servant worships his Lord and Master forever.

lines.g: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ॥
lines.r: Thaakur ke sevak kai man parateet ||
lines.ht: ठाकुर के सेवक कै मनि परतीति ॥
lines.e: The servant of the Lord Master has faith in his mind.

lines.g: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
lines.r: Thaakur ke sevak kee niramal reet ||
lines.ht: ठाकुर के सेवक की निरमल रीति ॥
lines.e: The servant of the Lord Master lives a pure lifestyle.
The servant of the Lord Master knows that the Lord is with him.

lines.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਨਾਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
lines.r: prabh kaa sevak naam kai ra(n)g ||
lines.ht: प्रभ का सेवकु नाम कै रंगि ॥
lines.e: God's servant is attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
God is the Cherisher of His servant.
The Formless Lord preserves His servant.

lines.g: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਦਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
lines.r: so sevak jis dhiaa prabh dhaarai ||
lines.ht: सो सेवकु जिसु दइआ प्रभु धारै ॥
lines.e: Unto His servant, God bestows His Mercy.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਮਾਰੈ ॥੩॥
lines.r: naanak so sevak saas saas samaarai ||3||
lines.ht: नानक सो सेवकु सासि सासि समारै ॥३॥
lines.e: O Nanak, that servant remembers Him with each and every breath. ||3||
He covers the faults of His servant.
He surely preserves the honor of His servant.
He blesses His slave with greatness.
He inspires His servant to chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.g: ਅਪਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਆਪਿ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
lines.r: apane sevak kee aap pat raakhai ||
lines.ht: अपने सेवक की आपि पति राखै ॥
lines.e: He Himself preserves the honor of His servant.

lines.g: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਲਾਖੈ ॥
lines.r: taa kee gat mit koi na laakhai ||
lines.ht: ता की गति मिति कोइ न लाखै ॥
lines.e: No one knows His state and extent.

lines.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਕੋ ਨ ਪਹੂਚੈ ॥
lines.r: prabh ke sevak kau ko na pahoochai ||
lines.ht: प्रभ के सेवक कउ को न पहूचै ॥
lines.e: No one is equal to the servant of God.

lines.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਊਚ ਤੇ ਊਚੇ ॥
lines.r: prabh ke sevak uooch te uooche ||
lines.ht: प्रभ के सेवक ऊच ते ऊचे ॥
lines.e: The servant of God is the highest of the high.
One whom God applies to His own service, O Nanak

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
lines.r: naanak so sevak dheh dhis pragaTaiaa ||4||
lines.ht: नानक सो सेवकु दह दिसि प्रगटाइआ ॥४॥
lines.e: - that servant is famous in the ten directions. ||4||
He infuses His Power into the tiny ant;
it can then reduce the armies of millions to ashes

lines.g: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾਸੁ ਨ ਕਾਢਤ ਆਪਿ ॥
lines.r: jis kaa saas na kaaddat aap ||
lines.ht: जिस का सासु न काढत आपि ॥
lines.e: Those whose breath of life He Himself does not take away

lines.g: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਰਾਖਤ ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਥ ॥
lines.r: taa kau raakhat dhe kar haath ||
lines.ht: ता कउ राखत दे करि हाथ ॥
lines.e: He preserves them, and holds out His Hands to protect them.
You may make all sorts of efforts,
but these attempts are in vain.

lines.g: ਮਾਰੈ ਨ ਰਾਖੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.r: maarai na raakhai avar na koi ||
lines.ht: मारै न राखै अवरु न कोइ ॥
lines.e: No one else can kill or preserve
He is the Protector of all beings.
So why are you so anxious, O mortal?
Meditate, O Nanak, on God, the invisible, the wonderful! ||5||
Time after time, again and again, meditate on God.

lines.g: ਪੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਧ੍ਰਪੀਐ ॥
lines.r: pee a(n)mrit ih man tan dhrapeeaai ||
lines.ht: पी अंमृतु इहु मनु तनु ध्रपीऐ ॥
lines.e: Drinking in this Nectar, this mind and body are satisfied.
The jewel of the Naam is obtained by the Gurmukhs;
they see no other than God.
Unto them, the Naam is wealth, the Naam is beauty and delight.

lines.g: ਨਾਮੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
lines.r: naamo sukh har naam kaa sa(n)g ||
lines.ht: नामो सुखु हरि नाम का संगु ॥
lines.e: The Naam is peace, the Lord's Name is their companion.
Those who are satisfied by the essence of the Naam
their minds and bodies are drenched with the Naam.
While standing up, sitting down and sleeping, the Naam,

lines.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਕਾਮ ॥੬॥
lines.r: kahu naanak jan kai sadh kaam ||6||
lines.ht: कहु नानक जन कै सद काम ॥६॥
lines.e: says Nanak, is forever the occupation of God's humble servant. ||6||
Chant His Praises with your tongue, day and night.
God Himself has given this gift to His servants.
Performing devotional worship with heart-felt love,
they remain absorbed in God Himself.
They know the past and the present.
They recognize God's Own Command.
Who can describe His Glory?

lines.g: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਗੁਨੁ ਕਹਿ ਏਕ ਨ ਜਾਨਉ ॥
lines.r: tis kaa gun keh ek na jaanau ||
lines.ht: तिस का गुनु कहि एक न जानउ ॥
lines.e: I cannot describe even one of His virtuous qualities.
Those who dwell in God's Presence, twenty-four hours a day
- says Nanak, they are the perfect persons. ||7||

lines.g: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਲੇਹਿ ॥
lines.r: man mere tin kee oT leh ||
lines.ht: मन मेरे तिन की ओट लेहि ॥
lines.e: O my mind, seek their protection;

lines.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਤਿਨ ਜਨ ਦੇਹਿ ॥
lines.r: man tan apanaa tin jan dheh ||
lines.ht: मनु तनु अपना तिन जन देहि ॥
lines.e: give your mind and body to those humble beings.
Those humble beings who recognizes God

lines.g: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸਰਬ ਥੋਕ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
lines.r: so jan sarab thok kaa dhaataa ||
lines.ht: सो जनु सरब थोक का दाता ॥
lines.e: are the givers of all things.

lines.g: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
lines.r: tis kee saran sarab sukh paaveh ||
lines.ht: तिस की सरनि सरब सुख पावहि ॥
lines.e: In His Sanctuary, all comforts are obtained.

lines.g: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਦਰਸਿ ਸਭ ਪਾਪ ਮਿਟਾਵਹਿ ॥
lines.r: tis kai dharas sabh paap miTaaveh ||
lines.ht: तिस कै दरसि सभ पाप मिटावहि ॥
lines.e: By the Blessing of His Darshan, all sins are erased.
So renounce all other clever devices,

lines.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਤੂ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੁ ॥
lines.r: tis jan kee too sevaa laag ||
lines.ht: तिसु जन की तू सेवा लागु ॥
lines.e: and enjoin yourself to the service of those servants.
Your comings and goings shall be ended.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਪੂਜਹੁ ਸਦ ਪੈਰਾ ॥੮॥੧੭॥
lines.r: naanak tis jan ke poojahu sadh pairaa ||8||17||
lines.ht: नानक तिसु जन के पूजहु सद पैरा ॥८॥१७॥
lines.e: O Nanak, worship the feet of God's humble servants forever. ||8||17||
Shalok:

lines.g: ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.r: sat purakh jin jaaniaa satigur tis kaa naau ||
lines.ht: सति पुरखु जिनि जानिआ सतिगुरु तिस का नाउ ॥
lines.e: The one who knows the True Lord God, is called the True Guru.

lines.g: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਿਖੁ ਉਧਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥
lines.r: tis kai sa(n)g sikh udharai naanak har gun gaau ||1||
lines.ht: तिस कै संगि सिखु उधरै नानक हरि गुन गाउ ॥१॥
lines.e: In His Company, the Sikh is saved, O Nanak, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
The True Guru cherishes His Sikh.
The Guru is always merciful to His servant.

lines.g: ਸਿਖ ਕੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਲੁ ਹਿਰੈ ॥
lines.r: sikh kee gur dhuramat mal hirai ||
lines.ht: सिख की गुरु दुरमति मलु हिरै ॥
lines.e: The Guru washes away the filth of the evil intellect of His Sikh.
Through the Guru's Teachings, he chants the Lord's Name.
The True Guru cuts away the bonds of His Sikh.

lines.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਿਖੁ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਤੇ ਹਾਟੈ ॥
lines.r: gur kaa sikh bikaar te haaTai ||
lines.ht: गुर का सिखु बिकार ते हाटै ॥
lines.e: The Sikh of the Guru abstains from evil deeds.

lines.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਕਉ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.r: satigur sikh kau naam dhan dhei ||
lines.ht: सतिगुरु सिख कउ नाम धनु देइ ॥
lines.e: The True Guru gives His Sikh the wealth of the Naam.
The Sikh of the Guru is very fortunate.

lines.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਕਾ ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਸਵਾਰੈ ॥
lines.r: satigur sikh kaa halat palat savaarai ||
lines.ht: सतिगुरु सिख का हलतु पलतु सवारै ॥
lines.e: The True Guru arranges this world and the next for His Sikh.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਕਉ ਜੀਅ ਨਾਲਿ ਸਮਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.r: naanak satigur sikh kau jeea naal samaarai ||1||
lines.ht: नानक सतिगुरु सिख कउ जीअ नालि समारै ॥१॥
lines.e: O Nanak, with the fullness of His heart, the True Guru mends His Sikh. ||1||

lines.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜੋ ਰਹੈ ॥
lines.r: gur kai gireh sevak jo rahai ||
lines.ht: गुर कै गृहि सेवकु जो रहै ॥
lines.e: That selfless servant, who lives in the Guru's household,

lines.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਹੈ ॥
lines.r: gur kee aagiaa man meh sahai ||
lines.ht: गुर की आगिआ मन महि सहै ॥
lines.e: is to obey the Guru's Commands with all his mind.

lines.g: ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਕਰਿ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਜਨਾਵੈ ॥
lines.r: aapas kau kar kachh na janaavai ||
lines.ht: आपस कउ करि कछु न जनावै ॥
lines.e: He is not to call attention to himself in any way.

lines.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਦ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
lines.r: har har naam ridhai sadh dhiaavai ||
lines.ht: हरि हरि नामु रिदै सद धिआवै ॥
lines.e: He is to meditate constantly within his heart on the Name of the Lord.
One who sells his mind to the True Guru
- that humble servant's affairs are resolved.
One who performs selfless service, without thought of reward,
shall attain his Lord and Master.
He Himself grants His Grace;

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਲੇਇ ॥੨॥
lines.r: naanak so sevak gur kee mat lei ||2||
lines.ht: नानक सो सेवकु गुर की मति लेइ ॥२॥
lines.e: O Nanak, that selfless servant lives the Guru's Teachings. ||2||

lines.g: ਬੀਸ ਬਿਸਵੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
lines.r: bees bisave gur kaa man maanai ||
lines.ht: बीस बिसवे गुर का मनु मानै ॥
lines.e: One who obeys the Guru's Teachings one hundred per cent

lines.g: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
lines.r: so sevak paramesur kee gat jaanai ||
lines.ht: सो सेवकु परमेसुर की गति जानै ॥
lines.e: that selfless servant comes to know the state of the Transcendent Lord.

lines.g: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.r: so satigur jis ridhai har naau ||
lines.ht: सो सतिगुरु जिसु रिदै हरि नाउ ॥
lines.e: The True Guru's Heart is filled with the Name of the Lord.

lines.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਰ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
lines.r: anik baar gur kau bal jaau ||
lines.ht: अनिक बार गुर कउ बलि जाउ ॥
lines.e: So many times, I am a sacrifice to the Guru.
He is the treasure of everything, the Giver of life.
Twenty-four hours a day, He is imbued with the Love of the Supreme Lord God.

lines.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮਹਿ ਜਨੁ ਜਨ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ॥
lines.r: braham meh jan jan meh paarabraham ||
lines.ht: ब्रहम महि जनु जन महि पारब्रहमु ॥
lines.e: The servant is in God, and God is in the servant.
He Himself is One - there is no doubt about this.
By thousands of clever tricks, He is not found.
O Nanak, such a Guru is obtained by the greatest good fortune. ||3||
Blessed is His Darshan; receiving it, one is purified.
Touching His Feet, one's conduct and lifestyle become pure.
Abiding in His Company, one chants the Lord's Praise,
and reaches the Court of the Supreme Lord God.
Listening to His Teachings, one's ears are satisfied.
The mind is contented, and the soul is fulfilled.

lines.g: ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਖੵਓ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ॥
lines.r: pooraa gur akhayeo jaa kaa ma(n)tr ||
lines.ht: पूरा गुरु अख्यओ जा का मंत्र ॥
lines.e: The Guru is perfect; His Teachings are everlasting.
Beholding His Ambrosial Glance, one becomes saintly.
Endless are His virtuous qualities; His worth cannot be appraised.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੪॥
lines.r: naanak jis bhaavai tis le milai ||4||
lines.ht: नानक जिसु भावै तिसु लए मिलाइ ॥४॥
lines.e: O Nanak, one who pleases Him is united with Him. ||4||
The tongue is one, but His Praises are many.

lines.g: ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਪੂਰਨ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥ ਕਾਹੂ ਬੋਲ ਨ ਪਹੁਚਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ॥
lines.r: sat purakh pooran bibek || kaahoo bol na pahuchat praanee ||
lines.ht: सति पुरख पूरन बिबेक ॥ काहू बोल न पहुचत प्रानी ॥
lines.e: The True Lord, of perfect perfection - no speech can take the mortal to Him.
God is Inaccessible, Incomprehensible, balanced in the state of Nirvaanaa.
He is not sustained by food; He has no hatred or vengeance; He is the Giver of peace.

lines.g: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.r: taa kee keemat kinai na paiee ||
lines.ht: ता की कीमति किनै न पाई ॥
lines.e: No one can estimate His worth.
Countless devotees continually bow in reverence to Him.
In their hearts, they meditate on His Lotus Feet.
Nanak is forever a sacrifice to the True Guru;

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਐਸਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਪਨੇ ॥੫॥
lines.r: naanak jis prasaadh aaisaa prabh japane ||5||
lines.ht: नानक जिसु प्रसादि ऐसा प्रभु जपने ॥५॥
lines.e: by His Grace, he meditates on God. ||5||

lines.g: ਇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.r: eih har ras paavai jan koi ||
lines.ht: इहु हरि रसु पावै जनु कोइ ॥
lines.e: Only a few obtain this ambrosial essence of the Lord's Name.
Drinking in this Nectar, one becomes immortal.

lines.g: ਉਸੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਦੇ ਬਿਨਾਸ ॥ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਗੁਨਤਾਸ ॥
lines.r: aus purakh kaa naahee kadhe binaas || jaa kai man pragaTe gunataas ||
lines.ht: उसु पुरख का नाही कदे बिनास ॥ जा कै मनि प्रगटे गुनतास ॥
lines.e: That person whose mind is illuminated by the treasure of excellence, never dies.

lines.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਇ ॥
lines.r: aaTh pahar har kaa naam lei ||
lines.ht: आठ पहर हरि का नामु लेइ ॥
lines.e: Twenty-four hours a day, he takes the Name of the Lord.
The Lord gives true instruction to His servant.

lines.g: ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਲੇਪੁ ॥
lines.r: moh maiaa kai sa(n)g na lep ||
lines.ht: मोह माइआ कै संगि न लेपु ॥
lines.e: He is not polluted by emotional attachment to Maya.

lines.g: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ॥
lines.r: man meh raakhai har har ek ||
lines.ht: मन महि राखै हरि हरि एकु ॥
lines.e: In his mind, he cherishes the One Lord, Har, Har.
In the pitch darkness, a lamp shines forth.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਦੁਖ ਤਹ ਤੇ ਨਾਸੇ ॥੬॥
lines.r: naanak bharam moh dhukh teh te naase ||6||
lines.ht: नानक भरम मोह दुख तह ते नासे ॥६॥
lines.e: O Nanak, doubt, emotional attachment and pain are erased. ||6||
In the burning heat, a soothing coolness prevails.
Happiness ensues and pain departs, O Siblings of Destiny.
The fear of birth and death is dispelled,
by the perfect Teachings of the Holy Saint.
Fear is lifted, and one abides in fearlessness.

lines.g: ਸਗਲ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਖੈ ਨਸੇ ॥
lines.r: sagal biaadh man te khai nase ||
lines.ht: सगल बिआधि मन ते खै नसे ॥
lines.e: All evils are dispelled from the mind.

lines.g: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
lines.r: jis kaa saa tin kirapaa dhaaree ||
lines.ht: जिस का सा तिनि किरपा धारी ॥
lines.e: He takes us into His favor as His own.
In the Company of the Holy, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
Stability is attained; doubt and wandering cease,

lines.g: ਸੁਨਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ॥੭॥
lines.r: sun naanak har har jas sravan ||7||
lines.ht: सुनि नानक हरि हरि जसु स्रवन ॥७॥
lines.e: O Nanak, listening with one's ears to the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||7||
He Himself is absolute and unrelated; He Himself is also involved and related.
Manifesting His power, He fascinates the entire world.
God Himself sets His play in motion.
Only He Himself can estimate His worth.
There is none, other than the Lord.
Permeating all, He is the One.
Through and through, He pervades in form and color.
He is revealed in the Company of the Holy.
Having created the creation, He infuses His own power into it.
So many times, Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||8||18||
Shalok:

lines.g: ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸਗਲੀ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
lines.r: saath na chaalai bin bhajan bikhiaa sagalee chhaar ||
lines.ht: साथि न चालै बिनु भजन बिखिआ सगली छारु ॥
lines.e: Nothing shall go along with you, except your devotion. All corruption is like ashes.

lines.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਮਾਵਨਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.r: har har naam kamaavanaa naanak ih dhan saar ||1||
lines.ht: हरि हरि नामु कमावना नानक इहु धनु सारु ॥१॥
lines.e: Practice the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. O Nanak, this is the most excellent wealth. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
Joining the Company of the Saints, practice deep meditation.
Remember the One, and take the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
Forget all other efforts, O my friend

lines.g: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਿਦ ਮਹਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਹੁ ॥
lines.r: charan kamal ridh meh ur dhaarahu ||
lines.ht: चरन कमल रिद महि उरि धारहु ॥
lines.e: - enshrine the Lord's Lotus Feet within your heart.
God is All-powerful; He is the Cause of causes.

lines.g: ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਗਹਹੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਵਥੁ ॥
lines.r: dhiraR kar gahahu naam har vath ||
lines.ht: दृड़ु करि गहहु नामु हरि वथु ॥
lines.e: Grasp firmly the object of the Lord's Name.
Gather this wealth, and become very fortunate.
Pure are the instructions of the humble Saints.
Keep faith in the One Lord within your mind.
All disease, O Nanak, shall then be dispelled. ||1||

lines.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਧਨ ਕਉ ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਵਹਿ ॥
lines.r: jis dhan kau chaar ku(n)T uTh dhaaveh ||
lines.ht: जिसु धन कउ चारि कुँट उठि धावहि ॥
lines.e: The wealth which you chase after in the four directions

lines.g: ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
lines.r: so dhan har sevaa te paaveh ||
lines.ht: सो धनु हरि सेवा ते पावहि ॥
lines.e: you shall obtain that wealth by serving the Lord.

lines.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਸੁਖ ਕਉ ਨਿਤ ਬਾਛਹਿ ਮੀਤ ॥
lines.r: jis sukh kau nit baachheh meet ||
lines.ht: जिसु सुख कउ नित बाछहि मीत ॥
lines.e: The peace, which you always yearn for, O friend
that peace comes by the love of the Company of the Holy.

lines.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਕਉ ਕਰਹਿ ਭਲੀ ਕਰਨੀ ॥
lines.r: jis sobhaa kau kareh bhalee karanee ||
lines.ht: जिसु सोभा कउ करहि भली करनी ॥
lines.e: The glory, for which you perform good deeds

lines.g: ਸਾ ਸੋਭਾ ਭਜੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਨੀ ॥
lines.r: saa sobhaa bhaj har kee saranee ||
lines.ht: सा सोभा भजु हरि की सरनी ॥
lines.e: - you shall obtain that glory by seeking the Lord's Sanctuary.
All sorts of remedies have not cured the disease
- the disease is cured only by giving the medicine of the Lord's Name.

lines.g: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
lines.r: sarab nidhaan meh har naam nidhaan ||
lines.ht: सरब निधान महि हरि नामु निधानु ॥
lines.e: Of all treasures, the Lord's Name is the supreme treasure.
Chant it, O Nanak, and be accepted in the Court of the Lord. ||2||
Enlighten your mind with the Name of the Lord.
Having wandered around in the ten directions, it comes to its place of rest.

lines.g: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.r: taa kau bighan na laagai koi ||
lines.ht: ता कउ बिघनु न लागै कोइ ॥
lines.e: No obstacle stands in the way of one

lines.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.r: jaa kai ridhai basai har soi ||
lines.ht: जा कै रिदै बसै हरि सोइ ॥
lines.e: whose heart is filled with the Lord.
The Dark Age of Kali Yuga is so hot; the Lord's Name is soothing and cool.
Remember, remember it in meditation, and obtain everlasting peace.
Your fear shall be dispelled, and your hopes shall be fulfilled.
By devotional worship and loving adoration, your soul shall be enlightened.
You shall go to that home, and live forever.
Says Nanak, the noose of death is cut away. ||3||
One who contemplates the essence of reality, is said to be the true person.
Birth and death are the lot of the false and the insincere.
Coming and going in reincarnation is ended by serving God.
Give up your selfishness and conceit, and seek the Sanctuary of the Divine Guru.

lines.g: ਇਉ ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.r: eiau ratan janam kaa hoi udhaar ||
lines.ht: इउ रतन जनम का होइ उधारु ॥
lines.e: Thus the jewel of this human life is saved.
Remember the Lord, Har, Har, the Support of the breath of life.
By all sorts of efforts, people are not saved
not by studying the Simritees, the Shaastras or the Vedas.

lines.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.r: har kee bhagat karahu man lai ||
lines.ht: हरि की भगति करहु मनु लाइ ॥
lines.e: Worship the Lord with whole-hearted devotion.
O Nanak, you shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desire. ||4||
Your wealth shall not go with you;
why do you cling to it, you fool?
Children, friends, family and spouse

lines.g: ਇਨ ਤੇ ਕਹਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਕਵਨ ਸਨਾਥਾ ॥
lines.r: ein te kahahu tum kavan sanaathaa ||
lines.ht: इन ते कहहु तुम कवन सनाथा ॥
lines.e: who of these shall accompany you?
Power, pleasure, and the vast expanse of Maya
who has ever escaped from these?
Horses, elephants, chariots and pageantry
- false shows and false displays.

lines.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਬੁਝੈ ਨ ਬਿਗਾਨਾ ॥
lines.r: jin dhe'ee tis bujhai na bigaanaa ||
lines.ht: जिनि दीए तिसु बुझै न बिगाना ॥
lines.e: The fool does not acknowledge the One who gave this;
forgetting the Naam, O Nanak, he will repent in the end. ||5||

lines.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਤੂੰ ਲੇਹਿ ਇਆਨੇ ॥
lines.r: gur kee mat too(n) leh iaane ||
lines.ht: गुर की मति तूँ लेहि इआने ॥
lines.e: Take the Guru's advice, you ignorant fool;
without devotion, even the clever have drowned.

lines.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੀਤ ॥
lines.r: har kee bhagat karahu man meet ||
lines.ht: हरि की भगति करहु मन मीत ॥
lines.e: Worship the Lord with heart-felt devotion, my friend;
your consciousness shall become pure.
Enshrine the Lord's Lotus Feet in your mind;
the sins of countless lifetimes shall depart.
Chant the Naam yourself, and inspire others to chant it as well.
Hearing, speaking and living it, emancipation is obtained.

lines.g: ਸਾਰ ਭੂਤ ਸਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.r: saar bhoot sat har ko naau ||
lines.ht: सार भूत सति हरि को नाउ ॥
lines.e: The essential reality is the True Name of the Lord.
With intuitive ease, O Nanak, sing His Glorious Praises. ||6||
Chanting His Glories, your filth shall be washed off.
The all-consuming poison of ego will be gone.
You shall become carefree, and you shall dwell in peace.
With every breath and every morsel of food, cherish the Lord's Name.
Renounce all clever tricks, O mind.
In the Company of the Holy, you shall obtain the true wealth.
So gather the Lord's Name as your capital, and trade in it.
In this world you shall be at peace, and in the Court of the Lord, you shall be acclaimed.
See the One permeating all;

lines.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ॥੭॥
lines.r: kahu naanak jaa kai masatak lekh ||7||
lines.ht: कहु नानक जा कै मसतकि लेखु ॥७॥
lines.e: says Nanak, your destiny is pre-ordained. ||7||
Meditate on the One, and worship the One.
Remember the One, and yearn for the One in your mind.
Sing the endless Glorious Praises of the One.
