With mind and body, meditate on the One Lord God.
The One Lord Himself is the One and Only.
The Pervading Lord God is totally permeating all.
The many expanses of the creation have all come from the One.
Adoring the One, past sins are removed.

lines.g: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
lines.r: man tan a(n)tar ek prabh raataa ||
lines.ht: मन तन अंतरि एकु प्रभु राता ॥
lines.e: Mind and body within are imbued with the One God.
By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, the One is known. ||8||19||
Shalok:

lines.g: ਫਿਰਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਇਆ ਪਰਿਆ ਤਉ ਸਰਨਾਇ ॥
lines.r: firat firat prabh aaiaa pariaa tau saranai ||
lines.ht: फिरत फिरत प्रभ आइआ परिआ तउ सरनाइ ॥
lines.e: After wandering and wandering, O God, I have come, and entered Your Sanctuary.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਅਪਨੀ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.r: naanak kee prabh benatee apanee bhagatee lai ||1||
lines.ht: नानक की प्रभ बेनती अपनी भगती लाइ ॥१॥
lines.e: This is Nanak's prayer, O God: please, attach me to Your devotional service. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
I am a beggar; I beg for this gift from You:
please, by Your Mercy, Lord, give me Your Name.
I ask for the dust of the feet of the Holy.
O Supreme Lord God, please fulfill my yearning;

lines.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
lines.r: sadhaa sadhaa prabh ke gun gaavau ||
lines.ht: सदा सदा प्रभ के गुन गावउ ॥
lines.e: may I sing the Glorious Praises of God forever and ever.
With each and every breath, may I meditate on You, O God.
May I enshrine affection for Your Lotus Feet.

lines.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਨਿਤ ਨੀਤਿ ॥
lines.r: bhagat karau prabh kee nit neet ||
lines.ht: भगति करउ प्रभ की नित नीति ॥
lines.e: May I perform devotional worship to God each and every day.
You are my only Shelter, my only Support.
Nanak asks for the most sublime, the Naam, the Name of God. ||1||

lines.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.r: prabh kee dhirasaT mahaa sukh hoi ||
lines.ht: प्रभ की दृसटि महा सुखु होइ ॥
lines.e: By God's Gracious Glance, there is great peace.
Rare are those who obtain the juice of the Lord's essence.
Those who taste it are satisfied.
They are fulfilled and realized beings - they do not waver.
They are totally filled to over-flowing with the sweet delight of His Love.
Spiritual delight wells up within, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
Taking to His Sanctuary, they forsake all others.
Deep within, they are enlightened, and they center themselves on Him, day and night.
Most fortunate are those who meditate on God.
O Nanak, attuned to the Naam, they are at peace. ||2||
The wishes of the Lord's servant are fulfilled.
From the True Guru, the pure teachings are obtained.
Unto His humble servant, God has shown His kindness.
He has made His servant eternally happy.
The bonds of His humble servant are cut away, and he is liberated.
The pains of birth and death, and doubt are gone.
Desires are satisfied, and faith is fully rewarded,
imbued forever with His all-pervading peace.

lines.g: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਲੀਆ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
lines.r: jis kaa saa tin leeaa milai ||
lines.ht: जिस का सा तिनि लीआ मिलाइ ॥
lines.e: He is His - he merges in Union with Him.
Nanak is absorbed in devotional worship of the Naam. ||3||

lines.g: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਜਿ ਘਾਲ ਨ ਭਾਨੈ ॥
lines.r: so kiau bisarai j ghaal na bhaanai ||
lines.ht: सो किउ बिसरै जि घाल न भानै ॥
lines.e: Why forget Him, who does not overlook our efforts?

lines.g: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਜਿ ਕੀਆ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
lines.r: so kiau bisarai j keeaa jaanai ||
lines.ht: सो किउ बिसरै जि कीआ जानै ॥
lines.e: Why forget Him, who acknowledges what we do?

lines.g: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੀਆ ॥
lines.r: so kiau bisarai jin sabh kichh dheeaa ||
lines.ht: सो किउ बिसरै जिनि सभु किछु दीआ ॥
lines.e: Why forget Him, who has given us everything?

lines.g: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਜਿ ਜੀਵਨ ਜੀਆ ॥
lines.r: so kiau bisarai j jeevan jeeaa ||
lines.ht: सो किउ बिसरै जि जीवन जीआ ॥
lines.e: Why forget Him, who is the Life of the living beings?

lines.g: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਜਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
lines.r: so kiau bisarai j agan meh raakhai ||
lines.ht: सो किउ बिसरै जि अगनि महि राखै ॥
lines.e: Why forget Him, who preserves us in the fire of the womb?
By Guru's Grace, rare is the one who realizes this.

lines.g: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਜਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਤੇ ਕਾਢੈ ॥
lines.r: so kiau bisarai j bikh te kaaddai ||
lines.ht: सो किउ बिसरै जि बिखु ते काढै ॥
lines.e: Why forget Him, who lifts us up out of corruption?
Those separated from Him for countless lifetimes, are re-united with Him once again.
Through the Perfect Guru, this essential reality is understood.
O Nanak, God's humble servants meditate on Him. ||4||
O friends, O Saints, make this your work.
Renounce everything else, and chant the Name of the Lord.
Meditate, meditate, meditate in remembrance of Him, and find peace.
Chant the Naam yourself, and inspire others to chant it.
By loving devotional worship, you shall cross over the world-ocean.
Without devotional meditation, the body will be just ashes.
All joys and comforts are in the treasure of the Naam.
Even the drowning can reach the place of rest and safety.
All sorrows shall vanish.
O Nanak, chant the Naam, the treasure of excellence. ||5||
Love and affection, and the taste of yearning, have welled up within;
within my mind and body, this is my purpose:
beholding with my eyes His Blessed Vision, I am at peace.
My mind blossoms forth in ecstasy, washing the feet of the Holy.

lines.g: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
lines.r: bhagat janaa kai man tan ra(n)g ||
lines.ht: भगत जना कै मनि तनि रंगु ॥
lines.e: The minds and bodies of His devotees are infused with His Love.
Rare is the one who obtains their company.
Show Your mercy - please, grant me this one request:
by Guru's Grace, may I chant the Naam.

lines.g: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.r: taa kee upamaa kahee na jai ||
lines.ht: ता की उपमा कही न जाइ ॥
lines.e: His Praises cannot be spoken;
O Nanak, He is contained among all. ||6||
God, the Forgiving Lord, is kind to the poor.
He loves His devotees, and He is always merciful to them.
The Patron of the patronless, the Lord of the Universe, the Sustainer of the world,
the Nourisher of all beings.
The Primal Being, the Creator of the Creation.
The Support of the breath of life of His devotees.

lines.g: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਜਪੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਪੁਨੀਤ ॥
lines.r: jo jo japai su hoi puneet ||
lines.ht: जो जो जपै सु होइ पुनीत ॥
lines.e: Whoever meditates on Him is sanctified,
focusing the mind in loving devotional worship.
I am unworthy, lowly and ignorant.
Nanak has entered Your Sanctuary, O Supreme Lord God. ||7||
Everything is obtained: the heavens, liberation and deliverance,

lines.g: ਏਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ॥
lines.r: ek nimakh har ke gun gaae ||
lines.ht: एक निमख हरि के गुन गाए ॥
lines.e: if one sings the Lord's Glories, even for an instant.
So many realms of power, pleasures and great glories,

lines.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.r: har ke naam kee kathaa man bhaiee ||
lines.ht: हरि के नाम की कथा मनि भाई ॥
lines.e: come to one whose mind is pleased with the Sermon of the Lord's Name.
Abundant foods, clothes and music
come to one whose tongue continually chants the Lord's Name, Har, Har.
His actions are good, he is glorious and wealthy;
the Mantra of the Perfect Guru dwells within his heart.
O God, grant me a home in the Company of the Holy.
All pleasures, O Nanak, are so revealed. ||8||20||
Shalok:

lines.g: ਸਰਗੁਨ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧੀ ਆਪਿ ॥
lines.r: saragun niragun nira(n)kaar su(n)n samaadhee aap ||
lines.ht: सरगुन निरगुन निरंकार सुँन समाधी आपि ॥
lines.e: He possesses all qualities; He transcends all qualities; He is the Formless Lord. He Himself is in Primal Samaadhi.

lines.g: ਆਪਨ ਕੀਆ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੧॥
lines.r: aapan keeaa naanakaa aape hee fir jaap ||1||
lines.ht: आपन कीआ नानका आपे ही फिरि जापि ॥१॥
lines.e: Through His Creation, O Nanak, He meditates on Himself. ||1||
Ashtapadee:

lines.g: ਜਬ ਅਕਾਰੁ ਇਹੁ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੇਤਾ ॥
lines.r: jab akaar ih kachh na dhirasaTetaa ||
lines.ht: जब अकारु इहु कछु न दृसटेता ॥
lines.e: When this world had not yet appeared in any form,

lines.g: ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਤਬ ਕਹ ਤੇ ਹੋਤਾ ॥
lines.r: paap pu(n)n tab keh te hotaa ||
lines.ht: पाप पुँन तब कह ते होता ॥
lines.e: who then committed sins and performed good deeds?
When the Lord Himself was in Profound Samaadhi,

lines.g: ਤਬ ਬੈਰ ਬਿਰੋਧ ਕਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਮਾਤਿ ॥
lines.r: tab bair birodh kis sa(n)g kamaat ||
lines.ht: तब बैर बिरोध किसु संगि कमाति ॥
lines.e: then against whom were hate and jealousy directed?

lines.g: ਜਬ ਇਸ ਕਾ ਬਰਨੁ ਚਿਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਪਤ ॥
lines.r: jab is kaa baran chihan na jaapat ||
lines.ht: जब इस का बरनु चिहनु न जापत ॥
lines.e: When there was no color or shape to be seen,

lines.g: ਤਬ ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਸਹਿ ਬਿਆਪਤ ॥
lines.r: tab harakh sog kahu kiseh biaapat ||
lines.ht: तब हरख सोग कहु किसहि बिआपत ॥
lines.e: then who experienced joy and sorrow?
When the Supreme Lord Himself was Himself All-in-all,

lines.g: ਤਬ ਮੋਹ ਕਹਾ ਕਿਸੁ ਹੋਵਤ ਭਰਮ ॥
lines.r: tab moh kahaa kis hovat bharam ||
lines.ht: तब मोह कहा किसु होवत भरम ॥
lines.e: then where was emotional attachment, and who had doubts?
He Himself has staged His own drama;
O Nanak, there is no other Creator. ||1||
When there was only God the Master,

lines.g: ਤਬ ਬੰਧ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਗਨੀ ॥
lines.r: tab ba(n)dh mukat kahu kis kau ganee ||
lines.ht: तब बंध मुकति कहु किस कउ गनी ॥
lines.e: then who was called bound or liberated?
When there was only the Lord, Unfathomable and Infinite,

lines.g: ਤਬ ਨਰਕ ਸੁਰਗ ਕਹੁ ਕਉਨ ਅਉਤਾਰ ॥
lines.r: tab narak surag kahu kaun aautaar ||
lines.ht: तब नरक सुरग कहु कउन अउतार ॥
lines.e: then who entered hell, and who entered heaven?
When God was without attributes, in absolute poise,

lines.g: ਤਬ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤਿ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਠਾਇ ॥
lines.r: tab siv sakat kahahu kit Thai ||
lines.ht: तब सिव सकति कहहु कितु ठाइ ॥
lines.e: then where was mind and where was matter - where was Shiva and Shakti?

lines.g: ਜਬ ਆਪਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਅਪਨੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਧਰੈ ॥
lines.r: jab aapeh aap apanee jot dharai ||
lines.ht: जब आपहि आपि अपनी जोति धरै ॥
lines.e: When He held His Own Light unto Himself,

lines.g: ਤਬ ਕਵਨ ਨਿਡਰੁ ਕਵਨ ਕਤ ਡਰੈ ॥
lines.r: tab kavan niddar kavan kat ddarai ||
lines.ht: तब कवन निडरु कवन कत डरै ॥
lines.e: then who was fearless, and who was afraid?
He Himself is the Performer in His own plays;
O Nanak, the Lord Master is Unfathomable and Infinite. ||2||
When the Immortal Lord was seated at ease,

lines.g: ਤਹ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕਹੁ ਕਹਾ ਬਿਨਾਸਨ ॥
lines.r: teh janam maran kahu kahaa binaasan ||
lines.ht: तह जनम मरन कहु कहा बिनासन ॥
lines.e: then where was birth, death and dissolution?
When there was only God, the Perfect Creator,

lines.g: ਤਬ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.r: tab jam kee traas kahahu kis hoi ||
lines.ht: तब जम की त्रास कहहु किसु होइ ॥
lines.e: then who was afraid of death?
When there was only the One Lord, unmanifest and incomprehensible,

lines.g: ਤਬ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਪਤ ਕਿਸੁ ਪੂਛਤ ਲੇਖਾ ॥
lines.r: tab chitr gupat kis poochhat lekhaa ||
lines.ht: तब चित्र गुपत किसु पूछत लेखा ॥
lines.e: then who was called to account by the recording scribes of the conscious and the subconscious?
When there was only the Immaculate, Incomprehensible, Unfathomable Master,

lines.g: ਤਬ ਕਉਨ ਛੁਟੇ ਕਉਨ ਬੰਧਨ ਬਾਧੇ ॥
lines.r: tab kaun chhuTe kaun ba(n)dhan baadhe ||
lines.ht: तब कउन छुटे कउन बंधन बाधे ॥
lines.e: then who was emancipated, and who was held in bondage?
He Himself, in and of Himself, is the most wonderful.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਨ ਰੂਪ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਉਪਰਜਾ ॥੩॥
lines.r: naanak aapan roop aap hee uparajaa ||3||
lines.ht: नानक आपन रूप आप ही उपरजा ॥३॥
lines.e: O Nanak, He Himself created His Own Form. ||3||

lines.g: ਜਹ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਤਾ ॥
lines.r: jeh niramal purakh purakh pat hotaa ||
lines.ht: जह निरमल पुरखु पुरख पति होता ॥
lines.e: When there was only the Immaculate Being, the Lord of beings,

lines.g: ਤਹ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਧੋਤਾ ॥
lines.r: teh bin mail kahahu kiaa dhotaa ||
lines.ht: तह बिनु मैलु कहहु किआ धोता ॥
lines.e: there was no filth, so what was there to be washed clean?
When there was only the Pure, Formless Lord in Nirvaanaa,

lines.g: ਤਹ ਕਉਨ ਕਉ ਮਾਨ ਕਉਨ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ॥
lines.r: teh kaun kau maan kaun abhimaan ||
lines.ht: तह कउन कउ मान कउन अभिमान ॥
lines.e: then who was honored, and who was dishonored?
When there was only the Form of the Lord of the Universe,

lines.g: ਤਹ ਛਲ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਲਗਤ ਕਹੁ ਕੀਸ ॥
lines.r: teh chhal chhidhr lagat kahu kees ||
lines.ht: तह छल छिद्र लगत कहु कीस ॥
lines.e: then who was tainted by fraud and sin?

lines.g: ਜਹ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
lines.r: jeh jot saroopee jot sa(n)g samaavai ||
lines.ht: जह जोति सरूपी जोति संगि समावै ॥
lines.e: When the Embodiment of Light was immersed in His Own Light,
then who was hungry, and who was satisfied?
He is the Cause of causes, the Creator Lord.
O Nanak, the Creator is beyond calculation. ||4||

lines.g: ਜਬ ਅਪਨੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਆਪਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਨਾਈ ॥
lines.r: jab apanee sobhaa aapan sa(n)g banaiee ||
lines.ht: जब अपनी सोभा आपन संगि बनाई ॥
lines.e: When His Glory was contained within Himself,

lines.g: ਤਬ ਕਵਨ ਮਾਇ ਬਾਪ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਤ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.r: tab kavan mai baap mitr sut bhaiee ||
lines.ht: तब कवन माइ बाप मित्र सुत भाई ॥
lines.e: then who was mother, father, friend, child or sibling?
When all power and wisdom was latent within Him,

lines.g: ਤਹ ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਕਹਾ ਕੋਊ ਚੀਨ ॥
lines.r: teh bedh kateb kahaa kouoo cheen ||
lines.ht: तह बेद कतेब कहा कोऊ चीन ॥
lines.e: then where were the Vedas and the scriptures, and who was there to read them?

lines.g: ਜਬ ਆਪਨ ਆਪੁ ਆਪਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
lines.r: jab aapan aap aap ur dhaarai ||
lines.ht: जब आपन आपु आपि उरि धारै ॥
lines.e: When He kept Himself, All-in-all, unto His Own Heart,
then who considered omens to be good or bad?

lines.g: ਜਹ ਆਪਨ ਊਚ ਆਪਨ ਆਪਿ ਨੇਰਾ ॥
lines.r: jeh aapan uooch aapan aap neraa ||
lines.ht: जह आपन ऊच आपन आपि नेरा ॥
lines.e: When He Himself was lofty, and He Himself was near at hand,

lines.g: ਤਹ ਕਉਨ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਚੇਰਾ ॥
lines.r: teh kaun Thaakur kaun kaheeaai cheraa ||
lines.ht: तह कउन ठाकुरु कउनु कहीऐ चेरा ॥
lines.e: then who was called master, and who was called disciple?
We are wonder-struck at the wondrous wonder of the Lord.
O Nanak, He alone knows His own state. ||5||
When the Undeceiveable, Impenetrable, Inscrutable One was self-absorbed,
then who was swayed by Maya?
When He paid homage to Himself,
then the three qualities were not prevailing.
When there was only the One, the One and Only Lord God,

lines.g: ਤਹ ਕਉਨੁ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਚਿੰਤਾ ॥
lines.r: teh kaun achi(n)t kis laagai chi(n)taa ||
lines.ht: तह कउनु अचिंतु किसु लागै चिंता ॥
lines.e: then who was not anxious, and who felt anxiety?
When He Himself was satisfied with Himself,
then who spoke and who listened?
He is vast and infinite, the highest of the high.
O Nanak, He alone can reach Himself. ||6||
When He Himself fashioned the visible world of the creation,
he made the world subject to the three dispositions.
Sin and virtue then began to be spoken of.
Some have gone to hell, and some yearn for paradise.
Worldly snares and entanglements of Maya,
egotism, attachment, doubt and loads of fear;
pain and pleasure, honor and dishonor
these came to be described in various ways.
He Himself creates and beholds His own drama.
He winds up the drama, and then, O Nanak, He alone remains. ||7||
Wherever the Eternal Lord's devotee is, He Himself is there.
He unfolds the expanse of His creation for the glory of His Saint.
He Himself is the Master of both worlds.
His Praise is to Himself alone.
He Himself performs and plays His amusements and games.
He Himself enjoys pleasures, and yet He is unaffected and untouched.

lines.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਪਨ ਨਾਇ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
lines.r: jis bhaavai tis aapan nai laavai ||
lines.ht: जिसु भावै तिसु आपन नाइ लावै ॥
lines.e: He attaches whomever He pleases to His Name.
He causes whomever He pleases to play in His play.
He is beyond calculation, beyond measure, uncountable and unfathomable.

lines.g: ਜਿਉ ਬੁਲਾਵਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਬੋਲੈ ॥੮॥੨੧॥
lines.r: jiau bulaavahu tiau naanak dhaas bolai ||8||21||
lines.ht: जिउ बुलावहु तिउ नानक दास बोलै ॥८॥२१॥
lines.e: As You inspire him to speak, O Lord, so does servant Nanak speak. ||8||21||
Shalok:

lines.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਕੇ ਠਾਕੁਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਵਰਤਣਹਾਰ ॥
lines.r: jeea ja(n)t ke Thaakuraa aape varatanahaar ||
lines.ht: जीअ जंत के ठाकुरा आपे वरतणहार ॥
lines.e: O Lord and Master of all beings and creatures, You Yourself are prevailing everywhere.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੋ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਕਹ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.r: naanak eko pasariaa dhoojaa keh dhirasaTaar ||1||
lines.ht: नानक एको पसरिआ दूजा कह दृसटार ॥१॥
lines.e: O Nanak, The One is All-pervading; where is any other to be seen? ||1||
Ashtapadee:
He Himself is the speaker, and He Himself is the listener.
He Himself is the One, and He Himself is the many.

lines.g: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
lines.r: jaa tis bhaavai taa sirasaT upaae ||
lines.ht: जा तिसु भावै ता सृसटि उपाए ॥
lines.e: When it pleases Him, He creates the world.
As He pleases, He absorbs it back into Himself.

lines.g: ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਭਿੰਨ ਨਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.r: tum te bhi(n)n nahee kichh hoi ||
lines.ht: तुम ते भिंन नही किछु होइ ॥
lines.e: Without You, nothing can be done.
Upon Your thread, You have strung the whole world.

lines.g: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
lines.r: jaa kau prabh jeeau aap bujhaae ||
lines.ht: जा कउ प्रभ जीउ आपि बुझाए ॥
lines.e: One whom God Himself inspires to understand
- that person obtains the True Name.
He looks impartially upon all, and he knows the essential reality.
O Nanak, he conquers the whole world. ||1||

lines.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਸਭ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਹਾਥ ॥
lines.r: jeea ja(n)tr sabh taa kai haath ||
lines.ht: जीअ जंत्र सभ ता कै हाथ ॥
lines.e: All beings and creatures are in His Hands.
He is Merciful to the meek, the Patron of the patronless.

lines.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮਾਰੈ ॥
lines.r: jis raakhai tis koi na maarai ||
lines.ht: जिसु राखै तिसु कोइ न मारै ॥
lines.e: No one can kill those who are protected by Him.
One who is forgotten by God, is already dead.

lines.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਤਜਿ ਅਵਰ ਕਹਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.r: tis taj avar kahaa ko jai ||
lines.ht: तिसु तजि अवर कहा को जाइ ॥
lines.e: Leaving Him, where else could anyone go?
Over the heads of all is the One, the Immaculate King.

lines.g: ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਭ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
lines.r: jeea kee jugat jaa kai sabh haath ||
lines.ht: जीअ की जुगति जा कै सभ हाथि ॥
lines.e: The ways and means of all beings are in His Hands.
Inwardly and outwardly, know that He is with you.
He is the Ocean of excellence, infinite and endless.
Slave Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||
The Perfect, Merciful Lord is pervading everywhere.
His kindness extends to all.
He Himself knows His own ways.
The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is present everywhere.
He cherishes His living beings in so many ways.

lines.g: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਰਚਿਓ ਸੁ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਤਿ ॥
lines.r: jo jo rachio su tiseh dhiaat ||
lines.ht: जो जो रचिओ सु तिसहि धिआति ॥
lines.e: That which He has created meditates on Him.
Whoever pleases Him, He blends into Himself.

lines.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
lines.r: bhagat kareh har ke gun gai ||
lines.ht: भगति करहि हरि के गुण गाइ ॥
lines.e: They perform His devotional service and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
With heart-felt faith, they believe in Him.
O Nanak, they realize the One, the Creator Lord. ||3||
The Lord's humble servant is committed to His Name.

lines.g: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਨ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.r: tis kee aas na birathee jai ||
lines.ht: तिस की आस न बिरथी जाइ ॥
lines.e: His hopes do not go in vain.
The servant's purpose is to serve;
obeying the Lord's Command, the supreme status is obtained.
Beyond this, he has no other thought.
Within his mind, the Formless Lord abides.
His bonds are cut away, and he becomes free of hatred.
Night and day, he worships the Feet of the Guru.
He is at peace in this world, and happy in the next.
O Nanak, the Lord God unites him with Himself. ||4||
Join the Company of the Holy, and be happy.
Sing the Glories of God, the embodiment of supreme bliss.
Contemplate the essence of the Lord's Name.
Redeem this human body, so difficult to obtain.

lines.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਚਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥
lines.r: a(n)mirat bachan har ke gun gaau ||
lines.ht: अंमृत बचन हरि के गुन गाउ ॥
lines.e: Sing the Ambrosial Words of the Lord's Glorious Praises;
this is the way to save your mortal soul.
Behold God near at hand, twenty-four hours a day.
Ignorance shall depart, and darkness shall be dispelled.
Listen to the Teachings, and enshrine them in your heart.
O Nanak, you shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires. ||5||
Embellish both this world and the next;
enshrine the Lord's Name deep within your heart.
Perfect are the Teachings of the Perfect Guru.

lines.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਰੀਖਿਆ ॥
lines.r: jis man basai tis saach pareekhiaa ||
lines.ht: जिसु मनि बसै तिसु साचु परीखिआ ॥
lines.e: That person, within whose mind it abides, realizes the Truth.

lines.g: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.r: man tan naam japahu liv lai ||
lines.ht: मनि तनि नामु जपहु लिव लाइ ॥
lines.e: With your mind and body, chant the Naam; lovingly attune yourself to it.

lines.g: ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਭਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.r: dhookh dharadh man te bhau jai ||
lines.ht: दूखु दरदु मन ते भउ जाइ ॥
lines.e: Sorrow, pain and fear shall depart from your mind.
Deal in the true trade, O trader,
and your merchandise shall be safe in the Court of the Lord.
Keep the Support of the One in your mind.
O Nanak, you shall not have to come and go in reincarnation again. ||6||

lines.g: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਹਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.r: tis te dhoor kahaa ko jai ||
lines.ht: तिस ते दूरि कहा को जाइ ॥
lines.e: Where can anyone go, to get away from Him?
Meditating on the Protector Lord, you shall be saved.
Meditating on the Fearless Lord, all fear departs.
By God's Grace, mortals are released.

lines.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੂਖ ॥
lines.r: jis prabh raakhai tis naahee dhookh ||
lines.ht: जिसु प्रभु राखै तिसु नाही दूख ॥
lines.e: One who is protected by God never suffers in pain.
Chanting the Naam, the mind becomes peaceful.
Anxiety departs, and ego is eliminated.

lines.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਹੁਚਨਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.r: tis jan kau koi na pahuchanahaar ||
lines.ht: तिसु जन कउ कोइ न पहुचनहारु ॥
lines.e: No one can equal that humble servant.
The Brave and Powerful Guru stands over his head.
O Nanak, his efforts are fulfilled. ||7||

lines.g: ਮਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ॥
lines.r: mat pooree a(n)mrit jaa kee dhirasaT ||
lines.ht: मति पूरी अंमृतु जा की दृसटि ॥
lines.e: His wisdom is perfect, and His Glance is Ambrosial.
Beholding His Vision, the universe is saved.
His Lotus Feet are incomparably beautiful.
The Blessed Vision of His Darshan is fruitful and rewarding; His Lordly Form is beautiful.
Blessed is His service; His servant is famous.
The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is the most exalted Supreme Being.

lines.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਤ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥
lines.r: jis man basai su hot nihaal ||
lines.ht: जिसु मनि बसै सु होत निहालु ॥
lines.e: That one, within whose mind He abides, is blissfully happy.

lines.g: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਤ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
lines.r: taa kai nikaT na aavat kaal ||
lines.ht: ता कै निकटि न आवत कालु ॥
lines.e: Death does not draw near him.
One becomes immortal, and obtains the immortal status,
meditating on the Lord, O Nanak, in the Company of the Holy. ||8||22||
Shalok:

lines.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧੇਰ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥
lines.r: giaan a(n)jan gur dheeaa agiaan a(n)dher binaas ||
lines.ht: गिआन अंजनु गुरि दीआ अगिआन अंधेर बिनासु ॥
lines.e: The Guru has given the healing ointment of spiritual wisdom, and dispelled the darkness of ignorance.

lines.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
lines.r: har kirapaa te sa(n)t bheTiaa naanak man paragaas ||1||
lines.ht: हरि किरपा ते संत भेटिआ नानक मनि परगासु ॥१॥
lines.e: By the Lord's Grace, I have met the Saint; O Nanak, my mind is enlightened. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
In the Society of the Saints, I see God deep within my being.
God's Name is sweet to me.
All things are contained in the Heart of the One,
although they appear in so many various colors.

lines.g: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
lines.r: nau nidh a(n)mrit prabh kaa naam ||
lines.ht: नउ निधि अंमृतु प्रभ का नामु ॥
lines.e: The nine treasures are in the Ambrosial Name of God.
Within the human body is its place of rest.
The Deepest Samaadhi, and the unstruck sound current of the Naad are there.
The wonder and marvel of it cannot be described.
He alone sees it, unto whom God Himself reveals it.
O Nanak, that humble being understands. ||1||
The Infinite Lord is inside, and outside as well.
Deep within each and every heart, the Lord God is pervading.
In the earth, in the Akaashic ethers, and in the nether regions of the underworld
in all worlds, He is the Perfect Cherisher.
In the forests, fields and mountains, He is the Supreme Lord God.
As He orders, so do His creatures act.
He permeates the winds and the waters.
He is pervading in the four corners and in the ten directions.

lines.g: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਭਿੰਨ ਨਹੀ ਕੋ ਠਾਉ ॥
lines.r: tis te bhi(n)n nahee ko Thaau ||
lines.ht: तिस ते भिंन नही को ठाउ ॥
lines.e: Without Him, there is no place at all.
By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, peace is obtained. ||2||
See Him in the Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees.
In the moon, the sun and the stars, He is the One.

lines.g: ਬਾਣੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਬੋਲੈ ॥
lines.r: baanee prabh kee sabh ko bolai ||
lines.ht: बाणी प्रभ की सभु को बोलै ॥
lines.e: The Bani of God's Word is spoken by everyone.
He Himself is unwavering - He never wavers.
With absolute power, He plays His play.
His value cannot be estimated; His virtues are invaluable.

lines.g: ਸਰਬ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਜੋਤਿ ॥
lines.r: sarab jot meh jaa kee jot ||
lines.ht: सरब जोति महि जा की जोति ॥
lines.e: In all light, is His Light.
The Lord and Master supports the weave of the fabric of the universe.
By Guru's Grace, doubt is dispelled.
O Nanak, this faith is firmly implanted within. ||3||

lines.g: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਪੇਖਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)t janaa kaa pekhan sabh braham ||
lines.ht: संत जना का पेखनु सभु ब्रहम ॥
lines.e: In the eye of the Saint, everything is God.

lines.g: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਭਿ ਧਰਮ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)t janaa kai hiradhai sabh dharam ||
lines.ht: संत जना कै हिरदै सभि धरम ॥
lines.e: In the heart of the Saint, everything is Dharma.
The Saint hears words of goodness.
He is absorbed in the All-pervading Lord.

lines.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਇਹ ਰਹਤ ॥
lines.r: jin jaataa tis kee ieh rahat ||
lines.ht: जिनि जाता तिस की इह रहत ॥
lines.e: This is the way of life of one who knows God.
True are all the words spoken by the Holy.

lines.g: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਹੋਇ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
lines.r: jo jo hoi soiee sukh maanai ||
lines.ht: जो जो होइ सोई सुखु मानै ॥
lines.e: Whatever happens, he peacefully accepts.
He knows God as the Doer, the Cause of causes.
He dwells inside, and outside as well.
O Nanak, beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, all are fascinated. ||4||
He Himself is True, and all that He has made is True.
The entire creation came from God.
As it pleases Him, He creates the expanse.
As it pleases Him, He becomes the One and Only again.
His powers are so numerous, they cannot be known.
As it pleases Him, He merges us into Himself again.
Who is near, and who is far away?
He Himself is Himself pervading everywhere.
One whom God causes to know that He is within the heart
- O Nanak, He causes that person to understand Him. ||5||
In all forms, He Himself is pervading.
Through all eyes, He Himself is watching.
All the creation is His Body.
He Himself listens to His Own Praise.
The One has created the drama of coming and going.
He made Maya subservient to His Will.
In the midst of all, He remains unattached.

lines.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣਾ ਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਕਹੈ ॥
lines.r: jo kichh kahanaa su aape kahai ||
lines.ht: जो किछु कहणा सु आपे कहै ॥
lines.e: Whatever is said, He Himself says.
By His Will we come, and by His Will we go.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਲਏ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੬॥
lines.r: naanak jaa bhaavai taa le samai ||6||
lines.ht: नानक जा भावै ता लए समाइ ॥६॥
lines.e: O Nanak, when it pleases Him, then He absorbs us into Himself. ||6||

lines.g: ਇਸ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਬੁਰਾ ॥
lines.r: eis te hoi su naahee buraa ||
lines.ht: इस ते होइ सु नाही बुरा ॥
lines.e: If it comes from Him, it cannot be bad.
Other than Him, who can do anything?
He Himself is good; His actions are the very best.
He Himself knows His Own Being.
He Himself is True, and all that He has established is True.
Through and through, He is blended with His creation.

lines.g: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.r: taa kee gat mit kahee na jai ||
lines.ht: ता की गति मिति कही न जाइ ॥
lines.e: His state and extent cannot be described.
If there were another like Him, then only he could understand Him.
His actions are all approved and accepted.
By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, this is known. ||7||

lines.g: ਜੋ ਜਾਨੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.r: jo jaanai tis sadhaa sukh hoi ||
lines.ht: जो जानै तिसु सदा सुखु होइ ॥
lines.e: One who knows Him, obtains everlasting peace.
God blends that one into Himself.
He is wealth and prosperous, and of noble birth.
He is Jivan Mukta - liberated while yet alive; the Lord God abides in his heart.
Blessed, blessed, blessed is the coming of that humble being;
by his grace, the whole world is saved.
This is his purpose in life;

lines.g: ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.r: jan kai sa(n)g chit aavai naau ||
lines.ht: जन कै संगि चिति आवै नाउ ॥
lines.e: in the Company of this humble servant, the Lord's Name comes to mind.
He Himself is liberated, and He liberates the universe.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ॥੮॥੨੩॥
lines.r: naanak tis jan kau sadhaa namasakaar ||8||23||
lines.ht: नानक तिसु जन कउ सदा नमसकारु ॥८॥२३॥
lines.e: O Nanak, to that humble servant, I bow in reverence forever. ||8||23||
Shalok:

lines.g: ਪੂਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.r: pooraa prabh aaraadhiaa pooraa jaa kaa naau ||
lines.ht: पूरा प्रभु आराधिआ पूरा जा का नाउ ॥
lines.e: I worship and adore the Perfect Lord God. Perfect is His Name.

lines.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥
lines.r: naanak pooraa paiaa poore ke gun gaau ||1||
lines.ht: नानक पूरा पाइआ पूरे के गुन गाउ ॥१॥
lines.e: O Nanak, I have obtained the Perfect One; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Perfect Lord. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
Listen to the Teachings of the Perfect Guru;
see the Supreme Lord God near you.
With each and every breath, meditate in remembrance on the Lord of the Universe,
and the anxiety within your mind shall depart.
Abandon the waves of fleeting desire,

lines.g: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਮਨ ਮੰਗ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)t janaa kee dhoor man ma(n)g ||
lines.ht: संत जना की धूरि मन मंग ॥
lines.e: and pray for the dust of the feet of the Saints.
Renounce your selfishness and conceit and offer your prayers.
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, cross over the ocean of fire.

lines.g: ਹਰਿ ਧਨ ਕੇ ਭਰਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
lines.r: har dhan ke bhar leh bha(n)ddaar ||
lines.ht: हरि धन के भरि लेहु भंडार ॥
lines.e: Fill your stores with the wealth of the Lord.
Nanak bows in humility and reverence to the Perfect Guru. ||1||
Happiness, intuitive peace, poise and bliss
in the Company of the Holy, meditate on the Lord of supreme bliss.
You shall be spared from hell - save your soul!
Drink in the ambrosial essence of the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.
Focus your consciousness on the One, the All-pervading Lord

lines.g: ਏਕ ਰੂਪ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਰੰਗ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
lines.r: ek roop jaa ke ra(n)g anek ||
lines.ht: एक रूप जा के रंग अनेक ॥
lines.e: He has One Form, but He has many manifestations.
Sustainer of the Universe, Lord of the world, Kind to the poor,
Destroyer of sorrow, perfectly Merciful.
Meditate, meditate in remembrance on the Naam, again and again.
O Nanak, it is the Support of the soul. ||2||
The most sublime hymns are the Words of the Holy.
These are priceless rubies and gems.
One who listens and acts on them is saved.
He himself swims across, and saves others as well.

lines.g: ਸਫਲ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
lines.r: safal jeevan safal taa kaa sa(n)g ||
lines.ht: सफल जीवनु सफलु ता का संगु ॥
lines.e: His life is prosperous, and his company is fruitful;

lines.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
lines.r: jaa kai man laagaa har ra(n)g ||
lines.ht: जा कै मनि लागा हरि रंगु ॥
lines.e: his mind is imbued with the love of the Lord.
Hail, hail to him, for whom the sound current of the Shabad vibrates.

lines.g: ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਅਨਦ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਗਾਜੈ ॥
lines.r: sun sun anadh kare prabh gaajai ||
lines.ht: सुनि सुनि अनद करे प्रभु गाजै ॥
lines.e: Hearing it again and again, he is in bliss, proclaiming God's Praises.
The Lord radiates from the foreheads of the Holy.
Nanak is saved in their company. ||3||
Hearing that He can give Sanctuary, I have come seeking His Sanctuary.
Bestowing His Mercy, God has blended me with Himself.

lines.g: ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਬੈਰ ਭਏ ਸਭ ਰੇਨ ॥
lines.r: miT ge bair bhe sabh ren ||
lines.ht: मिटि गए बैर भए सभ रेन ॥
lines.e: Hatred is gone, and I have become the dust of all.
I have received the Ambrosial Naam in the Company of the Holy.
The Divine Guru is perfectly pleased;
the service of His servant has been rewarded.
I have been released from worldly entanglements and corruption,
hearing the Lord's Name and chanting it with my tongue.
By His Grace, God has bestowed His Mercy.
O Nanak, my merchandise has arrived save and sound. ||4||

lines.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਮੀਤ ॥
lines.r: prabh kee usatat karahu sa(n)t meet ||
lines.ht: प्रभ की उसतति करहु संत मीत ॥
lines.e: Sing the Praises of God, O Saints, O friends,
with total concentration and one-pointedness of mind.
Sukhmani is the peaceful ease, the Glory of God, the Naam.

lines.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
lines.r: jis man basai su hot nidhaan ||
lines.ht: जिसु मनि बसै सु होत निधान ॥
lines.e: When it abides in the mind, one becomes wealthy.

lines.g: ਸਰਬ ਇਛਾ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.r: sarab ichhaa taa kee pooran hoi ||
lines.ht: सरब इछा ता की पूरन होइ ॥
lines.e: All desires are fulfilled.
One becomes the most respected person, famous all over the world.
He obtains the highest place of all.
He does not come and go in reincarnation any longer.

lines.g: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਾਟਿ ਚਲੈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.r: har dhan khaaT chalai jan soi ||
lines.ht: हरि धनु खाटि चलै जनु सोइ ॥
lines.e: One who departs, after earning the wealth of the Lord's Name,
O Nanak, realizes it. ||5||
Comfort, peace and tranquility, wealth and the nine treasures;
wisdom, knowledge, and all spiritual powers;
learning, penance, Yoga and meditation on God;
The most sublime wisdom and purifying baths;
the four cardinal blessings, the opening of the heart-lotus;

lines.g: ਸਭ ਕੈ ਮਧਿ ਸਗਲ ਤੇ ਉਦਾਸ ॥
lines.r: sabh kai madh sagal te udhaas ||
lines.ht: सभ कै मधि सगल ते उदास ॥
lines.e: in the midst of all, and yet detached from all;
beauty, intelligence, and the realization of reality;
to look impartially upon all, and to see only the One

lines.g: ਇਹ ਫਲ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਭਨੇ ॥ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਬਚਨ ਮਨਿ ਸੁਨੇ ॥੬॥
lines.r: eeh fal tis jan kai mukh bhane || gur naanak naam bachan man sune ||6||
lines.ht: इह फल तिसु जन कै मुखि भने ॥ गुर नानक नाम बचन मनि सुने ॥६॥
lines.e: - these blessings come to one who, through Guru Nanak, chants the Naam with his mouth, and hears the Word with his ears. ||6||
One who chants this treasure in his mind

lines.g: ਸਭ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.r: sabh jug meh taa kee gat hoi ||
lines.ht: सभ जुग महि ता की गति होइ ॥
lines.e: in every age, he attains salvation.
In it is the Glory of God, the Naam, the chanting of Gurbani.
The Simritees, the Shaastras and the Vedas speak of it.
The essence of all religion is the Lord's Name alone.
It abides in the minds of the devotees of God.
Millions of sins are erased, in the Company of the Holy.

lines.g: ਸੰਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਛੁਟੈ ॥
lines.r: sa(n)t kirapaa te jam te chhuTai ||
lines.ht: संत कृपा ते जम ते छुटै ॥
lines.e: By the Grace of the Saint, one escapes the Messenger of Death.

lines.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਕਰਮ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.r: jaa kai masatak karam prabh paae ||
lines.ht: जा कै मसतकि करम प्रभि पाए ॥
lines.e: Those, who have such pre-ordained destiny on their foreheads,
O Nanak, enter the Sanctuary of the Saints. ||7||

lines.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ ਸੁਨੈ ਲਾਇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
lines.r: jis man basai sunai lai preet ||
lines.ht: जिसु मनि बसै सुनै लाइ प्रीति ॥
lines.e: One, within whose mind it abides, and who listens to it with love

lines.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
lines.r: tis jan aavai har prabh cheet ||
lines.ht: तिसु जन आवै हरि प्रभु चीति ॥
lines.e: that humble person consciously remembers the Lord God.

lines.g: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ॥
lines.r: janam maran taa kaa dhookh nivaarai ||
lines.ht: जनम मरन ता का दूखु निवारै ॥
lines.e: The pains of birth and death are removed.
The human body, so difficult to obtain, is instantly redeemed.

lines.g: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਭਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
lines.r: niramal sobhaa a(n)mirat taa kee baanee ||
lines.ht: निरमल सोभा अंमृत ता की बानी ॥
lines.e: Spotlessly pure is his reputation, and ambrosial is his speech.
The One Name permeates his mind.
Sorrow, sickness, fear and doubt depart.

lines.g: ਸਾਧ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਕਰਮ ॥
lines.r: saadh naam niramal taa ke karam ||
lines.ht: साध नाम निरमल ता के करम ॥
lines.e: He is called a Holy person; his actions are immaculate and pure.

lines.g: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਬਨੀ ॥
lines.r: sabh te uooch taa kee sobhaa banee ||
lines.ht: सभ ते ऊच ता की सोभा बनी ॥
lines.e: His glory becomes the highest of all.
O Nanak, by these Glorious Virtues, this is named Sukhmani, Peace of mind. ||8||24||
